text_en: Now it came to pass, after that Alexander the son of Philip the Macedonian, who first reigned in Greece, coming out of the land of Cethim, had overthrown Darius, king of the Persians and Medes :
text_la: Et factum est, postquam percussit Alexander Philippi Macedo, qui primus regnavit in Græcia, egressus de terra Cethim, Darium regem Persarum et Medorum:
text_pt: Provérbios de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ πατάξαι Ἀλέξανδρον τὸν Φιλίππου Μακεδόνα ὃς ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ γῆς Χεττιιμ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Δαρεῖον βασιλέα Περσῶν καὶ Μήδων καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ πρότερον ἐπὶ τὴν Ἑλλάδα

text_en: He fought many battles, and took the strong holds of all, and slew the kings of the earth:
text_la: constituit prælia multa, et obtinuit omnium munitiones, et interfecit reges terræ,
text_pt: Para se conhecer a sabedoria e a instrução; para se entenderem, as palavras da prudência.
text_el: καὶ συνεστήσατο πολέμους πολλοὺς καὶ ἐκράτησεν ὀχυρωμάτων καὶ ἔσφαξεν βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he went through even to the ends of the earth: and took the spoils of many nations: and the earth was quiet before him.
text_la: et pertransiit usque ad fines terræ : et accepit spolia multitudinis gentium, et siluit terra in conspectu ejus.
text_pt: Para se receber a instrução do entendimento, a justiça, o juízo e a eqüidade;
text_el: καὶ διῆλθεν ἕως ἄκρων τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔλαβεν σκῦλα πλήθους ἐθνῶν καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he gathered a power, and a very strong army: and his heart was exalted and lifted up:
text_la: Et congregavit virtutem, et exercitum fortem nimis : et exaltatum est, et elevatum cor ejus:
text_pt: Para dar aos simples, prudência, e aos moços, conhecimento e bom siso;
text_el: καὶ ὑψώθη καὶ ἐπήρθη ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he subdued countries of nations, and princes; and they became tributaries to him.
text_la: et obtinuit regiones gentium, et tyrannos : et facti sunt illi in tributum.
text_pt: O sábio ouvirá e crescerá em conhecimento, e o entendido adquirirá sábios conselhos;
text_el: καὶ συνῆξεν δύναμιν ἰσχυρὰν σφόδρα καὶ ἦρξεν χωρῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ τυράννων καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ εἰς φόρον

text_en: And after these things, he fell down upon his bed, and knew that he should die.
text_la: Et post hæc decidit in lectum, et cognovit quia moreretur.
text_pt: Para entender os provérbios e sua interpretação; as palavras dos sábios e as suas proposições.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην καὶ ἔγνω ὅτι ἀποθνῄσκει

text_en: And he called his servants, the nobles that were brought up with him from his youth: and he divided his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.
text_la: Et vocavit pueros suos nobiles, qui secum erant nutriti a juventute : et divisit illis regnum suum, cum adhuc viveret.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é o princípio do conhecimento; os loucos desprezam a sabedoria e a instrução.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ τοὺς ἐνδόξους τοὺς συνεκτρόφους αὐτοῦ ἐκ νεότητος καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτοῖς τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ ἔτι αὐτοῦ ζῶντος

text_en: And Alexander reigned twelve years, and he died.
text_la: Et regnavit Alexander annis duodecim, et mortuus est.
text_pt: Filho meu, ouve a instrução de teu pai, e não deixes o ensinamento de tua mãe,
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ἀλέξανδρος ἔτη δώδεκα καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And his servants made themselves kings, every one in his place:
text_la: Et obtinuerunt pueri ejus regnum, unusquisque in loco suo:
text_pt: Porque serão como diadema gracioso em tua cabeça, e colares ao teu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκράτησαν οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they all put crowns upon themselves after his death, and their sons after them, many years; and evils were multiplied in the earth.
text_la: et imposuerunt omnes sibi diademata post mortem ejus, et filii eorum post eos annis multis, et multiplicata sunt mala in terra.
text_pt: Filho meu, se os pecadores procuram te atrair com agrados, não aceites.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέθεντο πάντες διαδήματα μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτὸν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἔτη πολλὰ καὶ ἐπλήθυναν κακὰ ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: And there came out of them a wicked root, Antiochus the Illustrious, the son of King Antiochus, who had been a hostage at Rome: and he reigned in the hundred and thirty-seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
text_la: Et exiit ex eis radix peccatrix, Antiochus illustris, filius Antiochi regis, qui fuerat Romæ obses : et regnavit in anno centesimo trigesimo septimo regni Græcorum.
text_pt: Se disserem: Vem conosco a tocaias de sangue; embosquemos o inocente sem motivo;
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτῶν ῥίζα ἁμαρτωλὸς Ἀντίοχος Ἐπιφανὴς υἱὸς Ἀντιόχου τοῦ βασιλέως ὃς ἦν ὅμηρα ἐν Ῥώμῃ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν ἔτει ἑκατοστῷ καὶ τριακοστῷ καὶ ἑβδόμῳ βασιλείας Ἑλλήνων

text_en: In those days there went out of Israel wicked men , and they persuaded many, saying: Let us go and make a covenant with the heathens that are round about us: for since we departed from them, many evils have befallen us.
text_la: In diebus illis, exierunt ex Israël filii iniqui, et suaserunt multis, dicentes : Eamus, et disponamus testamentum cum gentibus, quæ circa nos sunt : quia ex quo recessimus ab eis, invenerunt nos multa mala.
text_pt: Traguemo-los vivos, como a sepultura; e inteiros, como os que descem à cova;
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐξῆλθον ἐξ Ισραηλ υἱοὶ παράνομοι καὶ ἀνέπεισαν πολλοὺς λέγοντες πορευθῶμεν καὶ διαθώμεθα διαθήκην μετὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν κύκλῳ ἡμῶν ὅτι ἀφ' ἧς ἐχωρίσθημεν ἀπ' αὐτῶν εὗρεν ἡμᾶς κακὰ πολλά

text_en: And the word seemed good in their eyes.
text_la: Et bonus visus est sermo in oculis eorum.
text_pt: Acharemos toda sorte de bens preciosos; encheremos as nossas casas de despojos;
text_el: καὶ ἠγαθύνθη ὁ λόγος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: And some of the people determined to do this, and went to the king: and he gave them license to do after the ordinances of the heathens .
text_la: Et destinaverunt aliqui de populo, et abierunt ad regem : et dedit illis potestatem ut facerent justitiam gentium.
text_pt: Lança a tua sorte conosco; teremos todos uma só bolsa!
text_el: καὶ προεθυμήθησάν τινες ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν ποιῆσαι τὰ δικαιώματα τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And they built a place of exercise in Jerusalem , according to the laws of the nations:
text_la: Et ædificaverunt gymnasium in Jerosolymis secundum leges nationum:
text_pt: Filho meu, não te ponhas a caminho com eles; desvia o teu pé das suas veredas;
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν γυμνάσιον ἐν Ιεροσολύμοις κατὰ τὰ νόμιμα τῶν ἐθνῶν

text_en: And they made themselves prepuces, and departed from the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathens , and were sold to do evil :
text_la: et fecerunt sibi præputia, et recesserunt a testamento sancto, et juncti sunt nationibus, et venundati sunt ut facerent malum.
text_pt: Porque os seus pés correm para o mal, e se apressam a derramar sangue.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς ἀκροβυστίας καὶ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ διαθήκης ἁγίας καὶ ἐζευγίσθησαν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐπράθησαν τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρόν

text_en: And the kingdom was established before Antiochus, and he had a mind to reign over the land of Egypt , that he might reign over two kingdoms.
text_la: Et paratum est regnum in conspectu Antiochi, et cœpit regnare in terra Ægypti ut regnaret super duo regna.
text_pt: Na verdade é inútil estender-se a rede ante os olhos de qualquer ave.
text_el: καὶ ἡτοιμάσθη ἡ βασιλεία ἐνώπιον Ἀντιόχου καὶ ὑπέλαβεν βασιλεῦσαι γῆς Αἰγύπτου ὅπως βασιλεύσῃ ἐπὶ τὰς δύο βασιλείας

text_en: And he entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, and elephants, and horsemen, and a great number of ships:
text_la: Et intravit in Ægyptum in multitudine gravi, in curribus, et elephantis, et equitibus, et copiosa navium multitudine:
text_pt: No entanto estes armam ciladas contra o seu próprio sangue; e espreitam suas próprias vidas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐν ὄχλῳ βαρεῖ ἐν ἅρμασιν καὶ ἐλέφασιν καὶ ἐν ἱππεῦσιν καὶ ἐν στόλῳ μεγάλῳ

text_en: And he made war against Ptolemee king of Egypt ; but Ptolemee was afraid at his presence and fled, and many were wounded unto death.
text_la: et constituit bellum adversus Ptolemæum regem Ægypti, et veritus est Ptolemæus a facie ejus, et fugit, et ceciderunt vulnerati multi.
text_pt: São assim as veredas de todo aquele que usa de cobiça: ela põe a perder a alma dos que a possuem.
text_el: καὶ συνεστήσατο πόλεμον πρὸς Πτολεμαῖον βασιλέα Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐνετράπη Πτολεμαῖος ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι πολλοί

text_en: And he took the strong cities in the land of Egypt : and he took the spoils of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Et comprehendit civitates munitas in terra Ægypti, et accepit spolia terræ Ægypti.
text_pt: A sabedoria clama lá fora; pelas ruas levanta a sua voz.
text_el: καὶ κατελάβοντο τὰς πόλεις τὰς ὀχυρὰς ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ σκῦλα γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And after Antiochus had ravaged Egypt , in the hundred and forty-third year, he returned and went up against Israel .
text_la: Et convertit Antiochus, postquam percussit Ægyptum in centesimo et quadragesimo tertio anno : et ascendit ad Israël,
text_pt: Nas esquinas movimentadas ela brada; nas entradas das portas e nas cidades profere as suas palavras:
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ἀντίοχος μετὰ τὸ πατάξαι Αἴγυπτον ἐν τῷ ἑκατοστῷ καὶ τεσσαρακοστῷ καὶ τρίτῳ ἔτει καὶ ἀνέβη ἐπὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he went up to Jerusalem , with a great multitude.
text_la: et ascendit Jerosolymam in multitudine gravi.
text_pt: Até quando, ó simples, amareis a simplicidade? E vós escarnecedores, desejareis o escárnio? E vós insensatos, odiareis o conhecimento?
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ιεροσόλυμα ἐν ὄχλῳ βαρεῖ

text_en: And he proudly entered into the sanctuary, and took away the golden altar , and the candlestick of light, and all the vessels thereof, and the table of proposition, and the pouring vessels, and the vials, and the little mortars of gold, and the veil, and the crowns, and the golden ornament that was before the temple : and he broke them all in pieces.
text_la: Et intravit in sanctificationem cum superbia, et accepit altare aureum, et candelabrum luminis, et universa vasa ejus, et mensam propositionis, et libatoria, et phialas, et mortariola aurea, et velum, et coronas, et ornamentum aureum, quod in facie templi erat : et comminuit omnia.
text_pt: Atentai para a minha repreensão; pois eis que vos derramarei abundantemente do meu espírito e vos farei saber as minhas palavras.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸ ἁγίασμα ἐν ὑπερηφανίᾳ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν καὶ τὴν λυχνίαν τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν τράπεζαν τῆς προθέσεως καὶ τὰ σπονδεῖα καὶ τὰς φιάλας καὶ τὰς θυΐσκας τὰς χρυσᾶς καὶ τὸ καταπέτασμα καὶ τοὺς στεφάνους καὶ τὸν κόσμον τὸν χρυσοῦν τὸν κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ ἐλέπισεν πάντα

text_en: And he took the silver and gold, and the precious vessels: and he took the hidden treasures, which he found: and when he had taken all away, he departed into his own country.
text_la: Et accepit argentum, et aurum, et vasa concupiscibilia : et accepit thesauros occultos, quos invenit : et sublatis omnibus, abiit in terram suam.
text_pt: Entretanto, porque eu clamei e recusastes; e estendi a minha mão e não houve quem desse atenção,
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὸ χρυσίον καὶ τὰ σκεύη τὰ ἐπιθυμητὰ καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς θησαυροὺς τοὺς ἀποκρύφους οὓς εὗρεν

text_en: And he made a great slaughter of men , and spoke very proudly .
text_la: Et fecit cædem hominum, et locutus est in superbia magna.
text_pt: Antes rejeitastes todo o meu conselho, e não quisestes a minha repreensão,
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν πάντα ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν φονοκτονίαν καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὑπερηφανίαν μεγάλην

text_en: And there was great mourning in Israel , and in every place where they were:
text_la: Et factus est planctus magnus in Israël, et in omni loco eorum:
text_pt: Também de minha parte eu me rirei na vossa perdição e zombarei, em vindo o vosso temor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πένθος μέγα ἐπὶ Ισραηλ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And the princes, and the ancients mourned, and the virgins and the young men were made feeble, and the beauty of the women was changed.
text_la: et ingemuerunt principes et seniores; virgines et juvenes infirmati sunt : et speciositas mulierum immutata est.
text_pt: Vindo o vosso temor como a assolação, e vindo a vossa perdição como uma tormenta, sobrevirá a vós aperto e angústia.
text_el: καὶ ἐστέναξαν ἄρχοντες καὶ πρεσβύτεροι παρθένοι καὶ νεανίσκοι ἠσθένησαν καὶ τὸ κάλλος τῶν γυναικῶν ἠλλοιώθη

text_en: Every bridegroom took up lamentation: and the bride that sat in the marriage bed, mourned:
text_la: Omnis maritus sumpsit lamentum, et quæ sedebant in thoro maritali, lugebant:
text_pt: Então clamarão a mim, mas eu não responderei; de madrugada me buscarão, porém não me acharão.
text_el: πᾶς νυμφίος ἀνέλαβεν θρῆνον καὶ καθημένη ἐν παστῷ ἐπένθει

text_en: And the land was moved for the inhabitants thereof, and all the house of Jacob was covered with confusion.
text_la: et commota est terra super habitantes in ea, et universa domus Jacob induit confusionem.
text_pt: Porquanto odiaram o conhecimento; e não preferiram o temor do Senhor:
text_el: καὶ ἐσείσθη ἡ γῆ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας αὐτήν καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκος Ιακωβ ἐνεδύσατο αἰσχύνην

text_en: And after two full years, the king sent the chief collector of his tributes to the cities of Juda , and he came to Jerusalem with a great multitude.
text_la: Et post duos annos dierum, misit rex principem tributorum in civitates Juda, et venit Jerusalem cum turba magna.
text_pt: Não aceitaram o meu conselho, e desprezaram toda a minha repreensão.
text_el: μετὰ δύο ἔτη ἡμερῶν ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἄρχοντα φορολογίας εἰς τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ὄχλῳ βαρεῖ

text_en: And he spoke to them peaceable words in deceit; and they believed him.
text_la: Et locutus est ad eos verba pacifica in dolo : et crediderunt ei.
text_pt: Portanto comerão do fruto do seu caminho, e fartar-se-ão dos seus próprios conselhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς λόγους εἰρηνικοὺς ἐν δόλῳ καὶ ἐνεπίστευσαν αὐτῷ

text_en: And he fell upon the city suddenly, and struck it with a great slaughter, and destroyed much people in Israel .
text_la: Et irruit super civitatem repente, et percussit eam plaga magna, et perdidit populum multum ex Israël.
text_pt: Porque o erro dos simples os matará, e o desvario dos insensatos os destruirá.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ἐξάπινα καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὴν πληγὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἀπώλεσεν λαὸν πολὺν ἐξ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he took the spoils of the city, and burnt it with fire, and threw down the houses thereof, and the walls thereof round about:
text_la: Et accepit spolia civitatis : et succendit eam igni, et destruxit domos ejus, et muros ejus in circuitu:
text_pt: Mas o que me der ouvidos habitará em segurança, e estará livre do temor do mal.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ σκῦλα τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐνέπρησεν αὐτὴν πυρὶ καὶ καθεῖλεν τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ τείχη κύκλῳ

text_en: And they took the women captive, and the children, and the cattle they possessed.
text_la: et captivas duxerunt mulieres, et natos et pecora possederunt.
text_el: καὶ ᾐχμαλώτισαν τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ τὰ κτήνη ἐκληρονόμησαν

text_en: And they built the city of David with a great and strong wall, and with strong towers, and made it a fortress for them:
text_la: Et ædificaverunt civitatem David muro magno et firmo, et turribus firmis, et facta est illis in arcem:
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὴν πόλιν Δαυιδ τείχει μεγάλῳ καὶ ὀχυρῷ πύργοις ὀχυροῖς καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς εἰς ἄκραν

text_en: And they placed there a sinful nation, wicked men , and they fortified themselves therein: and they stored up armour and victuals, and gathered together the spoils of Jerusalem ;
text_la: et posuerunt illic gentem peccatricem viros iniquos, et convaluerunt in ea : et posuerunt arma, et escas, et congregaverunt spolia Jerusalem:
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκαν ἐκεῖ ἔθνος ἁμαρτωλόν ἄνδρας παρανόμους καὶ ἐνίσχυσαν ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ παρέθεντο ὅπλα καὶ τροφὴν καὶ συναγαγόντες τὰ σκῦλα Ιερουσαλημ ἀπέθεντο ἐκεῖ

text_en: and laid them up there: and they became a great snare.
text_la: et reposuerunt illic : et facti sunt in laqueum magnum.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο εἰς μεγάλην παγίδα

text_en: And this was a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil devil in Israel .
text_la: Et factum est hoc ad insidias sanctificationi, et in diabolum malum in Israël:
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς ἔνεδρον τῷ ἁγιάσματι καὶ εἰς διάβολον πονηρὸν τῷ Ισραηλ διὰ παντός

text_en: And they shed innocent blood round about the sanctuary, and defiled the holy place.
text_la: et effuderunt sanguinem innocentem per circuitum sanctificationis, et contaminaverunt sanctificationem.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέχεαν αἷμα ἀθῷον κύκλῳ τοῦ ἁγιάσματος καὶ ἐμόλυναν τὸ ἁγίασμα

text_en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled away by reason of them and the city was made the habitation of strangers, and she became a stranger to her own seed, and her children forsook her.
text_la: Et fugerunt habitatores Jerusalem propter eos, et facta est habitatio exterorum, et facta est extera semini suo, et nati ejus reliquerunt eam.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγον οἱ κάτοικοι Ιερουσαλημ δι' αὐτούς καὶ ἐγένετο κατοικία ἀλλοτρίων καὶ ἐγένετο ἀλλοτρία τοῖς γενήμασιν αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἐγκατέλιπον αὐτήν

text_en: Her sanctuary was desolate like a wilderness , her festival days were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into reproach, her honours were brought to nothing.
text_la: Sanctificatio ejus desolata est sicut solitudo; dies festi ejus conversi sunt in luctum, sabbata ejus in opprobrium, honores ejus in nihilum.
text_el: τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτῆς ἠρημώθη ὡς ἔρημος αἱ ἑορταὶ αὐτῆς ἐστράφησαν εἰς πένθος τὰ σάββατα αὐτῆς εἰς ὀνειδισμόν ἡ τιμὴ αὐτῆς εἰς ἐξουδένωσιν

text_en: Her dishonour was increased according to her glory , and her excellency was turned into mourning.
text_la: Secundum gloriam ejus multiplicata est ignominia ejus, et sublimitas ejus conversa est in luctum.
text_el: κατὰ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῆς ἐπληθύνθη ἡ ἀτιμία αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς ἐστράφη εἰς πένθος

text_en: And King Antiochus wrote to all his kingdom, that all the people should be one: and every one should leave his own law.
text_la: Et scripsit rex Antiochus omni regno suo ut esset omnis populus unus: et relinqueret unusquisque legem suam.
text_el: καὶ ἔγραψεν ὁ βασιλεὺς πάσῃ τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ εἶναι πάντας εἰς λαὸν ἕνα

text_en: And all nations consented, according to the word of King Antiochus.
text_la: Et consenserunt omnes gentes secundum verbum regis Antiochi:
text_el: καὶ ἐγκαταλιπεῖν ἕκαστον τὰ νόμιμα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπεδέξαντο πάντα τὰ ἔθνη κατὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And many of Israel consented to his service, and they sacrificed to idols, and profaned the sabbath .
text_la: et multi ex Israël consenserunt servituti ejus, et sacrificaverunt idolis, et coinquinaverunt sabbatum.
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἀπὸ Ισραηλ εὐδόκησαν τῇ λατρείᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθυσαν τοῖς εἰδώλοις καὶ ἐβεβήλωσαν τὸ σάββατον

text_en: And the king sent letters by the hands of messengers to Jerusalem , and to all the cities of Juda ; that they should follow the law of the nations of the earth.
text_la: Et misit rex libros per manus nuntiorum in Jerusalem, et in omnes civitates Juda, ut sequerentur leges gentium terræ,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς βιβλία ἐν χειρὶ ἀγγέλων εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ τὰς πόλεις Ιουδα πορευθῆναι ὀπίσω νομίμων ἀλλοτρίων τῆς γῆς

text_en: And should forbid holocausts and sacrifices , and atonements to be made in the temple of God .
text_la: et prohiberent holocausta et sacrificia, et placationes fieri in templo Dei,
text_el: καὶ κωλῦσαι ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίαν καὶ σπονδὴν ἐκ τοῦ ἁγιάσματος

text_en: And should prohibit the sabbath , and the festival days to be celebrated.
text_la: et prohiberent celebrari sabbatum, et dies solemnes:
text_el: καὶ βεβηλῶσαι σάββατα καὶ ἑορτὰς

text_en: And he commanded the holy places to be profaned, and the holy people of Israel .
text_la: et jussit coinquinari sancta, et sanctum populum Israël.
text_el: καὶ μιᾶναι ἁγίασμα καὶ ἁγίους

text_en: And he commanded altars to be built, and temples, and idols, and swine's flesh to be immolated, and unclean beasts,
text_la: Et jussit ædificari aras, et templa, et idola, et immolari carnes suillas, et pecora communia,
text_el: οἰκοδομῆσαι βωμοὺς καὶ τεμένη καὶ εἰδώλια καὶ θύειν ὕεια καὶ κτήνη κοινὰ

text_en: and that they should leave their children uncircumcised, and let their souls be defiled with all uncleannesses , and abominations, to the end that they should forget the law, and should change all the justifications of God .
text_la: et relinquere filios suos incircumcisos, et coinquinari animas eorum in omnibus immundis, et abominationibus, ita ut obliviscerentur legem, et immutarent omnes justificationes Dei:
text_el: καὶ ἀφιέναι τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν ἀπεριτμήτους βδελύξαι τὰς ψυχὰς αὐτῶν ἐν παντὶ ἀκαθάρτῳ καὶ βεβηλώσει ὥστε ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ νόμου καὶ ἀλλάξαι πάντα τὰ δικαιώματα

text_en: And that whosoever would not do according to the word of King Antiochus, should be put to death.
text_la: et quicumque non fecissent secundum verbum regis Antiochi, morerentur.
text_el: καὶ ὃς ἂν μὴ ποιήσῃ κατὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: According to all these words he wrote to his whole kingdom: and he appointed rulers over the people that should force them to do these things.
text_la: Secundum omnia verba hæc scripsit omni regno suo : et præposuit principes populo, qui hæc fieri cogerent.
text_el: κατὰ πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἔγραψεν πάσῃ τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐπισκόπους ἐπὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν

text_en: And they commanded the cities of Juda to sacrifice .
text_la: Et jusserunt civitatibus Juda sacrificare.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα θυσιάζειν κατὰ πόλιν καὶ πόλιν

text_en: Then many of the people were gathered to them that had forsaken the law of the Lord : and they committed evils in the land:
text_la: Et congregati sunt multi de populo ad eos qui dereliquerant legem Domini, et fecerunt mala super terram:
text_el: καὶ συνηθροίσθησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ πολλοὶ πρὸς αὐτούς πᾶς ὁ ἐγκαταλείπων τὸν νόμον καὶ ἐποίησαν κακὰ ἐν τῇ γῇ

text_en: And they drove away the people of Israel into lurking holes, and into the secret places of fugitives.
text_la: et effugaverunt populum Israël in abditis, et in absconditis fugitivorum locis.
text_el: καὶ ἔθεντο τὸν Ισραηλ ἐν κρύφοις ἐν παντὶ φυγαδευτηρίῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: On the fifteenth day of the month, Casleu, in the hundred and forty-fifth year, King Antiochus set up the abominable idol of desolation upon the altar of God , and they built altars throughout all the cities of Juda round about:
text_la: Die quintadecima mensis Casleu, quinto et quadragesimo et centesimo anno, ædificavit rex Antiochus abominandum idolum desolationis super altare Dei, et per universas civitates Juda in circuitu ædificaverunt aras:
text_el: καὶ τῇ πεντεκαιδεκάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ Χασελευ τῷ πέμπτῳ καὶ τεσσαρακοστῷ καὶ ἑκατοστῷ ἔτει ᾠκοδόμησεν βδέλυγμα ἐρημώσεως ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα κύκλῳ ᾠκοδόμησαν βωμούς

text_en: And they burnt incense , and sacrificed at the doors of the houses and in the streets.
text_la: et ante januas domorum et in plateis incendebant thura, et sacrificabant:
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν θυρῶν τῶν οἰκιῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἐθυμίων

text_en: And they cut in pieces, and burnt with fire the books of the law of God :
text_la: et libros legis Dei combusserunt igni, scindentes eos:
text_el: καὶ τὰ βιβλία τοῦ νόμου ἃ εὗρον ἐνεπύρισαν ἐν πυρὶ κατασχίσαντες

text_en: And every one with whom the books of the testament of the Lord were found, and whosoever observed the law of the Lord , they put to death, according to the edict of the king.
text_la: et apud quemcumque inveniebantur libri testamenti Domini, et quicumque observabat legem Domini, secundum edictum regis trucidabant eum.
text_el: καὶ ὅπου εὑρίσκετο παρά τινι βιβλίον διαθήκης καὶ εἴ τις συνευδόκει τῷ νόμῳ τὸ σύγκριμα τοῦ βασιλέως ἐθανάτου αὐτόν

text_en: Thus by their power did they deal with the people of Israel , that were found in the cities month after month.
text_la: In virtute sua faciebant hæc populo Israël, qui inveniebatur in omni mense et mense in civitatibus.
text_el: ἐν ἰσχύι αὐτῶν ἐποίουν τῷ Ισραηλ τοῖς εὑρισκομένοις ἐν παντὶ μηνὶ καὶ μηνὶ ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν

text_en: And on the five and twentieth day of the month they sacrificed upon the altar of the idol that was over against the altar of God .
text_la: Et quinta et vigesima die mensis sacrificabant super aram, quæ erat contra altare.
text_el: καὶ τῇ πέμπτῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνὸς θυσιάζοντες ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν ὃς ἦν ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου

text_en: Now the women that circumcised their children were slain according to the commandment of King Antiochus,
text_la: Et mulieres, quæ circumcidebant filios suos, trucidabantur secundum jussum regis Antiochi,
text_el: καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας τὰς περιτετμηκυίας τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ἐθανάτωσαν κατὰ τὸ πρόσταγμα

text_en: and they hanged the children about their necks in all their houses: and those that had circumcised them, they put to death.
text_la: et suspendebant pueros a cervicibus per universas domos eorum : et eos, qui circumciderant illos, trucidabant.
text_el: καὶ ἐκρέμασαν τὰ βρέφη ἐκ τῶν τραχήλων αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς περιτετμηκότας αὐτούς

text_en: And many of the people of Israel determined with themselves, that they would not eat unclean things: and they chose rather to die, than to be defiled with unclean meats:
text_la: Et multi de populo Israël definierunt apud se, ut non manducarent immunda : et elegerunt magis mori, quam cibis coinquinari immundis:
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐν Ισραηλ ἐκραταιώθησαν καὶ ὠχυρώθησαν ἐν αὑτοῖς τοῦ μὴ φαγεῖν κοινὰ

text_en: And they would not break the holy law of God and they were put to death:
text_la: et noluerunt infringere legem Dei sanctam, et trucidati sunt:
text_el: καὶ ἐπεδέξαντο ἀποθανεῖν ἵνα μὴ μιανθῶσιν τοῖς βρώμασιν καὶ μὴ βεβηλώσωσιν διαθήκην ἁγίαν καὶ ἀπέθανον

text_en: And there was very great wrath upon the people.
text_la: et facta est ira magna super populum valde.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὀργὴ μεγάλη ἐπὶ Ισραηλ σφόδρα

text_en: In those days arose Mathathias , the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem , and he abode in the mountain of Modin:
text_la: In diebus illis surrexit Mathathias filius Joannis filii Simeonis, sacerdos ex filiis Joarib, ab Jerusalem, et consedit in monte Modin:
text_pt: Filho meu, se aceitares as minhas palavras, e esconderes contigo os meus mandamentos,
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀνέστη Ματταθιας υἱὸς Ιωαννου τοῦ Συμεων ἱερεὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ιωαριβ ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν Μωδεϊν

text_en: And he had five sons: John, who was surnamed Gaddis:
text_la: et habebat filios quinque, Joannem, qui cognominabatur Gaddis:
text_pt: Para fazeres o teu ouvido atento à sabedoria; e inclinares o teu coração ao entendimento;
text_el: καὶ αὐτῷ υἱοὶ πέντε Ιωαννης ὁ ἐπικαλούμενος Γαδδι

text_en: And Simon, who was surnamed Thasi;
text_la: et Simonem, qui cognominabatur Thasi:
text_pt: Se clamares por conhecimento, e por inteligência alçares a tua voz,
text_el: Σιμων ὁ καλούμενος Θασσι

text_en: and Judas, who was called Machabeus ;
text_la: et Judam, qui vocabatur Machabæus:
text_pt: Se como a prata a buscares e como a tesouros escondidos a procurares,
text_el: Ιουδας ὁ καλούμενος Μακκαβαῖος

text_en: and Eleazar , who was surnamed Abaron; and Jonathan , who was surnamed Apphus.
text_la: et Eleazarum, qui cognominabatur Abaron : et Jonathan, qui cognominabatur Apphus:
text_pt: Então entenderás o temor do Senhor, e acharás o conhecimento de Deus.
text_el: Ελεαζαρ ὁ καλούμενος Αυαραν Ιωναθης ὁ καλούμενος Απφους

text_en: These saw the evils that were done in the people of Juda , and in Jerusalem .
text_la: hi viderunt mala, quæ fiebant in populo Juda, et in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor dá a sabedoria; da sua boca é que vem o conhecimento e o entendimento.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν τὰς βλασφημίας τὰς γινομένας ἐν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Mathathias said: Woe is me, wherefore was I born to see the ruin of my people, and the ruin of the holy city , and to dwell there, when it is given into the hands of the enemies?
text_la: Et dixit Mathathias : Væ mihi! ut quid natus sum videre contritionem populi mei, et contritionem civitatis sanctæ, et sedere illic, cum datur in manibus inimicorum?
text_pt: Ele reserva a verdadeira sabedoria para os retos. Escudo é para os que caminham na sinceridade,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν οἴμμοι ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἐγεννήθην ἰδεῖν τὸ σύντριμμα τοῦ λαοῦ μου καὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς ἁγίας πόλεως καὶ καθίσαι ἐκεῖ ἐν τῷ δοθῆναι αὐτὴν ἐν χειρὶ ἐχθρῶν τὸ ἁγίασμα ἐν χειρὶ ἀλλοτρίων

text_en: The holy places have come into the hands of strangers: her temple has become as a man without honour.
text_la: Sancta in manu extraneorum facta sunt : templum ejus sicut homo ignobilis.
text_pt: Para que guardem as veredas do juízo. Ele preservará o caminho dos seus santos.
text_el: ἐγένετο ὁ ναὸς αὐτῆς ὡς ἀνὴρ ἄδοξος

text_en: The vessels of her glory are carried away captive; her old men are murdered in the streets, and her young men are fallen by the sword of the enemies.
text_la: Vasa gloriæ ejus captiva abducta sunt : trucidati sunt senes ejus in plateis, et juvenes ejus ceciderunt in gladio inimicorum.
text_pt: Então entenderás a justiça, o juízo, a eqüidade e todas as boas veredas.
text_el: τὰ σκεύη τῆς δόξης αὐτῆς αἰχμάλωτα ἀπήχθη ἀπεκτάνθη τὰ νήπια αὐτῆς ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις αὐτῆς οἱ νεανίσκοι αὐτῆς ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ ἐχθροῦ

text_en: What nation has not inherited her kingdom, and gotten of her spoils?
text_la: Quæ gens non hæreditavit regnum ejus et non obtinuit spolia ejus?
text_pt: Pois quando a sabedoria entrar no teu coração, e o conhecimento for agradável à tua alma,
text_el: ποῖον ἔθνος οὐκ ἐκληρονόμησεν βασίλεια καὶ οὐκ ἐκράτησεν τῶν σκύλων αὐτῆς

text_en: All her ornaments are taken away. She that was free is made a slave.
text_la: Omnis compositio ejus ablata est. Quæ erat libera, facta est ancilla.
text_pt: O bom siso te guardará e a inteligência te conservará;
text_el: πᾶς ὁ κόσμος αὐτῆς ἀφῃρέθη ἀντὶ ἐλευθέρας ἐγένετο εἰς δούλην

text_en: And behold our sanctuary, and our beauty, and our glory is laid waste, and the Gentiles have defiled them.
text_la: Et ecce sancta nostra, et pulchritudo nostra, et claritas nostra desolata est, et coinquinaverunt ea gentes.
text_pt: Para te afastar do mau caminho, e do homem que fala coisas perversas;
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ τὰ ἅγια ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ καλλονὴ ἡμῶν καὶ ἡ δόξα ἡμῶν ἠρημώθη καὶ ἐβεβήλωσαν αὐτὰ τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: To what end then should we live any longer?
text_la: Quo ergo nobis adhuc vivere?
text_pt: Dos que deixam as veredas da retidão, para andarem pelos caminhos escusos;
text_el: ἵνα τί ἡμῖν ἔτι ζωή

text_en: And Mathathias and his sons rent their garments, and they covered themselves with haircloth, and made great lamentation.
text_la: Et scidit vestimenta sua Mathathias, et filii ejus : et operuerunt se ciliciis, et planxerunt valde.
text_pt: Que se alegram de fazer mal, e folgam com as perversidades dos maus,
text_el: καὶ διέρρηξεν Ματταθιας καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ περιεβάλοντο σάκκους καὶ ἐπένθησαν σφόδρα

text_en: And they that were sent from King Antiochus, came thither, to compel them that were fled into the city of Modin, to sacrifice , and to burn incense , and to depart from the law of God .
text_la: Et venerunt illuc qui missi erant a rege Antiocho, ut cogerent eos, qui confugerant in civitatem Modin, immolare, et accendere thura, et a lege Dei discedere.
text_pt: Cujas veredas são tortuosas e que se desviam nos seus caminhos;
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον οἱ παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως οἱ καταναγκάζοντες τὴν ἀποστασίαν εἰς Μωδεϊν τὴν πόλιν ἵνα θυσιάσωσιν

text_en: And many of the people of Israel consented and came to them: but Mathathias and his sons stood firm.
text_la: Et multi de populo Israël consentientes accesserunt ad eos : sed Mathathias et filii ejus constanter steterunt.
text_pt: Para te afastar da mulher estranha, sim da estranha que lisonjeia com suas palavras;
text_el: καὶ πολλοὶ ἀπὸ Ισραηλ πρὸς αὐτοὺς προσῆλθον καὶ Ματταθιας καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ συνήχθησαν

text_en: And they that were sent from Antiochus, answering, said to Mathathias : You are a ruler, and an honourable, and great man in this city, and adorned with sons, and brethren.
text_la: Et respondentes qui missi erant ab Antiocho, dixerunt Mathathiæ : Princeps, et clarissimus et magnus es in hac civitate, et ornatus filiis et fratribus:
text_pt: Que deixa o guia da sua mocidade e se esquece da aliança do seu Deus;
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ εἶπον τῷ Ματταθια λέγοντες ἄρχων καὶ ἔνδοξος καὶ μέγας εἶ ἐν τῇ πόλει ταύτῃ καὶ ἐστηρισμένος υἱοῖς καὶ ἀδελφοῖς

text_en: Therefore, come first, and obey the king's commandment, as all nations have done, and the men of Juda , and they that remain in Jerusalem : and you, and your sons shall be in the number of the king's friends, and enriched with gold, and silver, and many presents.
text_la: ergo accede prior, et fac jussum regis, sicut fecerunt omnes gentes, et viri Juda, et qui remanserunt in Jerusalem : et eris tu, et filii tui, inter amicos regis, et amplificatus auro, et argento, et muneribus multis.
text_pt: Porque a sua casa se inclina para a morte, e as suas veredas para os mortos.
text_el: νῦν πρόσελθε πρῶτος καὶ ποίησον τὸ πρόσταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως ὡς ἐποίησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες Ιουδα καὶ οἱ καταλειφθέντες ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔσῃ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου τῶν φίλων τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου δοξασθήσεσθε ἀργυρίῳ καὶ χρυσίῳ καὶ ἀποστολαῖς πολλαῖς

text_en: Then Mathathias answered, and said with a loud voice: Although all nations obey King Antiochus, so as to depart every man from the service of the law of his fathers, and consent to his commandments:
text_la: Et respondit Mathathias, et dixit magna voce : Etsi omnes gentes regi Antiocho obediunt, ut discedat unusquisque a servitute legis patrum suorum, et consentiat mandatis ejus:
text_pt: Todos os que se dirigem a ela não voltarão e não atinarão com as veredas da vida.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη Ματταθιας καὶ εἶπεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ εἰ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐν οἴκῳ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ βασιλέως ἀκούουσιν αὐτοῦ ἀποστῆναι ἕκαστος ἀπὸ λατρείας πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ᾑρετίσαντο ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: I and my sons, and my brethren will obey the law of our fathers.
text_la: ego et filii mei, et fratres mei, obediemus legi patrum nostrorum:
text_pt: Para andares pelos caminhos dos bons, e te conservares nas veredas dos justos.
text_el: κἀγὼ καὶ οἱ υἱοί μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου πορευσόμεθα ἐν διαθήκῃ πατέρων ἡμῶν

text_en: God be merciful unto us: it is not profitable for us to forsake the law, and the justices of God :
text_la: propitius sit nobis Deus : non est nobis utile relinquere legem, et justitias Dei:
text_pt: Porque os retos habitarão a terra, e os íntegros permanecerão nela.
text_el: ἵλεως ἡμῖν καταλιπεῖν νόμον καὶ δικαιώματα

text_en: We will not hearken to the words of King Antiochus, neither will we sacrifice and transgress the commandments of our law, to go another way.
text_la: non audiemus verba regis Antiochi, nec sacrificabimus transgredientes legis nostræ mandata, ut eamus altera via.
text_pt: Mas os ímpios serão arrancados da terra, e os aleivosos serão dela exterminados.
text_el: τῶν λόγων τοῦ βασιλέως οὐκ ἀκουσόμεθα παρελθεῖν τὴν λατρείαν ἡμῶν δεξιὰν ἢ ἀριστεράν

text_en: Now as he left off speaking these words, there came a certain Jew in the sight of all to sacrifice to the idols upon the altar in the city of Modin, according to the king's commandment.
text_la: Et ut cessavit loqui verba hæc, accessit quidam Judæus in omnium oculis sacrificare idolis super aram in civitate Modin, secundum jussum regis:
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἐπαύσατο λαλῶν τοὺς λόγους τούτους προσῆλθεν ἀνὴρ Ιουδαῖος ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς πάντων θυσιάσαι ἐπὶ τοῦ βωμοῦ ἐν Μωδεϊν κατὰ τὸ πρόσταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Mathathias saw, and was grieved, and his reins trembled, and his wrath was kindled according to the judgment of the law, and running upon him he slew him upon the altar :
text_la: et vidit Mathathias, et doluit, et contremuerunt renes ejus, et accensus est furor ejus secundum judicium legis, et insiliens trucidavit eum super aram:
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ματταθιας καὶ ἐζήλωσεν καὶ ἐτρόμησαν οἱ νεφροὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν θυμὸν κατὰ τὸ κρίμα καὶ δραμὼν ἔσφαξεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν βωμόν

text_en: Moreover the man whom King Antiochus had sent, who compelled them to sacrifice , he slew at the same time, and pulled down the altar ,
text_la: sed et virum, quem rex Antiochus miserat, qui cogebat immolare, occidit in ipso tempore, et aram destruxit:
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἄνδρα τοῦ βασιλέως τὸν ἀναγκάζοντα θύειν ἀπέκτεινεν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καὶ τὸν βωμὸν καθεῖλεν

text_en: and showed zeal for the law, as Phinees did by Zamri, the son of Salomi.
text_la: et zelatus est legem, sicut fecit Phinees Zamri filio Salomi.
text_el: καὶ ἐζήλωσεν τῷ νόμῳ καθὼς ἐποίησεν Φινεες τῷ Ζαμβρι υἱῷ Σαλωμ

text_en: And Mathathias cried out in the city with a loud voice, saying: Every one that has zeal for the law, and maintains the testament, let him follow me.
text_la: Et exclamavit Mathathias voce magna in civitate, dicens : Omnis qui zelum habet legis, statuens testamentum, exeat post me.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέκραξεν Ματταθιας ἐν τῇ πόλει φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων πᾶς ὁ ζηλῶν τῷ νόμῳ καὶ ἱστῶν διαθήκην ἐξελθέτω ὀπίσω μου

text_en: So he and his sons fled into the mountains, and left all that they had in the city.
text_la: Et fugit ipse, et filii ejus in montes, et reliquerunt quæcumque habebant in civitate.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγεν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὄρη καὶ ἐγκατέλιπον ὅσα εἶχον ἐν τῇ πόλει

text_en: Then many that sought after judgment, and justice , went down into the desert ,
text_la: Tunc descenderunt multi quærentes judicium, et justitiam, in desertum:
text_el: τότε κατέβησαν πολλοὶ ζητοῦντες δικαιοσύνην καὶ κρίμα εἰς τὴν ἔρημον καθίσαι ἐκεῖ

text_en: and they abode there, they and their children, and their wives, and their cattle: because afflictions increased upon them.
text_la: et sederunt ibi ipsi, et filii eorum, et mulieres eorum, et pecora eorum : quoniam inundaverunt super eos mala.
text_el: αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐσκληρύνθη ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὰ κακά

text_en: And it was told to the king's men , and to the army that was in Jerusalem , in the city of David, that certain men , who had broken the king's commandment, had gone away into the secret places in the wilderness , and that many had gone after them.
text_la: Et renuntiatum est viris regis, et exercitui qui erat in Jerusalem civitate David, quoniam discessissent viri quidam, qui dissipaverunt mandatum regis, in loca occulta in deserto, et abiissent post illos multi.
text_el: καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ταῖς δυνάμεσιν αἳ ἦσαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ πόλει Δαυιδ ὅτι κατέβησαν ἄνδρες οἵτινες διεσκέδασαν τὴν ἐντολὴν τοῦ βασιλέως εἰς τοὺς κρύφους ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And forthwith they went out towards them, and made war against them on the sabbath day .
text_la: Et statim perrexerunt ad eos, et constituerunt adversus eos prælium in die sabbatorum,
text_el: καὶ ἔδραμον ὀπίσω αὐτῶν πολλοὶ καὶ κατελάβοντο αὐτοὺς καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ συνεστήσαντο πρὸς αὐτοὺς πόλεμον ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων

text_en: And they said to them: Do you still resist? Come forth, and do according to the edict of King Antiochus, and you shall live.
text_la: et dixerunt ad eos : Resistitis et nunc adhuc? exite, et facite secundum verbum regis Antiochi, et vivetis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτούς ἕως τοῦ νῦν ἐξελθόντες ποιήσατε κατὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ζήσεσθε

text_en: And they said: We will not come forth, neither will we obey the king's edict, to profane the sabbath day .
text_la: Et dixerunt : Non exibimus, neque faciemus verbum regis, ut polluamus diem sabbatorum.
text_el: καὶ εἶπον οὐκ ἐξελευσόμεθα οὐδὲ ποιήσομεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως βεβηλῶσαι τὴν ἡμέραν τῶν σαββάτων

text_en: And they made haste to give them battle.
text_la: Et concitaverunt adversus eos prælium.
text_el: καὶ ἐτάχυναν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς πόλεμον

text_en: But they answered them not, neither did they cast a stone at them, nor stopped up the secret places,
text_la: Et non responderunt eis, nec lapidem miserunt in eos, nec oppilaverunt loca occulta,
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτοῖς οὐδὲ λίθον ἐνετίναξαν αὐτοῖς οὐδὲ ἐνέφραξαν τοὺς κρύφους

text_en: saying: Let us all die in our innocency: and heaven and earth shall be witnesses for us, that you put us to death wrongfully.
text_la: dicentes : Moriamur omnes in simplicitate nostra : et testes erunt super nos cælum et terra, quod injuste perditis nos.
text_el: λέγοντες ἀποθάνωμεν πάντες ἐν τῇ ἁπλότητι ἡμῶν μαρτυρεῖ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ ὅτι ἀκρίτως ἀπόλλυτε ἡμᾶς

text_en: So they gave them battle on the sabbath : and they were slain, with their wives, and their children, and their cattle, to the number of a thousand persons.
text_la: Et intulerunt illis bellum sabbatis : et mortui sunt ipsi, et uxores eorum, et filii eorum, et pecora eorum usque ad mille animas hominum.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐν πολέμῳ τοῖς σάββασιν καὶ ἀπέθανον αὐτοὶ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν ἕως χιλίων ψυχῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And Mathathias and his friends heard of it, and they mourned for them exceedingly.
text_la: Et cognovit Mathathias et amici ejus, et luctum habuerunt super eos valde.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Ματταθιας καὶ οἱ φίλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπένθησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς σφόδρα

text_en: And every man said to his neighbour: If we shall all do as our brethren have done, and not fight against the heathens for our lives, and our justifications, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.
text_la: Et dixit vir proximo suo : Si omnes fecerimus sicut fratres nostri fecerunt, et non pugnaverimus adversus gentes pro animabus nostris et justificationibus nostris, nunc citius disperdent nos a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀνὴρ τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἐὰν πάντες ποιήσωμεν ὡς οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν ἐποίησαν καὶ μὴ πολεμήσωμεν πρὸς τὰ ἔθνη ὑπὲρ τῆς ψυχῆς ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν δικαιωμάτων ἡμῶν νῦν τάχιον ὀλεθρεύσουσιν ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And they determined in that day, saying: Whosoever shall come up against us to fight on the sabbath day , we will fight against him: and we will not all die, as our brethren that were slain in the secret places.
text_la: Et cogitaverunt in die illa, dicentes : Omnis homo, quicumque venerit ad nos in bello die sabbatorum, pugnemus adversus eum : et non moriemur omnes, sicut mortui sunt fratres nostri in occultis.
text_el: καὶ ἐβουλεύσαντο τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγοντες πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἐὰν ἔλθῃ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς εἰς πόλεμον τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων πολεμήσωμεν κατέναντι αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν πάντες καθὼς ἀπέθανον οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν ἐν τοῖς κρύφοις

text_en: Then was assembled to them the congregation of the Assideans , the stoutest of Israel , every one that had a good will for the law.
text_la: Tunc congregata est ad eos synagoga Assidæorum fortis viribus ex Israël, omnis voluntarius in lege:
text_el: τότε συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς συναγωγὴ Ασιδαίων ἰσχυροὶ δυνάμει ἀπὸ Ισραηλ πᾶς ὁ ἑκουσιαζόμενος τῷ νόμῳ

text_en: And all they that fled from the evils , joined themselves to them, and were a support to them.
text_la: et omnes, qui fugiebant a malis, additi sunt ad eos, et facti sunt illis ad firmamentum.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ φυγαδεύοντες ἀπὸ τῶν κακῶν προσετέθησαν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτοῖς εἰς στήριγμα

text_en: And they gathered an army, and slew the sinners in their wrath , and the wicked men in their indignation: and the rest fled to the nations for safety.
text_la: Et collegerunt exercitum, et percusserunt peccatores in ira sua, et viros iniquos in indignatione sua : et ceteri fugerunt ad nationes, ut evaderent.
text_el: καὶ συνεστήσαντο δύναμιν καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἁμαρτωλοὺς ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτῶν καὶ ἄνδρας ἀνόμους ἐν θυμῷ αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἔφυγον εἰς τὰ ἔθνη σωθῆναι

text_en: And Mathathias and his friends went round about, and they threw down the altars :
text_la: Et circuivit Mathathias et amici ejus, et destruxerunt aras:
text_el: καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν Ματταθιας καὶ οἱ φίλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ καθεῖλον τοὺς βωμοὺς

text_en: And they circumcised all the children whom they found in the confines of Israel that were uncircumcised: and they did valiantly .
text_la: et circumciderunt pueros incircumcisos quotquot invenerunt in finibus Israël : et in fortitudine.
text_el: καὶ περιέτεμον τὰ παιδάρια τὰ ἀπερίτμητα ὅσα εὗρον ἐν ὁρίοις Ισραηλ ἐν ἰσχύι

text_en: And they pursued after the children of pride , and the work prospered in their hands:
text_la: Et persecuti sunt filios superbiæ, et prosperatum est opus in manibus eorum:
text_el: καὶ ἐδίωξαν τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ὑπερηφανίας καὶ κατευοδώθη τὸ ἔργον ἐν χειρὶ αὐτῶν

text_en: And they recovered the law out of the hands of the nations, and out of the hands of the kings: and they yielded not the horn to the sinner.
text_la: et obtinuerunt legem de manibus gentium, et de manibus regum, et non dederant cornu peccatori.
text_el: καὶ ἀντελάβοντο τοῦ νόμου ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν ἐθνῶν καὶ τῶν βασιλέων καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκαν κέρας τῷ ἁμαρτωλῷ

text_en: Now the days drew near that Mathathias should die, and he said to his sons: Now has pride and chastisement gotten strength, and the time of destruction, and the wrath of indignation:
text_la: Et appropinquaverunt dies Mathathiæ moriendi, et dixit filiis suis : Nunc confortata est superbia, et castigatio, et tempus eversionis, et ira indignationis.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισαν αἱ ἡμέραι Ματταθιου ἀποθανεῖν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ νῦν ἐστηρίσθη ὑπερηφανία καὶ ἐλεγμὸς καὶ καιρὸς καταστροφῆς καὶ ὀργὴ θυμοῦ

text_en: Now, therefore, O my sons, be zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.
text_la: Nunc ergo, o filii, æmulatores estote legis, et date animas vestras pro testamento patrum vestrorum,
text_el: νῦν τέκνα ζηλώσατε τῷ νόμῳ καὶ δότε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ὑπὲρ διαθήκης πατέρων ἡμῶν

text_en: And call to remembrance the works of the fathers, which they have done in their generations : and you shall receive great glory , and an everlasting name .
text_la: et mementote operum patrum, quæ fecerunt in generationibus suis : et accipietis gloriam magnam, et nomen æternum.
text_el: καὶ μνήσθητε τὰ ἔργα τῶν πατέρων ἃ ἐποίησαν ἐν ταῖς γενεαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ δέξασθε δόξαν μεγάλην καὶ ὄνομα αἰώνιον

text_en: Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was reputed to him unto justice ?
text_la: Abraham nonne in tentatione inventus est fidelis, et reputatum est ei ad justitiam?
text_el: Αβρααμ οὐχὶ ἐν πειρασμῷ εὑρέθη πιστός καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην

text_en: Joseph , in the time of his distress, kept the commandment, and he was made lord of Egypt .
text_la: Joseph in tempore angustiæ suæ custodivit mandatum, et factus est dominus Ægypti.
text_el: Ιωσηφ ἐν καιρῷ στενοχωρίας αὐτοῦ ἐφύλαξεν ἐντολὴν καὶ ἐγένετο κύριος Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Phinees, our father, by being fervent in the zeal of God , received the covenant of an everlasting priesthood .
text_la: Phinees pater noster, zelando zelum Dei, accepit testamentum sacerdotii æterni.
text_el: Φινεες ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαι ζῆλον ἔλαβεν διαθήκην ἱερωσύνης αἰωνίας

text_en: Jesus , whilst he fulfilled the word, was made ruler in Israel .
text_la: Jesus dum implevit verbum, factus est dux in Israël.
text_el: Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῷ πληρῶσαι λόγον ἐγένετο κριτὴς ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Caleb , for bearing witness before the congregation, received an inheritance.
text_la: Caleb dum testificatur in ecclesia, accepit hæreditatem.
text_el: Χαλεβ ἐν τῷ μαρτύρασθαι ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ ἔλαβεν γῆς κληρονομίαν

text_en: David , by his mercy, obtained the throne of an everlasting kingdom.
text_la: David in sua misericordia consecutus est sedem regni in sæcula.
text_el: Δαυιδ ἐν τῷ ἐλέει αὐτοῦ ἐκληρονόμησεν θρόνον βασιλείας εἰς αἰῶνας

text_en: Elias , while he was full of zeal for the law, was taken up into heaven .
text_la: Elias, dum zelat zelum legis, receptus est in cælum.
text_el: Ηλιας ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαι ζῆλον νόμου ἀνελήμφθη εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν

text_en: Ananias and Azarias and Misael, by believing, were delivered out of the flame.
text_la: Ananias et Azarias et Misaël credentes, liberati sunt de flamma.
text_el: Ανανιας Αζαριας Μισαηλ πιστεύσαντες ἐσώθησαν ἐκ φλογός

text_en: Daniel , in his innocency, was delivered out of the mouth of the lions.
text_la: Daniel in sua simplicitate liberatus est de ore leonum.
text_el: Δανιηλ ἐν τῇ ἁπλότητι αὐτοῦ ἐρρύσθη ἐκ στόματος λεόντων

text_en: And thus consider, through all generations : that none that trust in him, fail in strength.
text_la: Et ita cogitate per generationem et generationem : quia omnes qui sperant in eum, non infirmantur.
text_el: καὶ οὕτως ἐννοήθητε κατὰ γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν ὅτι πάντες οἱ ἐλπίζοντες ἐπ' αὐτὸν οὐκ ἀσθενήσουσιν

text_en: And fear not the words of a sinful man , for his glory is dung and worms:
text_la: Et a verbis viri peccatoris ne timueritis, quia gloria ejus stercus et vermis est:
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ λόγων ἀνδρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ μὴ φοβηθῆτε ὅτι ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ εἰς κόπρια καὶ εἰς σκώληκας

text_en: Today he is lifted up, and tomorrow he shall not be found, because he is returned into his earth and his thought has come to nothing.
text_la: hodie extollitur, et cras non invenietur : quia conversus est in terram suam, et cogitatio ejus periit.
text_el: σήμερον ἐπαρθήσεται καὶ αὔριον οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ὅτι ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν χοῦν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ διαλογισμὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπολεῖται

text_en: You, therefore, my sons, take courage , and behave manfully in the law: for by it you shall be glorious .
text_la: Vos ergo filii, confortamini, et viriliter agite in lege : quia in ipsa gloriosi eritis.
text_el: τέκνα ἀνδρίζεσθε καὶ ἰσχύσατε ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ δοξασθήσεσθε

text_en: And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel: give ear to him always, and he shall be a father to you.
text_la: Et ecce Simon frater vester, scio quod vir consilii est : ipsum audite semper, et ipse erit vobis pater.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ Συμεων ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν οἶδα ὅτι ἀνὴρ βουλῆς ἐστιν αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτὸς ἔσται ὑμῶν πατήρ

text_en: And Judas Machabeus , who is valiant and strong from his youth up, let him be the leader of your army, and he shall manage the war of the people.
text_la: Et Judas Machabæus, fortis viribus a juventute sua, sit vobis princeps militiæ, et ipse aget bellum populi.
text_el: καὶ Ιουδας Μακκαβαῖος ἰσχυρὸς δυνάμει ἐκ νεότητος αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς ἔσται ὑμῖν ἄρχων στρατιᾶς καὶ πολεμήσει πόλεμον λαῶν

text_en: And you shall take to you all that observe the law: and revenge the wrong of your people.
text_la: Et adducetis ad vos omnes factores legis : et vindicate vindictam populi vestri.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς προσάξετε πρὸς ὑμᾶς πάντας τοὺς ποιητὰς τοῦ νόμου καὶ ἐκδικήσατε ἐκδίκησιν τοῦ λαοῦ ὑμῶν

text_en: Render to the Gentiles their reward, and take heed to the precepts of the law.
text_la: Retribuite retributionem gentibus, et intendite in præceptum legis.
text_el: ἀνταπόδοτε ἀνταπόδομα τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ προσέχετε εἰς πρόσταγμα τοῦ νόμου

text_en: And he blessed them, and was joined to his fathers.
text_la: Et benedixit eos, et appositus est ad patres suos.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he died in the hundred and forty-sixth year: and he was buried by his sons in the sepulchres of his fathers, in Modin, and all Israel mourned for him with great mourning.
text_la: Et defunctus est anno centesimo et quadragesimo sexto : et sepultus est a filiis suis in sepulchris patrum suorum in Modin, et planxerunt eum omnis Israël planctu magno.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ἐν τῷ ἕκτῳ καὶ τεσσαρακοστῷ καὶ ἑκατοστῷ ἔτει καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν τάφοις πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἐν Μωδεϊν καὶ ἐκόψαντο αὐτὸν πᾶς Ισραηλ κοπετὸν μέγαν

text_en: Then his son Judas, called Machabeus , rose up in his stead.
text_la: Et surrexit Judas, qui vocabatur Machabæus, filius ejus, pro eo:
text_pt: Filho meu, não te esqueças da minha lei, e o teu coração guarde os meus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ιουδας ὁ καλούμενος Μακκαβαῖος υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all his brethren helped him, and all they that had joined themselves to his father, and they fought with cheerfulness the battle of Israel .
text_la: et adjuvabant eum omnes fratres ejus, et universi qui se conjunxerant patri ejus, et præliabantur prælium Israël cum lætitia.
text_pt: Porque eles aumentarão os teus dias e te acrescentarão anos de vida e paz.
text_el: καὶ ἐβοήθουν αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες ὅσοι ἐκολλήθησαν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπολέμουν τὸν πόλεμον Ισραηλ μετ' εὐφροσύνης

text_en: And he got his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant, and girt his warlike armour about him in battles, and protected the camp with his sword.
text_la: Et dilatavit gloriam populo suo, et induit se loricam sicut gigas, et succinxit se arma bellica sua in præliis, et protegebat castra gladio suo.
text_pt: Não te desamparem a benignidade e a fidelidade; ata-as ao teu pescoço; escreve-as na tábua do teu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλάτυνεν δόξαν τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνεδύσατο θώρακα ὡς γίγας καὶ συνεζώσατο τὰ σκεύη τὰ πολεμικὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ πολέμους συνεστήσατο σκεπάζων παρεμβολὴν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: In his acts he was like a lion, and like a lion's whelp roaring for his prey.
text_la: Similis factus est leoni in operibus suis, et sicut catulus leonis rugiens in venatione.
text_pt: E acharás graça e bom entendimento aos olhos de Deus e do homem.
text_el: καὶ ὡμοιώθη λέοντι ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ὡς σκύμνος ἐρευγόμενος εἰς θήραν

text_en: And he pursued the wicked and sought them out, and them that troubled his people he burnt with fire:
text_la: Et persecutus est iniquos perscrutans eos : et qui conturbabant populum suum, eos succendit flammis :
text_pt: Confia no Senhor de todo o teu coração, e não te estribes no teu próprio entendimento.
text_el: καὶ ἐδίωξεν ἀνόμους ἐξερευνῶν καὶ τοὺς ταράσσοντας τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἐφλόγισεν

text_en: And his enemies were driven away for fear of him, and all the workers of iniquity were troubled: and salvation prospered in his hand.
text_la: et repulsi sunt inimici ejus præ timore ejus, et omnes operarii iniquitatis conturbati sunt : et directa est salus in manu ejus.
text_pt: Reconhece-o em todos os teus caminhos, e ele endireitará as tuas veredas.
text_el: καὶ συνεστάλησαν ἄνομοι ἀπὸ τοῦ φόβου αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐργάται τῆς ἀνομίας συνεταράχθησαν καὶ εὐοδώθη σωτηρία ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he grieved many kings, and made Jacob glad with his works, and his memory is blessed for ever.
text_la: Et exacerbabat reges multos, et lætificabat Jacob in operibus suis, et in sæculum memoria ejus in benedictione.
text_pt: Não sejas sábio a teus próprios olhos; teme ao Senhor e aparta-te do mal.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίκρανεν βασιλεῖς πολλοὺς καὶ εὔφρανεν τὸν Ιακωβ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτοῦ εἰς εὐλογίαν

text_en: And he went through the cities of Juda , and destroyed the wicked out of them, and turned away wrath from Israel .
text_la: Et perambulavit civitates Juda, et perdidit impios ex eis, et avertit iram ab Israël.
text_pt: Isto será saúde para o teu âmago, e medula para os teus ossos.
text_el: καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐξωλέθρευσεν ἀσεβεῖς ἐξ αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν ὀργὴν ἀπὸ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he was renowned even to the utmost part of the earth, and he gathered them that were perishing.
text_la: Et nominatus est usque ad novissimum terræ, et congregavit pereuntes.
text_pt: Honra ao Senhor com os teus bens, e com a primeira parte de todos os teus ganhos;
text_el: καὶ ὠνομάσθη ἕως ἐσχάτου γῆς καὶ συνήγαγεν ἀπολλυμένους

text_en: And Apollonius gathered together the Gentiles , and a numerous and great army from Samaria , to make war against Israel .
text_la: Et congregavit Apollonius gentes, et a Samaria virtutem multam et magnam ad bellandum contra Israël.
text_pt: E se encherão os teus celeiros, e transbordarão de vinho os teus lagares.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν Ἀπολλώνιος ἔθνη καὶ ἀπὸ Σαμαρείας δύναμιν μεγάλην τοῦ πολεμῆσαι πρὸς τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Judas understood it, and went forth to meet him: and he overthrew him, and killed him: and many fell down slain, and the rest fled away.
text_la: Et cognovit Judas, et exiit obviam illi : et percussit, et occidit illum : et ceciderunt vulnerati multi, et reliqui fugerunt.
text_pt: Filho meu, não rejeites a correção do Senhor, nem te enojes da sua repreensão.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Ιουδας καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι πολλοί καὶ οἱ ἐπίλοιποι ἔφυγον

text_en: And he took their spoils, and Judas took the sword of Apollonius, and fought with it all his lifetime.
text_la: Et accepit spolia eorum : et gladium Apollonii abstulit Judas, et erat pugnans in eo omnibus diebus.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor repreende aquele a quem ama, assim como o pai ao filho a quem quer bem.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν Ἀπολλωνίου ἔλαβεν Ιουδας καὶ ἦν πολεμῶν ἐν αὐτῇ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: And Seron, captain of the army of Syria , heard that Judas had assembled a company of the faithful, and a congregation with him,
text_la: Et audivit Seron princeps exercitus Syriæ, quod congregavit Judas congregationem fidelium, et ecclesiam secum,
text_pt: Bem-aventurado o homem que acha sabedoria, e o homem que adquire conhecimento;
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σήρων ὁ ἄρχων τῆς δυνάμεως Συρίας ὅτι ἤθροισεν Ιουδας ἄθροισμα καὶ ἐκκλησίαν πιστῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκπορευομένων εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: and he said I will get me a name , and will be glorified in the kingdom, and will overthrow Judas , and those that are with him, that have despised the edict of the king.
text_la: et ait : Faciam mihi nomen, et glorificabor in regno, et debellabo Judam, et eos qui cum ipso sunt, qui spernebant verbum regis.
text_pt: Porque é melhor a sua mercadoria do que artigos de prata, e maior o seu lucro que o ouro mais fino.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ποιήσω ἐμαυτῷ ὄνομα καὶ δοξασθήσομαι ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ καὶ πολεμήσω τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ τοὺς σὺν αὐτῷ τοὺς ἐξουδενοῦντας τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And he made himself ready; and the host of the wicked went up with him, strong succours, to be revenged of the children of Israel .
text_la: Et præparavit se: et ascenderunt cum eo castra impiorum fortes auxiliarii ut facerent vindictam in filios Israël.
text_pt: Mais preciosa é do que os rubis, e tudo o que mais possas desejar não se pode comparar a ela.
text_el: καὶ προσέθετο καὶ ἀνέβη μετ' αὐτοῦ παρεμβολὴ ἀσεβῶν ἰσχυρὰ βοηθῆσαι αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι τὴν ἐκδίκησιν ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And they approached even as far as Bethoron: and Judas went forth to meet him, with a small company.
text_la: Et appropinquaverunt usque ad Bethoron: et exivit Judas obviam illi cum paucis.
text_pt: Vida longa de dias está na sua mão direita; e na esquerda, riquezas e honra.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισεν ἕως ἀναβάσεως Βαιθωρων καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιουδας εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ ὀλιγοστός

text_en: But when they saw the army coming to meet them, they said to Judas : How shall we, being few, be able to fight against so great a multitude, and so strong, and we are ready to faint with fasting today?
text_la: Ut autem viderunt exercitum venientem sibi obviam, dixerunt Judæ : Quomodo poterimus pauci pugnare contra multitudinem tantam, et tam fortem, et nos fatigati sumus jejunio hodie?
text_pt: Os seus caminhos são caminhos de delícias, e todas as suas veredas de paz.
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἶδον τὴν παρεμβολὴν ἐρχομένην εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῶν εἶπον τῷ Ιουδα τί δυνησόμεθα ὀλιγοστοὶ ὄντες πολεμῆσαι πρὸς πλῆθος τοσοῦτο ἰσχυρόν καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐκλελύμεθα ἀσιτοῦντες σήμερον

text_en: And Judas said: It is an easy matter for many to be shut up in the hands of a few: and there is no difference in the sight of the God of heaven to deliver with a great multitude, or with a small company:
text_la: Et ait Judas : Facile est concludi multos in manus paucorum : et non est differentia in conspectu Dei cæli liberare in multis, et in paucis:
text_pt: É árvore de vida para os que dela tomam, e são bem-aventurados todos os que a retêm.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδας εὔκοπόν ἐστιν συγκλεισθῆναι πολλοὺς ἐν χερσὶν ὀλίγων καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν διαφορὰ ἐναντίον τοῦ οὐρανοῦ σῴζειν ἐν πολλοῖς ἢ ἐν ὀλίγοις

text_en: For the success of war is not in the multitude of the army, but strength comes from heaven .
text_la: quoniam non in multitudine exercitus victoria belli, sed de cælo fortitudo est.
text_pt: O Senhor, com sabedoria fundou a terra; com entendimento preparou os céus.
text_el: ὅτι οὐκ ἐν πλήθει δυνάμεως νίκη πολέμου ἐστίν ἀλλ' ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἡ ἰσχύς

text_en: They come against us with an insolent multitude, and with pride , to destroy us, and our wives, and our children, and to take our spoils.
text_la: Ipsi veniunt ad nos in multitudine contumaci, et superbia, ut disperdant nos, et uxores nostras, et filios nostros, et ut spolient nos:
text_pt: Pelo seu conhecimento se fenderam os abismos, e as nuvens destilam o orvalho.
text_el: αὐτοὶ ἔρχονται ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν πλήθει ὕβρεως καὶ ἀνομίας τοῦ ἐξᾶραι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας ἡμῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα ἡμῶν τοῦ σκυλεῦσαι ἡμᾶς

text_en: But we will fight for our lives, and our laws:
text_la: nos vero pugnabimus pro animabus nostris, et legibus nostris:
text_pt: Filho meu, não se apartem estas coisas dos teus olhos: guarda a verdadeira sabedoria e o bom siso;
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ πολεμοῦμεν περὶ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν νομίμων ἡμῶν

text_en: And the Lord himself will overthrow them before our face, but as for you, fear them not.
text_la: et ipse Dominus conteret eos ante faciem nostram: vos autem ne timueritis eos.
text_pt: Porque serão vida para a tua alma, e adorno ao teu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς συντρίψει αὐτοὺς πρὸ προσώπου ἡμῶν ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ φοβεῖσθε ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And as soon as he had made an end of speaking, he rushed suddenly upon them: and Seron, and his host were overthrown before him:
text_la: Ut cessavit autem loqui, insiluit in eos subito : et contritus est Seron et exercitus ejus in conspectu ipsius:
text_pt: Então andarás confiante pelo teu caminho, e o teu pé não tropeçará.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπαύσατο λαλῶν ἐνήλατο εἰς αὐτοὺς ἄφνω καὶ συνετρίβη Σήρων καὶ ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he pursued him by the descent of Bethoron, even to the plain, and there fell of them eight hundred men , and the rest fled into the land of the Philistines .
text_la: et persecutus est eum in descensu Bethoron usque in campum, et ceciderunt ex eis octingenti viri, reliqui autem fugerunt in terram Philisthiim.
text_pt: Quando te deitares, não temerás; ao contrário, o teu sono será suave ao te deitares.
text_el: καὶ ἐδίωκον αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ καταβάσει Βαιθωρων ἕως τοῦ πεδίου καὶ ἔπεσον ἀπ' αὐτῶν εἰς ἄνδρας ὀκτακοσίους οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἔφυγον εἰς γῆν Φυλιστιιμ

text_en: And the fear of Judas , and of his brethren, and the dread of them, fell upon all the nations round about them.
text_la: Et cecidit timor Judæ ac fratrum ejus, et formido super omnes gentes in circuitu eorum:
text_pt: Não temas o pavor repentino, nem a investida dos perversos quando vier.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ φόβος Ιουδου καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ πτόη ἐπέπιπτεν ἐπὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And his fame came to the king, and all nations told of the battles of Judas .
text_la: et pervenit ad regem nomen ejus, et de præliis Judæ narrabant omnes gentes.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor será a tua esperança; guardará os teus pés de serem capturados.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισεν ἕως τοῦ βασιλέως τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὑπὲρ τῶν παρατάξεων Ιουδου ἐξηγεῖτο τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: Now when King Antiochus heard these words, he was angry in his mind: and he sent, and gathered the forces of all his kingdom, an exceeding strong army.
text_la: Ut audivit autem rex Antiochus sermones istos, iratus est animo : et misit, et congregavit exercitum universi regni sui, castra fortia valde:
text_pt: Não deixes de fazer bem a quem o merece, estando em tuas mãos a capacidade de fazê-lo.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀντίοχος τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὠργίσθη θυμῷ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν καὶ συνήγαγεν τὰς δυνάμεις πάσας τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ παρεμβολὴν ἰσχυρὰν σφόδρα

text_en: And he opened his treasury, and gave out pay to the army for a year: and he commanded them, that they should be ready for all things.
text_la: et aperuit ærarium suum, et dedit stipendia exercitui in annum : et mandavit illis ut essent parati ad omnia.
text_pt: Não digas ao teu próximo: Vai, e volta amanhã que to darei, se já o tens contigo.
text_el: καὶ ἤνοιξεν τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν ὀψώνια ταῖς δυνάμεσιν εἰς ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς εἶναι ἑτοίμους εἰς πᾶσαν χρείαν

text_en: And he perceived that the money of his treasures failed, and that the tributes of the country were small, because of the dissension, and the evil that he had brought upon the land, that he might take away the laws of old times:
text_la: Et vidit quod defecit pecunia de thesauris suis, et tributa regionis modica propter dissensionem et plagam quam fecit in terra, ut tolleret legitima, quæ erant a primis diebus:
text_pt: Não maquines o mal contra o teu próximo, pois que habita contigo confiadamente.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν τὸ ἀργύριον ἐκ τῶν θησαυρῶν καὶ οἱ φόροι τῆς χώρας ὀλίγοι χάριν τῆς διχοστασίας καὶ πληγῆς ἧς κατεσκεύασεν ἐν τῇ γῇ τοῦ ἆραι τὰ νόμιμα ἃ ἦσαν ἀφ' ἡμερῶν τῶν πρώτων

text_en: And he feared that he should not have as formerly enough for charges and gifts, which he had given before with a liberal hand: for he had abounded more than the kings that had been before him.
text_la: et timuit ne non haberet ut semel et bis, in sumptus et donaria, quæ dederat ante larga manu : et abundaverat super reges qui ante eum fuerant.
text_pt: Não contendas com alguém sem causa, se não te fez nenhum mal.
text_el: καὶ εὐλαβήθη μὴ οὐκ ἔχῃ ὡς ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς εἰς τὰς δαπάνας καὶ τὰ δόματα ἃ ἐδίδου ἔμπροσθεν δαψιλῇ χειρὶ καὶ ἐπερίσσευσεν ὑπὲρ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τοὺς ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: And he was greatly perplexed in mind, and purposed to go into Persia, and to take tributes of the countries, and to gather much money.
text_la: Et consternatus erat animo valde, et cogitavit ire in Persidem, et accipere tributa regionum, et congregare argentum multum.
text_pt: Não tenhas inveja do homem violento, nem escolhas nenhum dos seus caminhos.
text_el: καὶ ἠπορεῖτο τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ σφόδρα καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο τοῦ πορευθῆναι εἰς τὴν Περσίδα καὶ λαβεῖν τοὺς φόρους τῶν χωρῶν καὶ συναγαγεῖν ἀργύριον πολύ

text_en: And he left Lysias, a nobleman of the blood royal to oversee the affairs of the kingdom from the river Euphrates even to the river of Egypt :
text_la: Et reliquit Lysiam hominem nobilem de genere regali, super negotia regia, a flumine Euphrate usque ad flumen Ægypti,
text_pt: Porque o perverso é abominável ao Senhor, mas com os sinceros ele tem intimidade.
text_el: καὶ κατέλιπεν Λυσίαν ἄνθρωπον ἔνδοξον καὶ ἀπὸ γένους τῆς βασιλείας ἐπὶ τῶν πραγμάτων τοῦ βασιλέως ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου καὶ ἕως ὁρίων Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And to bring up his son, Antiochus, till he came again.
text_la: et ut nutriret Antiochum filium suum, donec rediret.
text_pt: A maldição do Senhor habita na casa do ímpio, mas a habitação dos justos abençoará.
text_el: καὶ τρέφειν Ἀντίοχον τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἕως τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι αὐτόν

text_en: And he delivered to him half the army, and the elephants: and he gave him charge concerning all that he would have done, and concerning the inhabitants of Judea , and Jerusalem .
text_la: Et tradidit ei medium exercitum, et elephantos : et mandavit ei de omnibus quæ volebat, et de inhabitantibus Judæam, et Jerusalem:
text_pt: Certamente ele escarnecerá dos escarnecedores, mas dará graça aos mansos.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτῷ τὰς ἡμίσεις τῶν δυνάμεων καὶ τοὺς ἐλέφαντας καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ περὶ πάντων ὧν ἠβούλετο καὶ περὶ τῶν κατοικούντων τὴν Ιουδαίαν καὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And that he should send an army against them to destroy and root out the strength of Israel , and the remnant of Jerusalem , and to take away the memory of them from that place.
text_la: et ut mitteret ad eos exercitum ad conterendam et extirpandam virtutem Israël, et reliquias Jerusalem, et auferendam memoriam eorum de loco:
text_pt: Os sábios herdarão honra, mas os loucos tomam sobre si vergonha.
text_el: ἀποστεῖλαι ἐπ' αὐτοὺς δύναμιν τοῦ ἐκτρῖψαι καὶ ἐξᾶραι τὴν ἰσχὺν Ισραηλ καὶ τὸ κατάλειμμα Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἆραι τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ τόπου

text_en: And that he should settle strangers, to dwell in all their coasts, and divide their land by lot.
text_la: et ut constitueret habitatores filios alienigenas in omnibus finibus eorum, et sorte distribueret terram eorum.
text_el: καὶ κατοικίσαι υἱοὺς ἀλλογενεῖς ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν καὶ κατακληροδοτῆσαι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: So the king took the half of the army that remained, and went forth from Antioch , the chief city of his kingdom, in the hundred and forty-seventh year: and he passed over the river Euphrates, and went through the higher countries.
text_la: Et rex assumpsit partem exercitus residui, et exivit ab Antiochia civitate regni sui anno centesimo et quadragesimo septimo : et transfretavit Euphraten flumen, et perambulabat superiores regiones.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς παρέλαβεν τὰς ἡμίσεις τῶν δυνάμεων τὰς καταλειφθείσας καὶ ἀπῆρεν ἀπὸ Ἀντιοχείας ἀπὸ πόλεως βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἔτους ἑβδόμου καὶ τεσσαρακοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ καὶ διεπέρασεν τὸν Εὐφράτην ποταμὸν καὶ διεπορεύετο τὰς ἐπάνω χώρας

text_en: Then Lysias chose Ptolemee, the son of Dorymenus, and Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king's friends.
text_la: Et elegit Lysias Ptolemæum filium Dorymini, et Nicanorem, et Gorgiam, viros potentes ex amicis regis:
text_el: καὶ ἐπέλεξεν Λυσίας Πτολεμαῖον τὸν Δορυμένους καὶ Νικάνορα καὶ Γοργίαν ἄνδρας δυνατοὺς τῶν φίλων τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And he sent with them forty thousand men , and seven thousand horsemen: to go into the land of Juda , and to destroy it, according to the king's orders.
text_la: et misit cum eis quadraginta millia virorum, et septem millia equitum, ut venirent in terram Juda, et disperderent eam secundum verbum regis.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν μετ' αὐτῶν τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάδας ἀνδρῶν καὶ ἑπτακισχιλίαν ἵππον τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ καταφθεῖραι αὐτὴν κατὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: So they went forth with all their power, and came, and pitched near Emmaus, in the plain country.
text_la: Et processerunt cum universa virtute sua, et venerunt, et applicuerunt Emmaum in terra campestri.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν σὺν πάσῃ τῇ δυνάμει αὐτῶν καὶ ἦλθον καὶ παρενέβαλον πλησίον Αμμαους ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πεδινῇ

text_en: And the merchants of the countries heard the fame of them: and they took silver and gold in abundance, and servants: and they came into the camp, to buy the children of Israel for slaves: and there were joined to them the forces of Syria , and of the land of the strangers.
text_la: Et audierunt mercatores regionum nomen eorum : et acceperunt argentum, et aurum multum valde, et pueros, et venerunt in castra ut acciperent filios Israël in servos, et additi sunt ad eos exercitus Syriæ, et terræ alienigenarum.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς χώρας τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν καὶ ἔλαβον ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον πολὺ σφόδρα καὶ πέδας καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν τοῦ λαβεῖν τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ εἰς παῖδας καὶ προσετέθησαν πρὸς αὐτοὺς δύναμις Συρίας καὶ γῆς ἀλλοφύλων

text_en: And Judas , and his brethren, saw that evils were multiplied, and that the armies approached to their borders: and they knew the orders the king had given to destroy the people, and utterly abolish them.
text_la: Et vidit Judas et fratres ejus, quia multiplicata sunt mala, et exercitus applicabant ad fines eorum : et cognoverunt verba regis, quæ mandavit populo facere in interitum et consummationem:
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιουδας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐπληθύνθη τὰ κακὰ καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις παρεμβάλλουσιν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βασιλέως οὓς ἐνετείλατο ποιῆσαι τῷ λαῷ εἰς ἀπώλειαν καὶ συντέλειαν

text_en: And they said, every man to his neighbour: Let us raise up the low condition of our people, and let us fight for our people, and our sanctuary.
text_la: et dixerunt unusquisque ad proximum suum : Erigamus dejectionem populi nostri, et pugnemus pro populo nostro, et sanctis nostris.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἀναστήσωμεν τὴν καθαίρεσιν τοῦ λαοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ πολεμήσωμεν περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And the assembly was gathered, that they might be ready for battle, and that they might pray , and ask mercy and compassion.
text_la: Et congregatus est conventus ut essent parati in prælium, et ut orarent et peterent misericordiam et miserationes.
text_el: καὶ ἠθροίσθη ἡ συναγωγὴ τοῦ εἶναι ἑτοίμους εἰς πόλεμον καὶ τοῦ προσεύξασθαι καὶ αἰτῆσαι ἔλεος καὶ οἰκτιρμούς

text_en: Now Jerusalem was not inhabited, but was like a desert : there was none of her children that went in or out: and the sanctuary was trodden down: and the children of strangers were in the castle, there was the habitation of the Gentiles : and joy was taken away from Jacob , and the pipe and harp ceased there.
text_la: Et Jerusalem non habitabatur, sed erat sicut desertum : non erat qui ingrederetur et egrederetur de natis ejus. Et sanctum conculcabatur : et filii alienigenarum erant in arce; ibi erat habitatio gentium : et ablata est voluptas a Jacob, et defecit ibi tibia et cithara.
text_el: καὶ Ιερουσαλημ ἦν ἀοίκητος ὡς ἔρημος οὐκ ἦν ὁ εἰσπορευόμενος καὶ ἐκπορευόμενος ἐκ τῶν γενημάτων αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ ἁγίασμα καταπατούμενον καὶ υἱοὶ ἀλλογενῶν ἐν τῇ ἄκρᾳ κατάλυμα τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ ἐξήρθη τέρψις ἐξ Ιακωβ καὶ ἐξέλιπεν αὐλὸς καὶ κινύρα

text_en: And they assembled together, and came to Maspha , over against Jerusalem : for in Maspha was a place of prayer heretofore in Israel .
text_la: Et congregati sunt, et venerunt in Maspha contra Jerusalem, quia locus orationis erat in Maspha ante in Israël.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν καὶ ἤλθοσαν εἰς Μασσηφα κατέναντι Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι τόπος προσευχῆς ἦν ἐν Μασσηφα τὸ πρότερον τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And they fasted that day, and put on haircloth, and put ashes upon their heads: and they rent their garments:
text_la: Et jejunaverunt illa die, et induerunt se ciliciis, et cinerem imposuerunt capiti suo, et disciderunt vestimenta sua:
text_el: καὶ ἐνήστευσαν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ περιεβάλοντο σάκκους καὶ σποδὸν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν καὶ διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν

text_en: And they laid open the books of the law, in which the Gentiles searched for the likeness of their idols:
text_la: et expanderunt libros legis, de quibus scrutabantur gentes similitudinem simulacrorum suorum:
text_el: καὶ ἐξεπέτασαν τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ νόμου περὶ ὧν ἐξηρεύνων τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ὁμοιώματα τῶν εἰδώλων αὐτῶν

text_en: And they brought the priestly ornaments, and the first fruits and tithes , and stirred up the Nazarites that had fulfilled their days:
text_la: et attulerunt ornamenta sacerdotalia, et primitias, et decimas : et suscitaverunt Nazaræos, qui impleverant dies,
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκαν τὰ ἱμάτια τῆς ἱερωσύνης καὶ τὰ πρωτογενήματα καὶ τὰς δεκάτας καὶ ἤγειραν τοὺς ναζιραίους οἳ ἐπλήρωσαν τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: And they cried with a loud voice toward heaven , saying: What shall we do with these, and whither shall we carry them?
text_la: et clamaverunt voce magna in cælum, dicentes : Quid faciemus istis, et quo eos ducemus?
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησαν φωνῇ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν λέγοντες τί ποιήσωμεν τούτοις καὶ ποῦ αὐτοὺς ἀπαγάγωμεν

text_en: For your holies are trodden down, and are profaned, and your priests are in mourning, and are brought low.
text_la: et sancta tua conculcata sunt, et contaminata sunt, et sacerdotes tui facti sunt in luctum, et in humilitatem:
text_el: καὶ τὰ ἅγιά σου καταπεπάτηνται καὶ βεβήλωνται καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς σου ἐν πένθει καὶ ταπεινώσει

text_en: And behold the nations have come together against us, to destroy us: you know what they intend against us.
text_la: et ecce nationes convenerunt adversum nos ut nos disperdant: tu scis quæ cogitant in nos.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ τὰ ἔθνη συνῆκται ἐφ' ἡμᾶς τοῦ ἐξᾶραι ἡμᾶς σὺ οἶδας ἃ λογίζονται ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: How shall we be able to stand before their face, unless you, O God , help us?
text_la: Quomodo poterimus subsistere ante faciem eorum, nisi tu, Deus, adjuves nos?
text_el: πῶς δυνησόμεθα ὑποστῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ἐὰν μὴ σὺ βοηθήσῃς ἡμῖν

text_en: Then they sounded with trumpets, and cried out with a loud voice.
text_la: Et tubis exclamaverunt voce magna.
text_el: καὶ ἐσάλπισαν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἐβόησαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ

text_en: And after this, Judas appointed captains over the people, over thousands, and over hundreds , and over fifties, and over tens.
text_la: Et post hæc constituit Judas duces populi, tribunos, et centuriones, et pentacontarchos, et decuriones.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο κατέστησεν Ιουδας ἡγουμένους τοῦ λαοῦ χιλιάρχους καὶ ἑκατοντάρχους καὶ πεντηκοντάρχους καὶ δεκαδάρχους

text_en: And he said to them that were building houses, or had betrothed wives, or were planting vineyards, or were fearful, that they should return every man to his house, according to the law.
text_la: Et dixit his, qui ædificabant domos, et sponsabant uxores, et plantabant vineas, et formidolosis, ut redirent unusquisque in domum suam secundum legem.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς οἰκοδομοῦσιν οἰκίας καὶ μνηστευομένοις γυναῖκας καὶ φυτεύουσιν ἀμπελῶνας καὶ δειλοῖς ἀποστρέφειν ἕκαστον εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὸν νόμον

text_en: So they removed the camp, and pitched on the south side of Emmaus.
text_la: Et moverunt castra, et collocaverunt ad austrum Emmaum.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ἡ παρεμβολή καὶ παρενέβαλον κατὰ νότον Αμμαους

text_en: And Judas said: Gird yourselves, and be valiant men , and be ready against the morning, that you may fight with these nations that are assembled against us to destroy us and our sanctuary.
text_la: Et ait Judas : Accingimini, et estote filii potentes, et estote parati in mane, ut pugnetis adversus nationes has quæ convenerunt adversus nos disperdere nos, et sancta nostra:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδας περιζώσασθε καὶ γίνεσθε εἰς υἱοὺς δυνατοὺς καὶ γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι εἰς πρωὶ τοῦ πολεμῆσαι ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τούτοις τοῖς ἐπισυνηγμένοις ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐξᾶραι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὰ ἅγια ἡμῶν

text_en: For it is better for us to die in battle, than to see the evils of our nation, and of the holies:
text_la: quoniam melius est nos mori in bello, quam videre mala gentis nostræ, et sanctorum.
text_el: ὅτι κρεῖσσον ἡμᾶς ἀποθανεῖν ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ ἢ ἐπιδεῖν ἐπὶ τὰ κακὰ τοῦ ἔθνους ἡμῶν καὶ τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: Nevertheless, as it shall be the will of God in heaven , so be it done.
text_la: Sicut autem fuerit voluntas in cælo, sic fiat.
text_el: ὡς δ' ἂν ᾖ θέλημα ἐν οὐρανῷ οὕτως ποιήσει

text_en: Then Gorgias took five thousand men , and a thousand of the best horsemen; and they removed out of the camp by night.
text_la: Et assumpsit Gorgias quinque millia virorum, et mille equites electos : et moverunt castra nocte,
text_pt: Ouvi, filhos, a instrução do pai, e estai atentos para conhecerdes a prudência.
text_el: καὶ παρέλαβεν Γοργίας πεντακισχιλίους ἄνδρας καὶ χιλίαν ἵππον ἐκλεκτήν καὶ ἀπῆρεν ἡ παρεμβολὴ νυκτὸς

text_en: That they might come upon the camp of the Jews and strike them suddenly: and the men that were of the castle were their guides.
text_la: ut applicarent ad castra Judæorum, et percuterent eos subito : et filii, qui erant ex arce, erant illis duces.
text_pt: Pois dou-vos boa doutrina; não deixeis a minha lei.
text_el: ὥστε ἐπιβαλεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν Ιουδαίων καὶ πατάξαι αὐτοὺς ἄφνω καὶ υἱοὶ τῆς ἄκρας ἦσαν αὐτῷ ὁδηγοί

text_en: And Judas heard of it, and rose up, he and the valiant men , to attack the king's forces that were in Emmaus.
