text_en: But there were no victuals in the city, because it was the seventh year: and such as had stayed in Judea of them that came from among the nations, had eaten the residue of all that which had been stored up.
text_la: Escæ autem non erant in civitate, eo quod septimus annus esset : et qui remanserant in Judæa de gentibus, consumpserant reliquias eorum, quæ repositæ fuerant.
text_el: βρώματα δὲ οὐκ ἦν ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις διὰ τὸ ἕβδομον ἔτος εἶναι καὶ οἱ ἀνασῳζόμενοι εἰς τὴν Ιουδαίαν ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν κατέφαγον τὸ ὑπόλειμμα τῆς παραθέσεως

text_en: And there remained in the holy places but a few, for the famine had prevailed over them: and they were dispersed every man to his own place.
text_la: Et remanserunt in sanctis viri pauci, quoniam obtinuerat eos fames : et dispersi sunt unusquisque in locum suum.
text_el: καὶ ὑπελείφθησαν ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις ἄνδρες ὀλίγοι ὅτι κατεκράτησεν αὐτῶν ὁ λιμός καὶ ἐσκορπίσθησαν ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now Lysias heard that Philip; whom King Antiochus while he lived had appointed to bring up his son, Antiochus, and to reign,
text_la: Et audivit Lysias quod Philippus, quem constituerat rex Antiochus cum adhuc viveret, ut nutriret Antiochum filium suum, et regnaret,
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Λυσίας ὅτι Φίλιππος ὃν κατέστησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ἀντίοχος ἔτι ζῶντος αὐτοῦ ἐκθρέψαι Ἀντίοχον τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτόν

text_en: was returned from Persia, and Media , with the army that went with him and that he sought to take upon him the affairs of the kingdom:
text_la: reversus esset a Perside et Media, et exercitus qui abierat cum ipso, et quia quærebat suscipere regni negotia:
text_el: ἀπέστρεψεν ἀπὸ τῆς Περσίδος καὶ Μηδίας καὶ αἱ δυνάμεις αἱ πορευθεῖσαι μετὰ τοῦ βασιλέως μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅτι ζητεῖ παραλαβεῖν τὰ τῶν πραγμάτων

text_en: Wherefore he made haste to go, and say to the king and to the captains of the army: We decay daily, and our provision of victuals is small, and the place that we lay siege to is strong, and it lies upon us to take order for the affairs of the kingdom.
text_la: festinavit ire, et dicere ad regem, et duces exercitus : Deficimus quotidie, et esca nobis modica est; et locus, quem obsidemus, est munitus, et incumbit nobis ordinare de regno.
text_el: καὶ κατέσπευδεν καὶ ἐπένευσεν τοῦ ἀπελθεῖν καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ τοὺς ἡγεμόνας τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐκλείπομεν καθ' ἡμέραν καὶ ἡ τροφὴ ἡμῖν ὀλίγη καὶ ὁ τόπος οὗ παρεμβάλλομέν ἐστιν ὀχυρός καὶ ἐπίκειται ἡμῖν τὰ τῆς βασιλείας

text_en: Now, therefore, let us come to an agreement with these men , and make peace with them and with all their nation.
text_la: Nunc itaque demus dextras hominibus istis, et faciamus cum illis pacem, et cum omni gente eorum:
text_el: νῦν οὖν δῶμεν δεξιὰς τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις καὶ ποιήσωμεν μετ' αὐτῶν εἰρήνην καὶ μετὰ παντὸς ἔθνους αὐτῶν

text_en: And let us covenant with them, that they may live according to their own laws, as before. For because of our despising their laws, they have been provoked, and have done all these things.
text_la: et constituamus illis ut ambulent in legitimis suis sicut prius : propter legitima enim ipsorum, quæ despeximus, irati sunt, et fecerunt omnia hæc.
text_el: καὶ στήσωμεν αὐτοῖς τοῦ πορεύεσθαι τοῖς νομίμοις αὐτῶν ὡς τὸ πρότερον χάριν γὰρ τῶν νομίμων αὐτῶν ὧν διεσκεδάσαμεν ὠργίσθησαν καὶ ἐποίησαν ταῦτα πάντα

text_en: And the proposal was acceptable in the sight of the king, and of the princes: and he sent to them to make peace: and they accepted of it.
text_la: Et placuit sermo in conspectu regis et principum : et misit ad eos pacem facere, et receperunt illam.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν ὁ λόγος ἐναντίον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ τῶν ἀρχόντων καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς εἰρηνεῦσαι καὶ ἐπεδέξαντο

text_en: And the king and the princes swore to them: and they came out of the strong hold.
text_la: Et juravit illis rex et principes, et exierunt de munitione.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἐπὶ τούτοις ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ ὀχυρώματος

text_en: Then the king entered into Mount Sion, and saw the strength of the place: and he quickly broke the oath that he had taken, and gave commandment to throw down the wall round about.
text_la: Et intravit rex montem Sion, et vidit munitionem loci : et rupit citius juramentum quod juravit, et mandavit destruere murum in gyro.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς ὄρος Σιων καὶ εἶδεν τὸ ὀχύρωμα τοῦ τόπου καὶ ἠθέτησεν τὸν ὁρκισμόν ὃν ὤμοσεν καὶ ἐνετείλατο καθελεῖν τὸ τεῖχος κυκλόθεν

text_en: And he departed in haste and returned to Antioch , where he found Philip master of the city: and he fought against him, and took the city.
text_la: Et discessit festinanter, et reversus est Antiochiam, et invenit Philippum dominantem civitati : et pugnavit adversus eum, et occupavit civitatem.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν κατὰ σπουδὴν καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν καὶ εὗρεν Φίλιππον κυριεύοντα τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐπολέμησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ κατελάβετο τὴν πόλιν βίᾳ

text_en: In the hundred and fifty-first year, Demetrius, the son of Seleucus, departed from the city of Rome, and came up with few men into a city of the sea coast, and reigned there.
text_la: Anno centesimo quinquagesimo primo, exiit Demetrius Seleuci filius ab urbe Roma, et ascendit cum paucis viris in civitatem maritimam, et regnavit illic.
text_pt: Filho meu, guarda as minhas palavras, e esconde dentro de ti os meus mandamentos.
text_el: ἔτους ἑνὸς καὶ πεντηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ ἐξῆλθεν Δημήτριος ὁ τοῦ Σελεύκου ἐκ Ῥώμης καὶ ἀνέβη σὺν ἀνδράσιν ὀλίγοις εἰς πόλιν παραθαλασσίαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And it came to pass as he entered into the house of the kingdom of his fathers, that the army seized upon Antiochus, and Lysias, to bring them unto him.
text_la: Et factum est, ut ingressus est domum regni patrum suorum, comprehendit exercitus Antiochum et Lysiam, ut adducerent eos ad eum.
text_pt: Guarda os meus mandamentos e vive; e a minha lei, como a menina dos teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἰσεπορεύετο εἰς οἶκον βασιλείας πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ συνέλαβον αἱ δυνάμεις τὸν Ἀντίοχον καὶ τὸν Λυσίαν ἀγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς αὐτῷ

text_en: And when he knew it, he said: Let me not see their face.
text_la: Et res ei innotuit, et ait : Nolite mihi ostendere faciem eorum.
text_pt: Ata-os aos teus dedos, escreve-os na tábua do teu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐγνώσθη αὐτῷ τὸ πρᾶγμα καὶ εἶπεν μή μοι δείξητε τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν

text_en: So the army slew them. And Demetrius sat upon the throne of his kingdom:
text_la: Et occidit eos exercitus. Et sedit Demetrius super sedem regni sui.
text_pt: Dize à sabedoria: Tu és minha irmã; e à prudência chama de tua parenta,
text_el: καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς αἱ δυνάμεις καὶ ἐκάθισεν Δημήτριος ἐπὶ θρόνου βασιλείας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And there came to him the wicked and ungodly men of Israel : and Alcimus was at the head of them, who desired to be made high priest .
text_la: Et venerunt ad eum viri iniqui et impii ex Israël : et Alcimus dux eorum, qui volebat fieri sacerdos.
text_pt: Para que elas te guardem da mulher alheia, da estranha que lisonjeia com as suas palavras.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες ἄνδρες ἄνομοι καὶ ἀσεβεῖς ἐξ Ισραηλ καὶ Ἄλκιμος ἡγεῖτο αὐτῶν βουλόμενος ἱερατεύειν

text_en: And they accused the people to the king, saying: Judas and his brethren have destroyed all your friends, and he has driven us out of our land.
text_la: Et accusaverunt populum apud regem, dicentes : Perdidit Judas et fratres ejus omnes amicos tuos, et nos dispersit de terra nostra.
text_pt: Porque da janela da minha casa, olhando eu por minhas frestas,
text_el: καὶ κατηγόρησαν τοῦ λαοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα λέγοντες ἀπώλεσεν Ιουδας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ πάντας τοὺς φίλους σου καὶ ἡμᾶς ἐσκόρπισεν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἡμῶν

text_en: Now, therefore, send some man whom you trust, and let him go, and see all the havoc he has made amongst us, and in the king's lands: and let him punish all his friends and their helpers.
text_la: Nunc ergo mitte virum, cui credis, ut eat, et videat exterminium omne quod fecit nobis, et regionibus regis : et puniat omnes amicos ejus, et adjutores eorum.
text_pt: Vi entre os simples, descobri entre os moços, um moço falto de juízo,
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἀπόστειλον ἄνδρα ᾧ πιστεύεις καὶ πορευθεὶς ἰδέτω τὴν ἐξολέθρευσιν πᾶσαν ἣν ἐποίησεν ἡμῖν καὶ τῇ χώρᾳ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ κολασάτω αὐτοὺς καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἐπιβοηθοῦντας αὐτοῖς

text_en: Then the king chose Bacchides, one of his friends, that ruled beyond the great river in the kingdom, and was faithful to the king: and he sent him,
text_la: Et elegit rex ex amicis suis Bacchidem, qui dominabatur trans flumen magnum in regno, et fidelem regi : et misit eum,
text_pt: Que passava pela rua junto à sua esquina, e seguia o caminho da sua casa;
text_el: καὶ ἐπέλεξεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Βακχίδην τῶν φίλων τοῦ βασιλέως κυριεύοντα ἐν τῷ πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ μέγαν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ καὶ πιστὸν τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: to see the havoc that Judas had made: and the wicked Alcimus he made high priest , and commanded him to take revenge upon the children of Israel .
text_la: ut videret exterminium quod fecit Judas : sed et Alcimum impium constituit in sacerdotium, et mandavit ei facere ultionem in filios Israël.
text_pt: No crepúsculo, à tarde do dia, na tenebrosa noite e na escuridão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν καὶ Ἄλκιμον τὸν ἀσεβῆ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτῷ τὴν ἱερωσύνην καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ποιῆσαι τὴν ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And they arose, and came with a great army into the land of Juda : and they sent messengers, and spoke to Judas and his brethren with peaceable words, deceitfully.
text_la: Et surrexerunt, et venerunt cum exercitu magno in terram Juda : et miserunt nuntios, et locuti sunt ad Judam et ad fratres ejus verbis pacificis in dolo.
text_pt: E eis que uma mulher lhe saiu ao encontro com enfeites de prostituta, e astúcia de coração.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῇρον καὶ ἦλθον μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸς Ιουδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ λόγοις εἰρηνικοῖς μετὰ δόλου

text_en: But they gave no heed to their words: for they saw that they had come with a great army.
text_la: Et non intenderunt sermonibus eorum : viderunt enim quia venerunt cum exercitu magno.
text_pt: Estava alvoroçada e irrequieta; não paravam em sua casa os seus pés.
text_el: καὶ οὐ προσέσχον τοῖς λόγοις αὐτῶν εἶδον γὰρ ὅτι ἦλθαν μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς

text_en: Then there assembled to Alcimus and Bacchides a company of the scribes , to require things that are just :
text_la: Et convenerunt ad Alcimum et Bacchidem congregatio scribarum requirere quæ justa sunt:
text_pt: Foi para fora, depois pelas ruas, e ia espreitando por todos os cantos;
text_el: καὶ ἐπισυνήχθησαν πρὸς Ἄλκιμον καὶ Βακχίδην συναγωγὴ γραμματέων ἐκζητῆσαι δίκαια

text_en: And first the Assideans , that were among the children of Israel , and they sought peace of them.
text_la: et primi, Assidæi qui erant in filiis Israël : et exquirebant ab eis pacem.
text_pt: E chegou-se para ele e o beijou. Com face impudente lhe disse:
text_el: καὶ πρῶτοι οἱ Ασιδαῖοι ἦσαν ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπεζήτουν παρ' αὐτῶν εἰρήνην

text_en: For they said: One that is a priest of the seed of Aaron has come, he will not deceive us.
text_la: Dixerunt enim : Homo sacerdos de semine Aaron venit; non decipiet nos:
text_pt: Sacrifícios pacíficos tenho comigo; hoje paguei os meus votos.
text_el: εἶπον γάρ ἄνθρωπος ἱερεὺς ἐκ σπέρματος Ααρων ἦλθεν ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν καὶ οὐκ ἀδικήσει ἡμᾶς

text_en: And he spoke to them peaceably: and he swore to them, saying: We will do you no harm, nor your friends.
text_la: et locutus est cum eis verba pacifica, et juravit illis, dicens : Non inferemus vobis malum, neque amicis vestris.
text_pt: Por isto saí ao teu encontro a buscar diligentemente a tua face, e te achei.
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτῶν λόγους εἰρηνικοὺς καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτοῖς λέγων οὐκ ἐκζητήσομεν ὑμῖν κακὸν καὶ τοῖς φίλοις ὑμῶν

text_en: And they believed him. And he took threescore of them, and slew them in one day, according to the word that is written:
text_la: Et crediderunt ei : et comprehendit ex eis sexaginta viros, et occidit eos in una die, secundum verbum quod scriptum est:
text_pt: Já cobri a minha cama com cobertas de tapeçaria, com obras lavradas, com linho fino do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεπίστευσαν αὐτῷ καὶ συνέλαβεν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἑξήκοντα ἄνδρας καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ κατὰ τὸν λόγον ὃν ἔγραψεν αὐτόν

text_en: The flesh of your saints, and the blood of them they have shed round about Jerusalem , and there was none to bury them.
text_la: Carnes sanctorum tuorum, et sanguinem ipsorum effuderunt in circuitu Jerusalem, et non erat qui sepeliret.
text_pt: Já perfumei o meu leito com mirra, aloés e canela.
text_el: σάρκας ὁσίων σου καὶ αἷμα αὐτῶν ἐξέχεαν κύκλῳ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτοῖς ὁ θάπτων

text_en: Then fear and trembling fell upon all the people: for they said: There is no truth , nor justice among them: for they have broken the covenant, and the oath which they made.
text_la: Et incubuit timor et tremor in omnem populum : quia dixerunt : Non est veritas, et judicium in eis : transgressi sunt enim constitutum, et jusjurandum quod juraverunt.
text_pt: Vem, saciemo-nos de amores até à manhã; alegremo-nos com amores.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέπεσεν αὐτῶν ὁ φόβος καὶ ὁ τρόμος εἰς πάντα τὸν λαόν ὅτι εἶπον οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀλήθεια καὶ κρίσις παρέβησαν γὰρ τὴν στάσιν καὶ τὸν ὅρκον ὃν ὤμοσαν

text_en: And Bacchides removed the camp from Jerusalem , and pitched in Bethzecha: and he sent, and took many of them that were fled away from him, and some of the people he killed, and threw them into a great pit.
text_la: Et movit Bacchides castra ab Jerusalem, et applicuit in Bethzecha : et misit, et comprehendit multos ex eis qui a se effugerant : et quosdam de populo mactavit, et in puteum magnum projecit.
text_pt: Porque o marido não está em casa; foi fazer uma longa viagem;
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν Βακχίδης ἀπὸ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐν Βηθζαιθ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν καὶ συνέλαβεν πολλοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ αὐτομολησάντων ἀνδρῶν καί τινας τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθυσεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸ φρέαρ τὸ μέγα

text_en: Then he committed the country to Alcimus , and left with him troops to help him. So Bacchides went away to the king.
text_la: Et commisit regionem Alcimo, et reliquit cum eo auxilium in adjutorium ipsi. Et abiit Bacchides ad regem:
text_pt: Levou na sua mão um saquitel de dinheiro; voltará para casa só no dia marcado.
text_el: καὶ κατέστησεν τὴν χώραν τῷ Ἀλκίμῳ καὶ ἀφῆκεν μετ' αὐτοῦ δύναμιν τοῦ βοηθεῖν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν Βακχίδης πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: But Alcimus did what he could to maintain his chief priesthood .
text_la: et satis agebat Alcimus pro principatu sacerdotii sui:
text_pt: Assim, o seduziu com palavras muito suaves e o persuadiu com as lisonjas dos seus lábios.
text_el: καὶ ἠγωνίσατο Ἄλκιμος περὶ τῆς ἀρχιερωσύνης

text_en: And they that disturbed the people resorted to him, and they got the land of Juda into their power, and did much hurt in Israel .
text_la: et convenerunt ad eum omnes, qui perturbabant populum suum, et obtinuerunt terram Juda, et fecerunt plagam magnam in Israël.
text_pt: E ele logo a segue, como o boi que vai para o matadouro, e como vai o insensato para o castigo das prisões;
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ ταράσσοντες τὸν λαὸν αὐτῶν καὶ κατεκράτησαν γῆν Ιουδα καὶ ἐποίησαν πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Judas saw all the evils that Alcimus , and they that were with him, did to the children of Israel , much more than the Gentiles .
text_la: Et vidit Judas omnia mala quæ fecit Alcimus et qui cum eo erant filiis Israël, multo plus quam gentes:
text_pt: Até que a flecha lhe atravesse o fígado; ou como a ave que se apressa para o laço, e não sabe que está armado contra a sua vida.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιουδας πᾶσαν τὴν κακίαν ἣν ἐποίησεν Ἄλκιμος καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ὑπὲρ τὰ ἔθνη

text_en: And he went out into all the coasts of Judea round about, and took vengeance upon the men that had revolted, and they ceased to go forth any more into the country.
text_la: et exiit in omnes fines Judææ in circuitu, et fecit vindictam in viros desertores, et cessaverunt ultra exire in regionem.
text_pt: Agora pois, filhos, dai-me ouvidos, e estai atentos às palavras da minha boca.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς πάντα τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ιουδαίας κυκλόθεν καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς αὐτομολήσασιν καὶ ἀνεστάλησαν τοῦ ἐκπορεύεσθαι εἰς τὴν χώραν

text_en: And Alcimus saw that Judas and they that were with him, prevailed: and he knew that he could not stand against them, and he went back to the king, and accused them of many crimes.
text_la: Vidit autem Alcimus quod prævaluit Judas et qui cum eo erant, et cognovit quia non potest sustinere eos : et regressus est ad regem, et accusavit eos multis criminibus.
text_pt: Não se desvie para os caminhos dela o teu coração, e não te deixes perder nas suas veredas.
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἶδεν Ἄλκιμος ὅτι ἐνίσχυσεν Ιουδας καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔγνω ὅτι οὐ δύναται ὑποστῆναι αὐτούς καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ κατηγόρησεν αὐτῶν πονηρά

text_en: And the king sent Nicanor, one of his principal lords, who was a great enemy to Israel : and he commanded him to destroy the people.
text_la: Et misit rex Nicanorem, unum ex principibus suis nobilioribus, qui erat inimicitias exercens contra Israël : et mandavit ei evertere populum.
text_pt: Porque a muitos feridos derrubou; e são muitíssimos os que por causa dela foram mortos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Νικάνορα ἕνα τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτοῦ τῶν ἐνδόξων καὶ μισοῦντα καὶ ἐχθραίνοντα τῷ Ισραηλ καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ἐξᾶραι τὸν λαόν

text_en: And Nicanor came to Jerusalem with a great army, and he sent to Judas and to his brethren deceitfully, with friendly words,
text_la: Et venit Nicanor in Jerusalem cum exercitu magno, et misit ad Judam et ad fratres ejus verbis pacificis cum dolo,
text_pt: A sua casa é caminho do inferno que desce para as câmaras da morte.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Νικάνωρ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ δυνάμει πολλῇ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Ιουδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ μετὰ δόλου λόγοις εἰρηνικοῖς λέγων

text_en: saying: Let there be no fighting between me and you: I will come with a few men , to see your faces with peace.
text_la: dicens : Non sit pugna inter me et vos : veniam cum viris paucis, ut videam facies vestras cum pace.
text_el: μὴ ἔστω μάχη ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν ἥξω ἐν ἀνδράσιν ὀλίγοις ἵνα ἴδω ὑμῶν τὰ πρόσωπα μετ' εἰρήνης

text_en: And he came to Judas , and they saluted one another peaceably: and the enemies were prepared to take away Judas by force.
text_la: Et venit ad Judam, et salutaverunt se invicem pacifice : et hostes parati erant rapere Judam.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Ιουδαν καὶ ἠσπάσαντο ἀλλήλους εἰρηνικῶς καὶ οἱ πολέμιοι ἕτοιμοι ἦσαν ἐξαρπάσαι τὸν Ιουδαν

text_en: And the thing was known to Judas that he had come to him with deceit: and he was much afraid of him, and would not see his face any more.
text_la: Et innotuit sermo Judæ quoniam cum dolo venerat ad eum : et conterritus est ab eo, et amplius noluit videre faciem ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγνώσθη ὁ λόγος τῷ Ιουδα ὅτι μετὰ δόλου ἦλθεν ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ ἐπτοήθη ἀπ' αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐβουλήθη ἔτι ἰδεῖν τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Nicanor knew that his counsel was discovered: and he went out to fight against Judas , near Capharsalama.
text_la: Et cognovit Nicanor quoniam denudatum est consilium ejus: et exivit obviam Judæ in pugnam juxta Capharsalama.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Νικάνωρ ὅτι ἀπεκαλύφθη ἡ βουλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς συνάντησιν τῷ Ιουδα ἐν πολέμῳ κατὰ Χαφαρσαλαμα

text_en: And there fell of Nicanor's army almost five thousand men , and they fled into the city of David.
text_la: Et ceciderunt de Nicanoris exercitu fere quinque millia viri, et fugerunt in civitatem David.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσον τῶν παρὰ Νικάνορος ὡσεὶ πεντακόσιοι ἄνδρες καὶ ἔφυγον εἰς τὴν πόλιν Δαυιδ

text_en: And after this Nicanor went up into mount Sion: and some of the priests and the people came out to salute him peaceably, and to show him the holocausts that were offered for the king.
text_la: Et post hæc verba ascendit Nicanor in montem Sion : et exierunt de sacerdotibus populi salutare eum in pace, et demonstrare ei holocautomata, quæ offerebantur pro rege.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἀνέβη Νικάνωρ εἰς ὄρος Σιων καὶ ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων ἐκ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τοῦ λαοῦ ἀσπάσασθαι αὐτὸν εἰρηνικῶς καὶ δεῖξαι αὐτῷ τὴν ὁλοκαύτωσιν τὴν προσφερομένην ὑπὲρ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: But he mocked and despised them, and abused them: and he spoke proudly ,
text_la: Et irridens sprevit eos, et polluit : et locutus est superbe,
text_el: καὶ ἐμυκτήρισεν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατεγέλασεν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐμίανεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὑπερηφάνως

text_en: and swore in anger , saying: Unless Judas and his army be delivered into my hands, as soon as ever I return in peace, I will burn this house. And he went out in a great rage.
text_la: et juravit cum ira, dicens : Nisi traditus fuerit Judas et exercitus ejus in manus meas, continuo cum regressus fuero in pace, succendam domum istam. Et exiit cum ira magna.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσεν μετὰ θυμοῦ λέγων ἐὰν μὴ παραδοθῇ Ιουδας καὶ ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς χεῖράς μου τὸ νῦν καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψω ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐμπυριῶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον καὶ ἐξῆλθεν μετὰ θυμοῦ μεγάλου

text_en: And the priests went in, and stood before the face of the altar and the temple : and weeping, they said:
text_la: Et intraverunt sacerdotes, et steterunt ante faciem altaris et templi, et flentes dixerunt:
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ἔστησαν κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ ἔκλαυσαν καὶ εἶπον

text_en: You, O Lord , have chosen this house for your name to be called upon therein, that it might be a house of prayer and supplication for your people.
text_la: Tu, Domine, elegisti domum istam ad invocandum nomen tuum in ea, ut esset domus orationis et obsecrationis populo tuo:
text_el: σὺ ἐξελέξω τὸν οἶκον τοῦτον ἐπικληθῆναι τὸ ὄνομά σου ἐπ' αὐτοῦ εἶναι οἶκον προσευχῆς καὶ δεήσεως τῷ λαῷ σου

text_en: Be avenged of this man , and his army, and let them fall by the sword: remember their blasphemies, and suffer them not to continue any longer.
text_la: fac vindictam in homine isto et exercitu ejus, et cadant in gladio : memento blasphemias eorum, et ne dederis eis ut permaneant.
text_el: ποίησον ἐκδίκησιν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τούτῳ καὶ ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ πεσέτωσαν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ μνήσθητι τῶν δυσφημιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ μὴ δῷς αὐτοῖς μονήν

text_en: Then Nicanor went out from Jerusalem , and encamped near to Bethoron: and an army of Syria joined him.
text_la: Et exiit Nicanor ab Jerusalem, et castra applicuit ad Bethoron : et occurrit illi exercitus Syriæ.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Νικάνωρ ἐξ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ παρενέβαλεν ἐν Βαιθωρων καὶ συνήντησεν αὐτῷ δύναμις Συρίας

text_en: But Judas pitched in Adarsa with three thousand men : and Judas prayed , and said:
text_la: Et Judas applicuit in Adarsa cum tribus millibus viris : et oravit Judas, et dixit:
text_el: καὶ Ιουδας παρενέβαλεν ἐν Αδασα ἐν τρισχιλίοις ἀνδράσιν καὶ προσηύξατο Ιουδας καὶ εἶπεν

text_en: O Lord , when they that were sent by King Sennacherib blasphemed you, an angel went out, and slew of them a hundred and eighty-five thousand:
text_la: Qui missi erant a rege Sennacherib, Domine, quia blasphemaverunt te, exiit angelus, et percussit ex eis centum octoginta quinque millia:
text_el: οἱ παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως ὅτε ἐδυσφήμησαν ἐξῆλθεν ὁ ἄγγελός σου καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα πέντε χιλιάδας

text_en: Even so destroy this army in our sight today and let the rest know that he has spoken ill against your sanctuary: and judge him according to his wickedness .
text_la: sic contere exercitum istum in conspectu nostro hodie : et sciant ceteri quia male locutus est super sancta tua : et judica illum secundum malitiam illius.
text_el: οὕτως σύντριψον τὴν παρεμβολὴν ταύτην ἐνώπιον ἡμῶν σήμερον καὶ γνώτωσαν οἱ ἐπίλοιποι ὅτι κακῶς ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγιά σου καὶ κρῖνον αὐτὸν κατὰ τὴν κακίαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the armies joined battle on the thirteenth day of the month, Adar : and the army of Nicanor was defeated, and he himself was first slain in the battle.
text_la: Et commiserunt exercitus prælium tertiadecima die mensis Adar : et contrita sunt castra Nicanoris, et cecidit ipse primus in prælio.
text_el: καὶ συνῆψαν αἱ παρεμβολαὶ εἰς πόλεμον τῇ τρισκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς Αδαρ καὶ συνετρίβη ἡ παρεμβολὴ Νικάνορος καὶ ἔπεσεν αὐτὸς πρῶτος ἐν τῷ πολέμῳ

text_en: And when his army saw that Nicanor was slain they threw away their weapons, and fled:
text_la: Ut autem vidit exercitus ejus quia cecidisset Nicanor, projecerunt arma sua, et fugerunt:
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἶδεν ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἔπεσεν Νικάνωρ ῥίψαντες τὰ ὅπλα ἔφυγον

text_en: And they pursued after them one day's journey from Adazer, even till you come to Gazara, and they sounded the trumpets after them with signals.
text_la: et persecuti sunt eos viam unius diei ab Adazer usquequo veniatur in Gazara, et tubis cecinerunt post eos cum significationibus:
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωκον αὐτοὺς ὁδὸν ἡμέρας μιᾶς ἀπὸ Αδασα ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς Γαζηρα καὶ ἐσάλπιζον ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν τῶν σημασιῶν

text_en: And they went forth out of all the towns of Judea round about, and they pushed them with the horns, and they turned again to them, and they were all slain with the sword, and there was not left of them so much as one.
text_la: et exierunt de omnibus castellis Judææ in circuitu, et ventilabant eos cornibus, et convertebantur iterum ad eos, et ceciderunt omnes gladio, et non est relictus ex eis nec unus.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον ἐκ πασῶν τῶν κωμῶν τῆς Ιουδαίας κυκλόθεν καὶ ὑπερεκέρων αὐτούς καὶ ἀπέστρεφον οὗτοι πρὸς τούτους καὶ ἔπεσον πάντες ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς

text_en: And they took the spoils of them for a booty, and they cut off Nicanor's head, and his right hand, which he had proudly stretched out, and they brought it, and hung it up over against Jerusalem .
text_la: Et acceperunt spolia eorum in prædam : et caput Nicanoris amputaverunt, et dexteram ejus, quam extenderat superbe, et attulerunt, et suspenderunt contra Jerusalem.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον τὰ σκῦλα καὶ τὴν προνομήν καὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Νικάνορος ἀφεῖλον καὶ τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἣν ἐξέτεινεν ὑπερηφάνως καὶ ἤνεγκαν καὶ ἐξέτειναν παρὰ τῇ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And the people rejoiced exceedingly, and they spent that day with great joy .
text_la: Et lætatus est populus valde, et egerunt diem illam in lætitia magna.
text_el: καὶ ηὐφράνθη ὁ λαὸς σφόδρα καὶ ἤγαγον τὴν ἡμέραν ἐκείνην ἡμέραν εὐφροσύνης μεγάλην

text_en: And he ordained that this day should be kept every year, being the thirteenth of the month of Adar .
text_la: Et constituit agi omnibus annis diem istam tertiadecima die mensis Adar.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν τοῦ ἄγειν κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην τῇ τρισκαιδεκάτῃ τοῦ Αδαρ

text_en: And the land of Juda was quiet for a short time.
text_la: Et siluit terra Juda dies paucos.
text_el: καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ Ιουδα ἡμέρας ὀλίγας

text_en: Now Judas heard of the fame of the Romans, that they are powerful and strong, and willingly agree to all things that are requested of them: and that whosoever have come to them, they have made amity with them, and that they are mighty in power.
text_la: Et audivit Judas nomen Romanorum, quia sunt potentes viribus, et acquiescunt ad omnia quæ postulantur ab eis, et quicumque accesserunt ad eos, statuerunt cum eis amicitias : et quia sunt potentes viribus.
text_pt: Não clama porventura a sabedoria, e a inteligência não faz ouvir a sua voz?
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ιουδας τὸ ὄνομα τῶν Ῥωμαίων ὅτι εἰσὶν δυνατοὶ ἰσχύι καὶ αὐτοὶ εὐδοκοῦσιν ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς προστιθεμένοις αὐτοῖς καὶ ὅσοι ἂν προσέλθωσιν αὐτοῖς ἱστῶσιν αὐτοῖς φιλίαν καὶ ὅτι εἰσὶ δυνατοὶ ἰσχύι

text_en: And they heard of their battles, and their noble acts which they had done in Galatia, how they had conquered them, and brought them under tribute:
text_la: Et audierunt prælia eorum, et virtutes bonas, quas fecerunt in Galatia, quia obtinuerunt eos, et duxerunt sub tributum:
text_pt: No cume das alturas, junto ao caminho, nas encruzilhadas das veredas se posta.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ τοὺς πολέμους αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς ἀνδραγαθίας ἃς ποιοῦσιν ἐν τοῖς Γαλάταις καὶ ὅτι κατεκράτησαν αὐτῶν καὶ ἤγαγον αὐτοὺς ὑπὸ φόρον

text_en: And how great things they had done in the land of Spain , and that they had brought under their power the mines of silver and of gold that are there, and had gotten possession of all the place by their counsel and patience:
text_la: et quanta fecerunt in regione Hispaniæ, et quod in potestatem redegerunt metalla argenti et auri, quæ illic sunt, et possederunt omnem locum consilio suo, et patientia:
text_pt: Do lado das portas da cidade, à entrada da cidade, e à entrada das portas está gritando:
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐποίησαν ἐν χώρᾳ Σπανίας τοῦ κατακρατῆσαι τῶν μετάλλων τοῦ ἀργυρίου καὶ τοῦ χρυσίου τοῦ ἐκεῖ

text_en: And had conquered places that were very far off from them, and kings that came against them from the ends of the earth, and had overthrown them with great slaughter: and the rest pay them tribute every year.
text_la: locaque quæ longe erant valde ab eis, et reges, qui supervenerant eis ab extremis terræ, contriverunt, et percusserunt eos plaga magna : ceteri autem dant eis tributum omnibus annis.
text_pt: A vós, ó homens, clamo; e a minha voz se dirige aos filhos dos homens.
text_el: καὶ κατεκράτησαν τοῦ τόπου παντὸς τῇ βουλῇ αὐτῶν καὶ τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ ὁ τόπος ἦν ἀπέχων μακρὰν ἀπ' αὐτῶν σφόδρα καὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῶν ἐπελθόντων ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀπ' ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως συνέτριψαν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπάταξαν ἐν αὐτοῖς πληγὴν μεγάλην καὶ οἱ ἐπίλοιποι διδόασιν αὐτοῖς φόρον κατ' ἐνιαυτόν

text_en: And that they had defeated in battle Philip and Perses the king of the Ceteans, and the rest that had borne arms against them, and had conquered them:
text_la: Et Philippum et Persen Ceteorum regem, et ceteros qui adversum eos arma tulerant, contriverunt in bello, et obtinuerunt eos:
text_pt: Entendei, ó simples, a prudência; e vós, insensatos, entendei de coração.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Φίλιππον καὶ τὸν Περσέα Κιτιέων βασιλέα καὶ τοὺς ἐπηρμένους ἐπ' αὐτοὺς συνέτριψαν αὐτοὺς ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ κατεκράτησαν αὐτῶν

text_en: And how Antiochus, the great king of Asia, who went to fight against them, having a hundred and twenty elephants, with horsemen, and chariots, and a very great army, was routed by them.
text_la: et Antiochum magnum regem Asiæ, qui eis pugnam intulerat habens centum viginti elephantos, et equitatum, et currus, et exercitum magnum valde, contritum ab eis:
text_pt: Ouvi, porque falarei coisas excelentes; os meus lábios se abrirão para a eqüidade.
text_el: καὶ Ἀντίοχον τὸν μέγαν βασιλέα τῆς Ἀσίας τὸν πορευθέντα ἐπ' αὐτοὺς εἰς πόλεμον ἔχοντα ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἐλέφαντας καὶ ἵππον καὶ ἅρματα καὶ δύναμιν πολλὴν σφόδρα καὶ συνετρίβη ὑπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And how they took him alive, and appointed to him, that both he and they that should reign after him, should pay a great tribute, and that he should give hostages, and that which was agreed upon,
text_la: et quia ceperunt eum vivum, et statuerunt ei ut daret ipse, et qui regnarent post ipsum, tributum magnum, et daret obsides, et constitutum,
text_pt: Porque a minha boca proferirá a verdade, e os meus lábios abominam a impiedade.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὸν ζῶντα καὶ ἔστησαν αὐτοῖς διδόναι αὐτόν τε καὶ τοὺς βασιλεύοντας μετ' αὐτὸν φόρον μέγαν καὶ διδόναι ὅμηρα καὶ διαστολὴν

text_en: and the country of the Indians, and of the Medes , and of the Lydians, some of their best provinces: and those which they had taken from them, they gave to King Eumenes.
text_la: et regionem Indorum, et Medos, et Lydos, de optimis regionibus eorum : et acceptas eas ab eis, dederunt Eumeni regi,
text_pt: São justas todas as palavras da minha boca: não há nelas nenhuma coisa tortuosa nem pervertida.
text_el: καὶ χώραν τὴν Ἰνδικὴν καὶ Μηδίαν καὶ Λυδίαν ἀπὸ τῶν καλλίστων χωρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὰς παρ' αὐτοῦ ἔδωκαν αὐτὰς Εὐμένει τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And that they who were in Greece, had a mind to go and to destroy them: and they had knowledge thereof,
text_la: et quia qui erant apud Helladam, voluerunt ire, et tollere eos : et innotuit sermo his,
text_pt: Todas elas são retas para aquele que as entende bem, e justas para os que acham o conhecimento.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι οἱ ἐκ τῆς Ἑλλάδος ἐβουλεύσαντο ἐλθεῖν καὶ ἐξᾶραι αὐτούς

text_en: and they sent a general against them, and fought with them, and many of them were slain, and they carried away their wives, and their children captives, and spoiled them, and took possession of their land, and threw down their walls, and brought them to be their servants unto this day.
text_la: et miserunt ad eos ducem unum, et pugnaverunt contra illos, et ceciderunt ex eis multi, et captivas duxerunt uxores eorum et filios, et diripuerunt eos, et terram eorum possederunt, et destruxerunt muros eorum, et in servitutem illos redegerunt usque in hunc diem:
text_pt: Aceitai a minha correção, e não a prata; e o conhecimento, mais do que o ouro fino escolhido.
text_el: καὶ ἐγνώσθη ὁ λόγος αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀπέστειλαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς στρατηγὸν ἕνα καὶ ἐπολέμησαν πρὸς αὐτούς καὶ ἔπεσον ἐξ αὐτῶν τραυματίαι πολλοί καὶ ᾐχμαλώτισαν τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπρονόμευσαν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατεκράτησαν τῆς γῆς καὶ καθεῖλον τὰ ὀχυρώματα αὐτῶν καὶ κατεδουλώσαντο αὐτοὺς ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And the other kingdoms, and islands, that at any time had resisted them, they had destroyed and brought under their power.
text_la: et residua regna, et insulas, quæ aliquando restiterant illis, exterminaverunt, et in potestatem redegerunt.
text_pt: Porque melhor é a sabedoria do que os rubis; e tudo o que mais se deseja não se pode comparar com ela.
text_el: καὶ τὰς ἐπιλοίπους βασιλείας καὶ τὰς νήσους ὅσοι ποτὲ ἀντέστησαν αὐτοῖς κατέφθειραν καὶ ἐδούλωσαν αὐτούς μετὰ δὲ τῶν φίλων αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἐπαναπαυομένων αὐτοῖς συνετήρησαν φιλίαν

text_en: But with their friends, and such as relied upon them, they kept amity, and had conquered kingdoms that were near, and that were far off: for all that heard their name , were afraid of them.
text_la: Cum amicis autem suis, et qui in ipsis requiem habebant, conservaverunt amicitiam, et obtinuerunt regna, quæ erant proxima, et quæ erant longe : quia quicumque audiebant nomen eorum, timebant eos:
text_pt: Eu, a sabedoria, habito com a prudência, e acho o conhecimento dos conselhos.
text_el: καὶ κατεκράτησαν τῶν βασιλέων τῶν ἐγγὺς καὶ τῶν μακράν καὶ ὅσοι ἤκουον τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν ἐφοβοῦντο ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: That whom they had a mind to help to a kingdom, those reigned: and whom they would, they deposed from a kingdom: and they were greatly exalted.
text_la: quibus vero vellent auxilio esse ut regnarent, regnabant : quos autem vellent, regno deturbabant : et exaltati sunt valde.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é odiar o mal; a soberba e a arrogância, o mau caminho e a boca perversa, eu odeio.
text_el: οἷς δ' ἂν βούλωνται βοηθεῖν καὶ βασιλεύειν βασιλεύουσιν οὓς δ' ἂν βούλωνται μεθιστῶσιν καὶ ὑψώθησαν σφόδρα

text_en: And none of all these wore a crown, or was clothed in purple, to be magnified thereby.
text_la: Et in omnibus istis nemo portabat diadema, nec induebatur purpura, ut magnificaretur in ea.
text_pt: Meu é o conselho e a verdadeira sabedoria; eu sou o entendimento; minha é a fortaleza.
text_el: καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τούτοις οὐκ ἐπέθεντο αὐτῶν οὐδὲ εἷς διάδημα οὐδὲ περιεβάλοντο πορφύραν ὥστε ἁδρυνθῆναι ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And that they had made themselves a senate house, and consulted daily three hundred and twenty men , that sat in council always for the people, that they might do the things that were right:
text_la: Et quia curiam fecerunt sibi, et quotidie consulebant trecentos viginti consilium agentes semper de multitudine, ut quæ digna sunt, gerant:
text_pt: Por mim reinam os reis e os príncipes decretam justiça.
text_el: καὶ βουλευτήριον ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ καθ' ἡμέραν ἐβουλεύοντο τριακόσιοι καὶ εἴκοσι βουλευόμενοι διὰ παντὸς περὶ τοῦ πλήθους τοῦ εὐκοσμεῖν αὐτούς

text_en: And that they committed their government to one man every year, to rule over all their country, and they all obey one, and there is no envy nor jealousy amongst them.
text_la: et committunt uni homini magistratum suum per singulos annos dominari universæ terræ suæ, et omnes obediunt uni, et non est invidia, neque zelus inter eos.
text_pt: Por mim governam príncipes e nobres; sim, todos os juízes da terra.
text_el: καὶ πιστεύουσιν ἑνὶ ἀνθρώπῳ ἄρχειν αὐτῶν κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν καὶ κυριεύειν πάσης τῆς γῆς αὐτῶν καὶ πάντες ἀκούουσιν τοῦ ἑνός καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν φθόνος οὐδὲ ζῆλος ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: So Judas chose Eupolemus, the son of John, the son of Jacob, and Jason , the son of Eleazar , and he sent them to Rome to make a league of amity and confederacy with them:
text_la: Et elegit Judas Eupolemum filium Joannis filii Jacob, et Jasonem filium Eleazari, et misit eos Romam constituere cum illis amicitiam et societatem:
text_pt: Eu amo aos que me amam, e os que cedo me buscarem, me acharão.
text_el: καὶ ἐπελέξατο Ιουδας τὸν Εὐπόλεμον υἱὸν Ιωαννου τοῦ Ακκως καὶ Ἰάσονα υἱὸν Ελεαζαρου καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς εἰς Ῥώμην στῆσαι φιλίαν καὶ συμμαχίαν

text_en: And that they might take off from them the yoke of the Grecians, for they saw that they oppressed the kingdom of Israel with servitude.
text_la: et ut auferrent ab eis jugum Græcorum, quia viderunt quod in servitutem premerent regnum Israël.
text_pt: Riquezas e honra estão comigo; assim como os bens duráveis e a justiça.
text_el: καὶ τοῦ ἆραι τὸν ζυγὸν ἀπ' αὐτῶν ὅτι εἶδον τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν Ἑλλήνων καταδουλουμένους τὸν Ισραηλ δουλείᾳ

text_en: And they went to Rome, a very long journey, and they entered into the senate house, and said:
text_la: Et abierunt Romam viam multam valde, et introierunt curiam, et dixerunt:
text_pt: Melhor é o meu fruto do que o ouro, do que o ouro refinado, e os meus ganhos mais do que a prata escolhida.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς Ῥώμην καὶ ἡ ὁδὸς πολλὴ σφόδρα καὶ εἰσήλθοσαν εἰς τὸ βουλευτήριον καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν καὶ εἶπον

text_en: Judas Machabeus , and his brethren, and the people of the Jews , have sent us to you to make alliance and peace with you, and that we may be registered your confederates and friends.
text_la: Judas Machabæus, et fratres ejus, et populus Judæorum, miserunt nos ad vos statuere vobiscum societatem et pacem, et conscribere nos socios et amicos vestros.
text_pt: Faço andar pelo caminho da justiça, no meio das veredas do juízo.
text_el: Ιουδας ὁ καὶ Μακκαβαῖος καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν Ιουδαίων ἀπέστειλαν ἡμᾶς πρὸς ὑμᾶς στῆσαι μεθ' ὑμῶν συμμαχίαν καὶ εἰρήνην καὶ γραφῆναι ἡμᾶς συμμάχους καὶ φίλους ὑμῶν

text_en: And the proposal was pleasing in their sight.
text_la: Et placuit sermo in conspectu eorum.
text_pt: Para que faça herdar bens permanentes aos que me amam, e eu encha os seus tesouros.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν ὁ λόγος ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And this is the copy of the writing that they wrote back again, graven in tables of brass, and sent to Jerusalem , that it might be with them there for a memorial of the peace, and alliance.
text_la: Et hoc rescriptum est quod rescripserunt in tabulis æreis, et miserunt in Jerusalem, ut esset apud eos ibi memoriale pacis et societatis:
text_pt: O Senhor me possuiu no princípio de seus caminhos, desde então, e antes de suas obras.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἀντίγραφον τῆς ἐπιστολῆς ἧς ἀντέγραψαν ἐπὶ δέλτοις χαλκαῖς καὶ ἀπέστειλαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ εἶναι παρ' αὐτοῖς ἐκεῖ μνημόσυνον εἰρήνης καὶ συμμαχίας

text_en: GOOD SUCCESS BE TO THE ROMANS, and to the people of the Jews by sea, and by land, for ever: and far be the sword and enemy from them.
text_la: Bene sit Romanis, et genti Judæorum, in mari et in terra in æternum : gladiusque et hostis procul sit ab eis.
text_pt: Desde a eternidade fui ungida, desde o princípio, antes do começo da terra.
text_el: καλῶς γένοιτο Ῥωμαίοις καὶ τῷ ἔθνει Ιουδαίων ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς ξηρᾶς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ ῥομφαία καὶ ἐχθρὸς μακρυνθείη ἀπ' αὐτῶν

text_en: But if there come first any war upon the Romans, or any of their confederates, in all their dominions:
text_la: Quod si institerit bellum Romanis prius, aut omnibus sociis eorum in omni dominatione eorum,
text_pt: Quando ainda não havia abismos, fui gerada, quando ainda não havia fontes carregadas de águas.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐνστῇ πόλεμος Ῥώμῃ προτέρᾳ ἢ πᾶσιν τοῖς συμμάχοις αὐτῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ κυριείᾳ αὐτῶν

text_en: The nation of the Jews shall help them according as the time shall direct, with all their heart:
text_la: auxilium feret gens Judæorum, prout tempus dictaverit, corde pleno:
text_pt: Antes que os montes se houvessem assentado, antes dos outeiros, eu fui gerada.
text_el: συμμαχήσει τὸ ἔθνος τῶν Ιουδαίων ὡς ἂν ὁ καιρὸς ὑπογράφῃ αὐτοῖς καρδίᾳ πλήρει

text_en: Neither shall they give them, whilst they are fighting, or furnish them with wheat, or arms, or money, or ships, as it has seemed good to the Romans: and they shall obey their orders, without taking anything of them.
text_la: et præliantibus non dabunt, neque subministrabunt triticum, arma, pecuniam, naves, sicut placuit Romanis : et custodient mandata eorum, nihil ab eis accipientes.
text_pt: Ainda ele não tinha feito a terra, nem os campos, nem o princípio do pó do mundo.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς πολεμοῦσιν οὐ δώσουσιν οὐδὲ ἐπαρκέσουσιν σῖτον ὅπλα ἀργύριον πλοῖα ὡς ἔδοξεν Ῥώμῃ καὶ φυλάξονται τὰ φυλάγματα αὐτῶν οὐθὲν λαβόντες

text_en: In like manner also if war shall come first upon the nation of the Jews , the Romans shall help them with all their heart, according as the time shall permit them:
text_la: Similiter autem et si genti Judæorum prius acciderit bellum, adjuvabunt Romani ex animo, prout eis tempus permiserit:
text_pt: Quando ele preparava os céus, aí estava eu, quando traçava o horizonte sobre a face do abismo;
text_el: κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ δὲ ἐὰν ἔθνει Ιουδαίων συμβῇ προτέροις πόλεμος συμμαχήσουσιν οἱ Ῥωμαῖοι ἐκ ψυχῆς ὡς ἂν αὐτοῖς ὁ καιρὸς ὑπογράφῃ

text_en: And there shall not be given to them that come to their aid, either wheat, or arms, or money, or ships, as it has seemed good to the Romans: and they shall observe their orders without deceit.
text_la: et adjuvantibus non dabitur triticum, arma, pecunia, naves, sicut placuit Romanis : et custodient mandata eorum absque dolo:
text_pt: Quando firmava as nuvens acima, quando fortificava as fontes do abismo,
text_el: καὶ τοῖς συμμαχοῦσιν οὐ δοθήσεται σῖτος ὅπλα ἀργύριον πλοῖα ὡς ἔδοξεν Ῥώμῃ καὶ φυλάξονται τὰ φυλάγματα ταῦτα καὶ οὐ μετὰ δόλου

text_en: According to these articles did the Romans covenant with the people of the Jews .
text_la: secundum hæc verba constituerunt Romani populo Judæorum.
text_pt: Quando fixava ao mar o seu termo, para que as águas não traspassassem o seu mando, quando compunha os fundamentos da terra.
text_el: κατὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους οὕτως ἔστησαν Ῥωμαῖοι τῷ δήμῳ τῶν Ιουδαίων

text_en: And, if after this, one party or the other shall have a mind to add to these articles, or take away anything, they may do it at their pleasure: and whatsoever they shall add, or take away, shall be ratified.
text_la: Quod si post hæc verba hi aut illi addere aut demere ad hæc aliquid voluerint, facient ex proposito suo : et quæcumque addiderint, vel dempserint, rata erunt.
text_pt: Então eu estava com ele, e era seu arquiteto; era cada dia as suas delícias, alegrando-me perante ele em todo o tempo;
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους βουλεύσωνται οὗτοι καὶ οὗτοι προσθεῖναι ἢ ἀφελεῖν ποιήσονται ἐξ αἱρέσεως αὐτῶν καὶ ὃ ἂν προσθῶσιν ἢ ἀφέλωσιν ἔσται κύρια

text_en: Moreover, concerning the evils that Demetrius, the king, has done against them, we have written to him, saying: Why have you made your yoke heavy upon our friends and allies, the Jews .
text_la: Sed et de malis, quæ Demetrius rex fecit in eos, scripsimus ei, dicentes : Quare gravasti jugum tuum super amicos nostros, et socios Judæos?
text_pt: Regozijando-me no seu mundo habitável e enchendo-me de prazer com os filhos dos homens.
text_el: καὶ περὶ τῶν κακῶν ὧν ὁ βασιλεὺς Δημήτριος συντελεῖται εἰς αὐτούς ἐγράψαμεν αὐτῷ λέγοντες διὰ τί ἐβάρυνας τὸν ζυγόν σου ἐπὶ τοὺς φίλους ἡμῶν τοὺς συμμάχους Ιουδαίους

text_en: If, therefore, they come again to us complaining of you, we will do them justice , and will make war against you by sea and land.
text_la: si ergo iterum adierint nos, adversum te faciemus illis judicium, et pugnabimus tecum mari terraque.
text_pt: Agora, pois, filhos, ouvi-me, porque bem-aventurados serão os que guardarem os meus caminhos.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν ἔτι ἐντύχωσιν κατὰ σοῦ ποιήσομεν αὐτοῖς τὴν κρίσιν καὶ πολεμήσομέν σε διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ διὰ τῆς ξηρᾶς

text_en: In the mean time, when Demetrius heard that Nicanor and his army were fallen in battle, he sent again Bacchides and Alcimus into Judea ; and the right wing of his army with them.
text_la: Interea, ut audivit Demetrius quia cecidit Nicanor et exercitus ejus in prælio, apposuit Bacchidem et Alcimum rursum mittere in Judæam, et dextrum cornu cum illis.
text_pt: A sabedoria já edificou a sua casa, já lavrou as suas sete colunas.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Δημήτριος ὅτι ἔπεσεν Νικάνωρ καὶ ἡ δύναμις αὐτοῦ ἐν πολέμῳ καὶ προσέθετο τὸν Βακχίδην καὶ τὸν Ἄλκιμον ἐκ δευτέρου ἀποστεῖλαι εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ τὸ δεξιὸν κέρας μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And they took the road that leads to Galgal, and they camped in Masaloth, which is in Arabella: and they made themselves masters of it, and slew many people.
text_la: Et abierunt viam quæ ducit in Galgala, et castra posuerunt in Masaloth, quæ est in Arbellis : et occupaverunt eam, et peremerunt animas hominum multas.
text_pt: Já abateu os seus animais e misturou o seu vinho, e já preparou a sua mesa.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Γαλγαλα καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ Μαισαλωθ τὴν ἐν Αρβηλοις καὶ προκατελάβοντο αὐτὴν καὶ ἀπώλεσαν ψυχὰς ἀνθρώπων πολλάς

text_en: In the first month of the hundred and fifty-second year they brought the army to Jerusalem :
text_la: In mense primo anni centesimi et quinquagesimi secundi, applicuerunt exercitum ad Jerusalem:
text_pt: Já ordenou às suas criadas, e está convidando desde as alturas da cidade, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ πρώτου ἔτους τοῦ δευτέρου καὶ πεντηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And they arose and went to Berea, with twenty thousand men , and two thousand horsemen.
text_la: et surrexerunt, et abierunt in Beream viginti millia virorum, et duo millia equitum.
text_pt: Quem é simples, volte-se para cá. Aos faltos de senso diz:
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆραν καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς Βερεαν ἐν εἴκοσι χιλιάσιν ἀνδρῶν καὶ δισχιλίᾳ ἵππῳ

text_en: Now Judas had pitched his tents in Laisa, and three thousand chosen men with him:
text_la: Et Judas posuerat castra in Laisa, et tria millia viri electi cum eo:
text_pt: Vinde, comei do meu pão, e bebei do vinho que tenho misturado.
text_el: καὶ Ιουδας ἦν παρεμβεβληκὼς ἐν Ελασα καὶ τρισχίλιοι ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκλεκτοί

text_en: And they saw the multitude of the army that they were many, and they were seized with great fear: and many withdrew themselves out of the camp, and there remained of them no more than eight hundred men .
text_la: et viderunt multitudinem exercitus, quia multi sunt, et timuerunt valde : et multi subtraxerunt se de castris, et non remanserunt ex eis nisi octingenti viri.
text_pt: Deixai os insensatos e vivei; e andai pelo caminho do entendimento.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὸ πλῆθος τῶν δυνάμεων ὅτι πολλοί εἰσιν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα καὶ ἐξερρύησαν πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς παρεμβολῆς οὐ κατελείφθησαν ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀλλ' ἢ ὀκτακόσιοι ἄνδρες

text_en: And Judas saw that his army slipped away, and the battle pressed upon him, and his heart was cast down: because he had not time to gather them together, and he was discouraged.
text_la: Et vidit Judas quod defluxit exercitus suus, et bellum perurgebat eum, et confractus est corde, quia non habebat tempus congregandi eos, et dissolutus est.
text_pt: O que repreende o escarnecedor, toma afronta para si; e o que censura o ímpio recebe a sua mancha.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιουδας ὅτι ἀπερρύη ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ πόλεμος ἔθλιβεν αὐτόν καὶ συνετρίβη τῇ καρδίᾳ ὅτι οὐκ εἶχεν καιρὸν συναγαγεῖν αὐτούς

text_en: Then he said to them that remained: Let us arise, and go against our enemies, if we may be able to fight against them.
text_la: Et dixit his qui residui erant : Surgamus, et eamus ad adversarios nostros, si poterimus pugnare adversus eos.
text_pt: Não repreendas o escarnecedor, para que não te odeie; repreende o sábio, e ele te amará.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελύθη καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς καταλειφθεῖσιν ἀναστῶμεν καὶ ἀναβῶμεν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὑπεναντίους ἡμῶν ἐὰν ἄρα δυνώμεθα πολεμῆσαι πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: But they dissuaded him, saying: We shall not be able, but let us save our lives now, and return to our brethren, and then we will fight against them: for we are but few.
text_la: Et avertebant eum, dicentes : Non poterimus, sed liberemus animas nostras modo, et revertamur ad fratres nostros, et tunc pugnabimus adversus eos : nos autem pauci sumus.
text_pt: Dá instrução ao sábio, e ele se fará mais sábio; ensina o justo e ele aumentará em entendimento.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεφον αὐτὸν λέγοντες οὐ μὴ δυνώμεθα ἀλλ' ἢ σῴζωμεν τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχὰς τὸ νῦν ἐπιστρέψωμεν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἡμῶν καὶ πολεμήσωμεν πρὸς αὐτούς ἡμεῖς δὲ ὀλίγοι

text_en: Then Judas said: God forbid we should do this thing, and flee away from them: but if our time be come, let us die manfully for our brethren, and let us not stain our glory .
text_la: Et ait Judas : Absit istam rem facere ut fugiamus ab eis : et si appropiavit tempus nostrum, moriamur in virtute propter fratres nostros, et non inferamus crimen gloriæ nostræ.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é o princípio da sabedoria, e o conhecimento do Santo a prudência.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδας μὴ γένοιτο ποιῆσαι τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο φυγεῖν ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ εἰ ἤγγικεν ὁ καιρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἀποθάνωμεν ἐν ἀνδρείᾳ χάριν τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν καὶ μὴ καταλίπωμεν αἰτίαν τῇ δόξῃ ἡμῶν

text_en: And the army removed out of the camp, and they stood over against them: and the horsemen were divided into two troops, and the slingers, and the archers, went before the army, and they that were in the front were all men of valour.
text_la: Et movit exercitus de castris, et steterunt illis obviam : et divisi sunt equites in duas partes, et fundibularii et sagittarii præibant exercitum, et primi certaminis omnes potentes.
text_pt: Porque por meu intermédio se multiplicam os teus dias, e anos de vida se te aumentarão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν ἡ δύναμις ἀπὸ τῆς παρεμβολῆς καὶ ἔστησαν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐμερίσθη ἡ ἵππος εἰς δύο μέρη καὶ οἱ σφενδονῆται καὶ οἱ τοξόται προεπορεύοντο τῆς δυνάμεως καὶ οἱ πρωταγωνισταὶ πάντες οἱ δυνατοί Βακχίδης δὲ ἦν ἐν τῷ δεξιῷ κέρατι

text_en: And Bacchides was in the right wing, and the legion drew near on two sides, and they sounded the trumpets:
text_la: Bacchides autem erat in dextro cornu, et proximavit legio ex duabus partibus, et clamabant tubis:
text_pt: Se fores sábio, para ti serás sábio; e, se fores escarnecedor, só tu o suportarás.
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισεν ἡ φάλαγξ ἐκ τῶν δύο μερῶν καὶ ἐφώνουν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἐσάλπισαν οἱ παρὰ Ιουδου καὶ αὐτοὶ ταῖς σάλπιγξιν

text_en: And they also that were on Judas' side, even they also cried out, and the earth shook at the noise of the armies: and the battle was fought from morning even unto the evening.
text_la: exclamaverunt autem et hi qui erant ex parte Judæ etiam ipsi, et commota est terra a voce exercituum : et commissum est prælium a mane usque ad vesperam.
text_pt: A mulher louca é alvoroçadora; é simples e nada sabe.
text_el: καὶ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς τῶν παρεμβολῶν καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ πόλεμος συνημμένος ἀπὸ πρωίθεν ἕως ἑσπέρας

text_en: And Judas perceived that the stronger part of the army of Bacchides was on the right side, and all the stout of heart came together with him:
text_la: Et vidit Judas quod firmior est pars exercitus Bacchidis in dextris, et convenerunt cum ipso omnes constantes corde:
text_pt: Assenta-se à porta da sua casa numa cadeira, nas alturas da cidade,
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιουδας ὅτι Βακχίδης καὶ τὸ στερέωμα τῆς παρεμβολῆς ἐν τοῖς δεξιοῖς καὶ συνῆλθον αὐτῷ πάντες οἱ εὔψυχοι τῇ καρδίᾳ

text_en: And the right wing was discomfited by them, and he pursued them even to the mount Azotus .
text_la: et contrita est dextera pars ab eis, et persecutus est eos usque ad montem Azoti.
text_pt: E põe-se a chamar aos que vão pelo caminho, e que passam reto pelas veredas, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ συνετρίβη τὸ δεξιὸν μέρος ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐδίωκεν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἕως Αζωτου ὄρους

text_en: And they that were in the left wing saw that the right wing was discomfited, and they followed after Judas , and them that were with him, at their back:
text_la: Et qui in sinistro cornu erant, viderunt quod contritum est dextrum cornu, et secuti sunt post Judam, et eos qui cum ipso erant, a tergo:
text_pt: Quem é simples, volte-se para cá. E aos faltos de entendimento ela diz:
text_el: καὶ οἱ εἰς τὸ ἀριστερὸν κέρας εἶδον ὅτι συνετρίβη τὸ δεξιὸν κέρας καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν κατὰ πόδας Ιουδου καὶ τῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν

text_en: And the battle was hard fought, and there fell many wounded of the one side and of the other.
text_la: et ingravatum est prælium, et ceciderunt vulnerati multi ex his et ex illis.
text_pt: As águas roubadas são doces, e o pão tomado às escondidas é agradável.
text_el: καὶ ἐβαρύνθη ὁ πόλεμος καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι πολλοὶ ἐκ τούτων καὶ ἐκ τούτων

text_en: And Judas was slain, and the rest fled away.
text_la: Et Judas cecidit, et ceteri fugerunt.
text_pt: Mas não sabem que ali estão os mortos; os seus convidados estão nas profundezas do inferno.
text_el: καὶ Ιουδας ἔπεσεν καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἔφυγον

text_en: And Jonathan and Simon took Judas , their brother, and buried him in the sepulchre of their fathers, in the city of Modin.
text_la: Et Jonathas et Simon tulerunt Judam fratrem suum, et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro patrum suorum in civitate Modin.
text_el: καὶ ἦρεν Ιωναθαν καὶ Σιμων Ιουδαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ τάφῳ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ ἐν Μωδεϊν

text_en: And all the people of Israel bewailed him with great lamentation, and they mourned for him many days.
text_la: Et fleverunt eum omnis populus Israël planctu magno, et lugebant dies multos,
text_el: καὶ ἔκλαυσαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐκόψαντο αὐτὸν πᾶς Ισραηλ κοπετὸν μέγαν καὶ ἐπένθουν ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ εἶπον

text_en: And said: How is the mighty man fallen, that saved the people of Israel !
text_la: et dixerunt : Quomodo cecidit potens, qui salvum faciebat populum Israël!
text_el: πῶς ἔπεσεν δυνατὸς σῴζων τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: But the rest of the words of the wars of Judas , and of the noble acts that he did, and of his greatness, are not written: for they were very many.
text_la: Et cetera verba bellorum Judæ, et virtutum, quas fecit, et magnitudinis ejus, non sunt descripta : multa enim erant valde.
text_el: καὶ τὰ περισσὰ τῶν λόγων Ιουδου καὶ τῶν πολέμων καὶ τῶν ἀνδραγαθιῶν ὧν ἐποίησεν καὶ τῆς μεγαλωσύνης αὐτοῦ οὐ κατεγράφη πολλὰ γὰρ ἦν σφόδρα

text_en: And it came to pass, after the death of Judas , that the wicked began to put forth their heads in all the confines of Israel , and all the workers of iniquity rose up.
text_la: Et factum est : post obitum Judæ emerserunt iniqui in omnibus finibus Israël, et exorti sunt omnes qui operabantur iniquitatem.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὴν τελευτὴν Ιουδου ἐξέκυψαν οἱ ἄνομοι ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ὁρίοις Ισραηλ καὶ ἀνέτειλαν πάντες οἱ ἐργαζόμενοι τὴν ἀδικίαν

text_en: In those days there was a very great famine, and they and all their country yielded to Bacchides.
text_la: In diebus illis facta est fames magna valde, et tradidit se Bacchidi omnis regio eorum cum ipsis.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἐγενήθη λιμὸς μέγας σφόδρα καὶ αὐτομόλησεν ἡ χώρα μετ' αὐτῶν

text_en: And Bacchides chose the wicked men , and made them lords of the country:
text_la: Et elegit Bacchides viros impios, et constituit eos dominos regionis:
text_el: καὶ ἐξέλεξεν Βακχίδης τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς ἄνδρας καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτοὺς κυρίους τῆς χώρας

text_en: And they sought out, and made diligent search after the friends of Judas , and brought them to Bacchides, and he took vengeance of them, and abused them.
text_la: et exquirebant, et perscrutabantur amicos Judæ, et adducebant eos ad Bacchidem, et vindicabat in illos, et illudebat.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεζήτουν καὶ ἠρεύνων τοὺς φίλους Ιουδου καὶ ἦγον αὐτοὺς πρὸς Βακχίδην καὶ ἐξεδίκα αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐνέπαιζεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And there was a great tribulation in Israel , such as was not since the day, that there was no prophet seen in Israel .
text_la: Et facta est tribulatio magna in Israël, qualis non fuit ex die qua non est visus propheta in Israël.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο θλῖψις μεγάλη ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ ἥτις οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ' ἧς ἡμέρας οὐκ ὤφθη προφήτης αὐτοῖς

text_en: And all the friends of Judas came together, and said to Jonathan :
text_la: Et congregati sunt omnes amici Judæ, et dixerunt Jonathæ:
text_el: καὶ ἠθροίσθησαν πάντες οἱ φίλοι Ιουδου καὶ εἶπον τῷ Ιωναθαν

text_en: Since your brother Judas died there is not a man like him to go forth against our enemies, Bacchides, and them that are the enemies of our nation.
text_la: Ex quo frater tuus Judas defunctus est, vir similis ei non est, qui exeat contra inimicos nostros, Bacchidem et eos qui inimici sunt gentis nostræ.
text_el: ἀφ' οὗ ὁ ἀδελφός σου Ιουδας τετελεύτηκεν καὶ ἀνὴρ ὅμοιος αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν ἐξελθεῖν καὶ εἰσελθεῖν πρὸς τοὺς ἐχθροὺς καὶ Βακχίδην καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐχθραίνουσιν τοῦ ἔθνους ἡμῶν

text_en: Now, therefore, we have chosen you this day to be our prince, and captain , in his stead, to fight our battles.
text_la: Nunc itaque, te hodie elegimus esse pro eo nobis in principem, et ducem ad bellandum bellum nostrum.
text_el: νῦν οὖν σὲ ᾑρετισάμεθα σήμερον τοῦ εἶναι ἀντ' αὐτοῦ ἡμῖν εἰς ἄρχοντα καὶ ἡγούμενον τοῦ πολεμῆσαι τὸν πόλεμον ἡμῶν

text_en: So Jonathan took upon him the government at that time, and rose up in the place of Judas , his brother,
text_la: Et suscepit Jonathas tempore illo principatum, et surrexit loco Judæ fratris sui.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεδέξατο Ιωναθαν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ τὴν ἥγησιν καὶ ἀνέστη ἀντὶ Ιουδου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: and Bacchides had knowledge of it, and sought to kill him.
text_la: Et cognovit Bacchides, et quærebat eum occidere.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Βακχίδης καὶ ἐζήτει αὐτὸν ἀποκτεῖναι

text_en: And Jonathan , and Simon, his brother, knew it, and all that were with them: and they fled into the desert of Thecua, and they pitched by the water of the lake Asphar,
text_la: Et cognovit Jonathas, et Simon frater ejus, et omnes qui cum eo erant : et fugerunt in desertum Thecuæ et consederunt ad aquam lacus Asphar.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Ιωναθαν καὶ Σιμων ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφυγον εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Θεκωε καὶ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ λάκκου Ασφαρ

text_en: and Bacchides understood it, and he came himself, with all his army, over the Jordan , on the sabbath day .
text_la: Et cognovit Bacchides, et die sabbatorum venit ipse et omnis exercitus ejus trans Jordanem.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Βακχίδης τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων καὶ ἦλθεν αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶν τὸ στράτευμα αὐτοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And Jonathan sent his brother, a captain of the people, to desire the Nabutheans his friends, that they would lend them their equipage, which was copious.
text_la: Et Jonathas misit fratrem suum ducem populi, et rogavit Nabuthæos amicos suos, ut commodarent illis apparatum suum, qui erat copiosus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἡγούμενον τοῦ ὄχλου καὶ παρεκάλεσεν τοὺς Ναβαταίους φίλους αὐτοῦ τοῦ παραθέσθαι αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶν τὴν πολλήν

text_en: And the children of Jambri came forth out of Madaba, and took John, and all that he had, and went away with them.
text_la: Et exierunt filii Jambri ex Madaba, et comprehenderunt Joannem et omnia quæ habebat, et abierunt habentes ea.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ υἱοὶ Ιαμβρι οἱ ἐκ Μηδαβα καὶ συνέλαβον Ιωαννην καὶ πάντα ὅσα εἶχεν καὶ ἀπῆλθον ἔχοντες

text_en: After this it was told Jonathan , and Simon, his brother, that the children of Jambri made a great marriage, and were bringing the bride out of Madaba, the daughter of one of the great princes of Chanaan , with great pomp.
text_la: Post hæc verba, renuntiatum est Jonathæ et Simoni fratri ejus, quia filii Jambri faciunt nuptias magnas, et ducunt sponsam ex Madaba filiam unius de magnis principibus Chanaan cum ambitione magna.
text_el: μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἀπήγγειλαν Ιωναθαν καὶ Σιμωνι τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ ὅτι υἱοὶ Ιαμβρι ποιοῦσιν γάμον μέγαν καὶ ἄγουσιν τὴν νύμφην ἀπὸ Ναδαβαθ θυγατέρα ἑνὸς τῶν μεγάλων μεγιστάνων Χανααν μετὰ παραπομπῆς μεγάλης

text_en: And they remembered the blood of John, their brother: and they went up, and hid themselves under the covert of the mountain.
text_la: Et recordati sunt sanguinis Joannis fratris sui : et ascenderunt, et absconderunt se sub tegumento montis.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθησαν τοῦ αἵματος Ιωαννου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέβησαν καὶ ἐκρύβησαν ὑπὸ τὴν σκέπην τοῦ ὄρους

text_en: And they lifted up their eyes, and saw: and behold a tumult, and great preparation: and the bridegroom came forth, and his friends, and his brethren to meet them with timbrels, and musical instruments and many weapons.
text_la: Et elevaverunt oculos suos, et viderunt : et ecce tumultus, et apparatus multus : et sponsus processit, et amici ejus, et fratres ejus obviam illis cum tympanis, et musicis, et armis multis.
text_el: καὶ ἦραν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ θροῦς καὶ ἀποσκευὴ πολλή καὶ ὁ νυμφίος ἐξῆλθεν καὶ οἱ φίλοι αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῶν μετὰ τυμπάνων καὶ μουσικῶν καὶ ὅπλων πολλῶν

text_en: And they rose up against them from the place where they lay in ambush, and slew them, and there fell many wounded, and the rest fled into the mountains, and they took all their spoils:
text_la: Et surrexerunt ad eos ex insidiis, et occiderunt eos, et ceciderunt vulnerati multi, et residui fugerunt in montes : et acceperunt omnia spolia eorum:
text_el: καὶ ἐξανέστησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ ἐνέδρου καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτούς καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι πολλοί καὶ οἱ ἐπίλοιποι ἔφυγον εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἔλαβον πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῶν

text_en: And the marriage was turned into mourning, and the noise of their musical instruments into lamentation.
text_la: et conversæ sunt nuptiæ in luctum, et vox musicorum ipsorum in lamentum.
text_el: καὶ μετεστράφη ὁ γάμος εἰς πένθος καὶ φωνὴ μουσικῶν αὐτῶν εἰς θρῆνον

text_en: And they took revenge for the blood of their brother: and they returned to the bank of the Jordan .
text_la: Et vindicaverunt vindictam sanguinis fratris sui : et reversi sunt ad ripam Jordanis.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεδίκησαν τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αἵματος ἀδελφοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν εἰς τὸ ἕλος τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: And Bacchides heard it, and he came on the sabbath day even to the bank of the Jordan , with a great power.
text_la: Et audivit Bacchides, et venit die sabbatorum usque ad oram Jordanis in virtute magna.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Βακχίδης καὶ ἦλθεν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἕως τῶν κρηπίδων τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἐν δυνάμει πολλῇ

text_en: And Jonathan said to his company: Let us arise, and fight against our enemies: for it is not now as yesterday, and the day before.
text_la: Et dixit ad suos Jonathas : Surgamus, et pugnemus contra inimicos nostros : non est enim hodie sicut heri et nudiustertius:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωναθαν τοῖς παρ' αὐτοῦ ἀναστῶμεν δὴ καὶ πολεμήσωμεν περὶ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν οὐ γάρ ἐστιν σήμερον ὡς ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν

text_en: For behold the battle is before us, and the water of the Jordan on this side and on that side, and banks, and marshes, and woods: and there is no place for us to turn aside.
text_la: ecce enim bellum ex adverso, aqua vero Jordanis hinc et inde, et ripæ, et paludes, et saltus : et non est locus divertendi.
text_el: ἰδοὺ γὰρ ὁ πόλεμος ἐξ ἐναντίας καὶ ἐξόπισθεν ἡμῶν τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ τοῦ Ιορδάνου ἔνθεν καὶ ἔνθεν καὶ ἕλος καὶ δρυμός οὐκ ἔστιν τόπος τοῦ ἐκκλῖναι

text_en: Now, therefore, cry to heaven , that you may be delivered from the hand of your enemies. And they joined battle.
text_la: Nunc ergo, clamate in cælum, ut liberemini de manu inimicorum vestrorum. Et commissum est bellum.
text_el: νῦν οὖν κεκράξατε εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν ὅπως διασωθῆτε ἐκ χειρὸς τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν

text_en: And Jonathan stretched forth his hand to strike Bacchides, but he turned away from him backwards.
text_la: Et extendit Jonathas manum suam percutere Bacchidem, et divertit ab eo retro:
text_el: καὶ συνῆψεν ὁ πόλεμος καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Ιωναθαν τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ πατάξαι τὸν Βακχίδην καὶ ἐξέκλινεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: And Jonathan , and they that were with him, leapt into the Jordan , and swam over the Jordan to them.
text_la: et desiliit Jonathas, et qui cum eo erant, in Jordanem, et transnataverunt ad eos Jordanem.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεπήδησεν Ιωναθαν καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν Ιορδάνην καὶ διεκολύμβησαν εἰς τὸ πέραν καὶ οὐ διέβησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὸν Ιορδάνην

text_en: And there fell of Bacchides' side that day a thousand men : and they returned to Jerusalem ,
text_la: Et ceciderunt de parte Bacchidis die illa mille viri. Et reversi sunt in Jerusalem,
text_el: ἔπεσον δὲ παρὰ Βακχίδου τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἰς χιλίους ἄνδρας

text_en: and they built strong cities in Judea , the fortress that was in Jericho , and in Ammaus, and in Bethoron, and in Bethel , and Thamnata, and Phara, and Thopo, with high walls, and gates, and bars.
text_la: et ædificaverunt civitates munitas in Judæa, munitionem quæ erat in Jericho, et in Ammaum, et in Bethoron, et in Bethel, et Thamnata, et Phara, et Thopo muris excelsis, et portis, et seris.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν πόλεις ὀχυρὰς ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ τὸ ὀχύρωμα τὸ ἐν Ιεριχω καὶ τὴν Αμμαους καὶ τὴν Βαιθωρων καὶ τὴν Βαιθηλ καὶ τὴν Θαμναθα Φαραθων καὶ τὴν Τεφων ἐν τείχεσιν ὑψηλοῖς καὶ πύλαις καὶ μοχλοῖς

text_en: And he placed garrisons in them, that they might wage war against Israel :
text_la: Et posuit custodiam in eis, ut inimicitias exercerent in Israël:
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο φρουρὰν ἐν αὐτοῖς τοῦ ἐχθραίνειν τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he fortified the city of Bethsura, and Gazara, and the castle, and set garrisons in them, and provisions of victuals:
text_la: et munivit civitatem Bethsuram, et Gazaram, et arcem, et posuit in eis auxilia, et apparatum escarum:
text_el: καὶ ὠχύρωσεν τὴν πόλιν τὴν Βαιθσουραν καὶ Γαζαρα καὶ τὴν ἄκραν καὶ ἔθετο ἐν αὐταῖς δυνάμεις καὶ παραθέσεις βρωμάτων

text_en: And he took the sons of the chief men of the country for hostages, and put them in the castle in Jerusalem in custody.
text_la: et accepit filios principum regionis obsides, et posuit eos in arce in Jerusalem in custodiam.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν ἡγουμένων τῆς χώρας ὅμηρα καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἄκρᾳ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐν φυλακῇ

text_en: Now in the year one hundred and fifty-three, the second month, Alcimus commanded the walls of the inner court of the sanctuary to be thrown down, and the works of the prophets to be destroyed: and he began to destroy.
text_la: Et anno centesimo quinquagesimo tertio, mense secundo, præcepit Alcimus destrui muros domus sanctæ interioris, et destrui opera prophetarum : et cœpit destruere.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἔτει τρίτῳ καὶ πεντηκοστῷ καὶ ἑκατοστῷ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἐπέταξεν Ἄλκιμος καθαιρεῖν τὸ τεῖχος τῆς αὐλῆς τῶν ἁγίων τῆς ἐσωτέρας καὶ καθεῖλεν τὰ ἔργα τῶν προφητῶν καὶ ἐνήρξατο τοῦ καθαιρεῖν

text_en: At that time Alcimus was struck: and his works were hindered, and his mouth was stopped, and he was taken with a palsy, so that he could no more speak a word, nor give order concerning his house.
text_la: In tempore illo percussus est Alcimus : et impedita sunt opera illius, et occlusum est os ejus, et dissolutus est paralysi, nec ultra potuit loqui verbum, et mandare de domo sua.
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἐπλήγη Ἄλκιμος καὶ ἐνεποδίσθη τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπεφράγη τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ καὶ παρελύθη καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο ἔτι λαλῆσαι λόγον καὶ ἐντείλασθαι περὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Alcimus died at that time in great torment.
text_la: Et mortuus est Alcimus in tempore illo cum tormento magno.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ἄλκιμος ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ μετὰ βασάνου μεγάλης

text_en: And Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead: and he returned to the king, and the land was quiet for two years.
text_la: Et vidit Bacchides quoniam mortuus est Alcimus, et reversus est ad regem. Et siluit terra annis duobus.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Βακχίδης ὅτι ἀπέθανεν Ἄλκιμος καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ Ιουδα ἔτη δύο

text_en: And all the wicked held a council, saying: Behold Jonathan , and they that are with him, dwell at ease and without fear: now, therefore, let us bring Bacchides hither, and he shall take them all in one night.
text_la: Et cogitaverunt omnes iniqui, dicentes : Ecce Jonathas, et qui cum eo sunt, in silentio habitant confidenter : nunc ergo adducamus Bacchidem, et comprehendet eos omnes una nocte.
text_el: καὶ ἐβουλεύσαντο πάντες οἱ ἄνομοι λέγοντες ἰδοὺ Ιωναθαν καὶ οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ κατοικοῦσιν πεποιθότες νῦν οὖν ἀνάξομεν τὸν Βακχίδην καὶ συλλήμψεται αὐτοὺς πάντας ἐν νυκτὶ μιᾷ

text_en: So they went, and gave him counsel.
text_la: Et abierunt, et consilium ei dederunt.
text_el: καὶ πορευθέντες συνεβουλεύσαντο αὐτῷ

text_en: And he arose to come with a great army: and he sent secretly letters to his adherents that were in Judea to seize upon Jonathan , and them that were with him: but they could not, for their design was known to them.
text_la: Et surrexit ut veniret cum exercitu multo : et misit occulte epistolas sociis suis qui erant in Judæa, ut comprehenderent Jonathan, et eos qui cum eo erant : sed non potuerunt, quia innotuit eis consilium eorum.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν τοῦ ἐλθεῖν μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ ἀπέστειλεν λάθρᾳ ἐπιστολὰς πᾶσιν τοῖς συμμάχοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ ὅπως συλλάβωσιν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο ὅτι ἐγνώσθη ἡ βουλὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: And he apprehended of the men of the country, that were the principal authors of the mischief, fifty men , and he slew them.
text_la: Et apprehendit de viris regionis, qui principes erant malitiæ, quinquaginta viros, et occidit eos:
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβον ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῆς χώρας τῶν ἀρχηγῶν τῆς κακίας εἰς πεντήκοντα ἄνδρας καὶ ἀπέκτειναν αὐτούς

text_en: And Jonathan , and Simon, and they that were with him, retired into Bethbessen, which is in the desert : and he repaired the breaches thereof, and they fortified it.
text_la: et secessit Jonathas, et Simon, et qui cum eo erant, in Bethbessen, quæ est in deserto : et exstruxit diruta ejus, et firmaverunt eam.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεχώρησεν Ιωναθαν καὶ Σιμων καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς Βαιθβασι τὴν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὰ καθῃρημένα αὐτῆς καὶ ἐστερέωσαν αὐτήν

text_en: And when Bacchides knew it, he gathered together all his multitude: and sent word to them that were of Judea .
text_la: Et cognovit Bacchides, et congregavit universam multitudinem suam : et his, qui de Judæa erant, denuntiavit.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Βακχίδης καὶ συνήγαγεν πᾶν τὸ πλῆθος αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῖς ἐκ τῆς Ιουδαίας παρήγγειλεν

text_en: And he came, and camped above Bethbessen, and fought against it many days, and made engines.
text_la: Et venit, et castra posuit desuper Bethbessen : et oppugnavit eam dies multos, et fecit machinas.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν παρενέβαλεν ἐπὶ Βαιθβασι καὶ ἐπολέμησεν αὐτὴν ἡμέρας πολλὰς καὶ ἐποίησεν μηχανάς

text_en: But Jonathan left his brother, Simon, in the city and went forth into the country, and came with a number of men ,
text_la: Et reliquit Jonathas Simonem fratrem suum in civitate, et exiit in regionem, et venit cum numero:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέλιπεν Ιωναθαν Σιμωνα τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τὴν χώραν καὶ ἦλθεν ἐν ἀριθμῷ

text_en: and struck Odares, and his brethren, and the children of Phaseron, in their tents, and he began to slay, and to increase in forces.
text_la: et percussit Odaren et fratres ejus, et filios Phaseron in tabernaculis ipsorum : et cœpit cædere, et crescere in virtutibus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν Οδομηρα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς Φασιρων ἐν τῷ σκηνώματι αὐτῶν καὶ ἤρξαντο τύπτειν καὶ ἀνέβαινον ἐν ταῖς δυνάμεσιν

text_en: But Simon, and they that were with him, sallied out of the city, and burnt the engines,
text_la: Simon vero, et qui cum ipso erant, exierunt de civitate, et succenderunt machinas,
text_el: καὶ Σιμων καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐνεπύρισαν τὰς μηχανάς

text_en: and they fought against Bacchides, and he was discomfited by them: and they afflicted him exceedingly, for his counsel, and his enterprise was in vain.
text_la: et pugnaverunt contra Bacchidem, et contritus est ab eis : et afflixerunt eum valde, quoniam consilium ejus et congressus ejus erat inanis.
text_el: καὶ ἐπολέμησαν πρὸς τὸν Βακχίδην καὶ συνετρίβη ὑπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἔθλιβον αὐτὸν σφόδρα ὅτι ἦν ἡ βουλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ ἔφοδος αὐτοῦ κενή

text_en: And he was angry with the wicked men that had given him counsel to come into their country, and he slew many of them: and he purposed to return with the rest into their country.
text_la: Et iratus contra viros iniquos, qui ei consilium dederant ut veniret in regionem ipsorum, multos ex eis occidit : ipse autem cogitavit cum reliquis abire in regionem suam.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη ἐν θυμῷ τοῖς ἀνδράσιν τοῖς ἀνόμοις τοῖς συμβουλεύσασιν αὐτῷ ἐλθεῖν εἰς τὴν χώραν καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν ἐξ αὐτῶν πολλοὺς καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο τοῦ ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Jonathan had knowledge of it, and he sent ambassadors to him to make peace with him, and to restore to him the prisoners.
text_la: Et cognovit Jonathas : et misit ad eum legatos componere pacem cum ipso, et reddere ei captivitatem.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέγνω Ιωναθαν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρέσβεις τοῦ συνθέσθαι πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰρήνην καὶ ἀποδοῦναι αὐτοῖς τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν

text_en: And he accepted it willingly, and did according to his words, and swore that he would do him no harm all the days of his life.
text_la: Et libenter accepit, et fecit secundum verba ejus, et juravit se nihil facturum ei mali omnibus diebus vitæ ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεδέξατο καὶ ἐποίησεν κατὰ τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ μὴ ἐκζητῆσαι αὐτῷ κακὸν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he restored to him the prisoners which he before had taken out of the land of Juda : and he returned, and went away into his own country, and he came no more into their borders.
text_la: Et reddidit ei captivitatem, quam prius erat prædatus de terra Juda : et conversus abiit in terram suam, et non apposuit amplius venire in fines ejus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν ἣν ᾐχμαλώτευσεν τὸ πρότερον ἐκ γῆς Ιουδα καὶ ἀποστρέψας ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐ προσέθετο ἔτι ἐλθεῖν εἰς τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν

text_en: So the sword ceased from Israel : and Jonathan dwelt in Machmas, and Jonathan began there to judge the people, and he destroyed the wicked out of Israel .
text_la: Et cessavit gladius ex Israël : et habitavit Jonathas in Machmas, et cœpit Jonathas ibi judicare populum, et exterminavit impios ex Israël.
text_el: καὶ κατέπαυσεν ῥομφαία ἐξ Ισραηλ καὶ ᾤκησεν Ιωναθαν ἐν Μαχμας καὶ ἤρξατο Ιωναθαν κρίνειν τὸν λαὸν καὶ ἠφάνισεν τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς ἐξ Ισραηλ

text_en: Now in the hundred and sixtieth year, Alexander, the son of Antiochus, surnamed the Illustrious, came up and took Ptolemais , and they received him, and he reigned there.
text_la: Et anno centesimo sexagesimo, ascendit Alexander Antiochi filius, qui cognominatus est Nobilis, et occupavit Ptolemaidam : et receperunt eum, et regnavit illic.
text_pt: Provérbios de Salomão: O filho sábio alegra a seu pai, mas o filho insensato é a tristeza de sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἔτει ἑξηκοστῷ καὶ ἑκατοστῷ ἀνέβη Ἀλέξανδρος ὁ τοῦ Ἀντιόχου ὁ Ἐπιφανὴς καὶ κατελάβετο Πτολεμαίδα καὶ ἐπεδέξαντο αὐτόν καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And King Demetrius heard of it, and gathered together an exceeding great army, and went forth against him to fight.
text_la: Et audivit Demetrius rex, et congregavit exercitum copiosum valde, et exivit obviam illi in prælium.
text_pt: Os tesouros da impiedade de nada aproveitam; mas a justiça livra da morte.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Δημήτριος ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ συνήγαγεν δυνάμεις πολλὰς σφόδρα καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: And Demetrius sent a letter to Jonathan , with peaceable words, to magnify him.
text_la: Et misit Demetrius epistolam ad Jonathan verbis pacificis, ut magnificaret eum.
text_pt: O Senhor não deixa o justo passar fome, mas rechaça a aspiração dos perversos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Δημήτριος πρὸς Ιωναθαν ἐπιστολὰς λόγοις εἰρηνικοῖς ὥστε μεγαλῦναι αὐτόν

text_en: For he said: Let us first make a peace with him, before he make one with Alexander against us.
text_la: Dixit enim : Anticipemus facere pacem cum eo, priusquam faciat cum Alexandro adversum nos:
text_pt: O que trabalha com mão displicente empobrece, mas a mão dos diligentes enriquece.
text_el: εἶπεν γάρ προφθάσωμεν τοῦ εἰρήνην θεῖναι μετ' αὐτῶν πρὶν ἢ θεῖναι αὐτὸν μετὰ Ἀλεξάνδρου καθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: For he will remember all the evils that we have done against him, and against his brother, and against his nation.
text_la: recordabitur enim omnium malorum, quæ fecimus in eum, et in fratrem ejus, et in gentem ejus.
text_pt: O que ajunta no verão é filho ajuizado, mas o que dorme na sega é filho que envergonha.
text_el: μνησθήσεται γὰρ πάντων τῶν κακῶν ὧν συνετελέσαμεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς τὸ ἔθνος

text_en: And he gave him authority to gather together a army, and to make arms, and that he should be his confederate: and the hostages that were in the castle, he commanded to be delivered to him.
text_la: Et dedit ei potestatem congregandi exercitum, et fabricare arma, et esse ipsum socium ejus : et obsides, qui erant in arce, jussit tradi ei.
text_pt: Bênçãos há sobre a cabeça do justo, mas a violência cobre a boca dos perversos.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν συναγαγεῖν δυνάμεις καὶ κατασκευάζειν ὅπλα καὶ εἶναι αὐτὸν σύμμαχον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ὅμηρα τὰ ἐν τῇ ἄκρᾳ εἶπεν παραδοῦναι αὐτῷ

text_en: And Jonathan came to Jerusalem , and read the letters in the hearing of all the people, and of them that were in the castle.
text_la: Et venit Jonathas in Jerusalem, et legit epistolas in auditu omnis populi, et eorum qui in arce erant.
text_pt: A memória do justo é abençoada, mas o nome dos perversos apodrecerá.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ιωναθαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀνέγνω τὰς ἐπιστολὰς εἰς τὰ ὦτα παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας

text_en: And they were struck with great fear, because they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an army.
text_la: Et timuerunt timore magno, quoniam audierunt quod dedit ei rex potestatem congregandi exercitum.
text_pt: O sábio de coração aceita os mandamentos, mas o insensato de lábios ficará transtornado.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν ὅτε ἤκουσαν ὅτι ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐξουσίαν συναγαγεῖν δύναμιν

text_en: And the hostages were delivered to Jonathan , and he restored them to their parents.
text_la: Et traditi sunt Jonathæ obsides, et reddidit eos parentibus suis:
text_pt: Quem anda em sinceridade, anda seguro; mas o que perverte os seus caminhos ficará conhecido.
text_el: καὶ παρέδωκαν οἱ ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας Ιωναθαν τὰ ὅμηρα καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτοὺς τοῖς γονεῦσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Jonathan dwelt in Jerusalem , and began to build, and to repair the city.
text_la: et habitavit Jonathas in Jerusalem, et cœpit ædificare et innovare civitatem.
text_pt: O que acena com os olhos causa dores, e o tolo de lábios ficará transtornado.
text_el: καὶ ᾤκησεν Ιωναθαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἤρξατο οἰκοδομεῖν καὶ καινίζειν τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And he ordered workmen to build the walls, and mount Sion round about with square stones for fortification: and so they did.
text_la: Et dixit facientibus opera ut exstruerent muros, et montem Sion in circuitu lapidibus quadratis ad munitionem : et ita fecerunt.
text_pt: A boca do justo é fonte de vida, mas a violência cobre a boca dos perversos.
