text_pt: O justo é mais excelente do que o seu próximo, mas o caminho dos ímpios faz errar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν κατασκόπους εἰς τὴν παρεμβολὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ ὅτι οὕτως τάσσονται ἐπιπεσεῖν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὴν νύκτα

text_en: And when the sun was set, Jonathan commanded his men to watch, and to be in arms all night long ready to fight, and he set sentinels round about the camp.
text_la: Cum occidisset autem sol, præcepit Jonathas suis vigilare, et esse in armis paratos ad pugnam tota nocte : et posuit custodes per circuitum castrorum.
text_pt: O preguiçoso deixa de assar a sua caça, mas ser diligente é o precioso bem do homem.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἔδυ ὁ ἥλιος ἐπέταξεν Ιωναθαν τοῖς παρ' αὐτοῦ γρηγορεῖν καὶ εἶναι ἐπὶ τοῖς ὅπλοις ἑτοιμάζεσθαι εἰς πόλεμον δι' ὅλης τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ ἐξέβαλεν προφύλακας κύκλῳ τῆς παρεμβολῆς

text_en: And the enemies heard that Jonathan and his men were ready for battle: and they were struck with fear and dread in their heart: and they kindled fires in their camp.
text_la: Et audierunt adversarii quod paratus est Jonathas cum suis in bello : et timuerunt, et formidaverunt in corde suo : et accenderunt focos in castris suis.
text_pt: Na vereda da justiça está a vida, e no caminho da sua carreira não há morte.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν οἱ ὑπεναντίοι ὅτι ἡτοίμασται Ιωναθαν καὶ οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ εἰς πόλεμον καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν καὶ ἔπτηξαν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέκαυσαν πυρὰς ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: But Jonathan , and they that were with him, knew it not till the morning: for they saw the lights burning.
text_la: Jonathas autem, et qui cum eo erant, non cognoverunt usque mane : videbant autem luminaria ardentia,
text_el: Ιωναθαν δὲ καὶ οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἕως πρωί ἔβλεπον γὰρ τὰ φῶτα καιόμενα

text_en: And Jonathan pursued after them, but overtook them not: for they had passed the river Eleutherus.
text_la: et secutus est eos Jonathas, et non comprehendit eos : transierant enim flumen Eleutherum.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Ιωναθαν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ κατέλαβεν αὐτούς διέβησαν γὰρ τὸν Ἐλεύθερον ποταμόν

text_en: And Jonathan turned upon the Arabians, that are called Zabadeans: and he defeated them, and took the spoils of them.
text_la: Et divertit Jonathas ad Arabas, qui vocantur Zabadæi : et percussit eos, et accepit spolia eorum.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέκλινεν Ιωναθαν ἐπὶ τοὺς Ἄραβας τοὺς καλουμένους Ζαβαδαίους καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῶν

text_en: And he went forward, and came to Damascus , and passed through all that country.
text_la: Et junxit, et venit Damascum, et perambulabat omnem regionem illam.
text_el: καὶ ἀναζεύξας ἦλθεν εἰς Δαμασκὸν καὶ διώδευσεν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ χώρᾳ

text_en: Simon also went forth, and came as far as Ascalon , and the neighbouring fortresses, and he turned aside to Joppe , and took possession of it,
text_la: Simon autem exiit, et venit usque ad Ascalonem, et ad proxima præsidia : et declinavit in Joppen, et occupavit eam
text_el: καὶ Σιμων ἐξῆλθεν καὶ διώδευσεν ἕως Ἀσκαλῶνος καὶ τὰ πλησίον ὀχυρώματα καὶ ἐξέκλινεν εἰς Ιοππην καὶ προκατελάβετο αὐτήν

text_en: (for he heard that they designed to deliver the hold to them that took part with Demetrius) and he put a garrison there to keep it.
text_la: (audivit enim quod vellent præsidium tradere partibus Demetrii), et posuit ibi custodes ut custodirent eam.
text_el: ἤκουσεν γὰρ ὅτι βούλονται τὸ ὀχύρωμα παραδοῦναι τοῖς παρὰ Δημητρίου καὶ ἔθετο ἐκεῖ φρουράν ὅπως φυλάσσωσιν αὐτήν

text_en: And Jonathan came back, and called together the ancients of the people; and he took a resolution with them to build fortresses in Judea ,
text_la: Et reversus est Jonathas, et convocavit seniores populi, et cogitavit cum eis ædificare præsidia in Judæa,
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Ιωναθαν καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐβουλεύετο μετ' αὐτῶν τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι ὀχυρώματα ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ

text_en: and to build up walls in Jerusalem , and raise a mount between the castle and the city, to separate it from the city, that so it might have no communication, and that they might neither buy nor sell.
text_la: et ædificare muros in Jerusalem, et exaltare altitudinem magnam inter medium arcis et civitatis, ut separaret eam a civitate, ut esset ipsa singulariter, et neque emant, neque vendant.
text_el: καὶ προσυψῶσαι τὰ τείχη Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὑψῶσαι ὕψος μέγα ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς ἄκρας καὶ τῆς πόλεως εἰς τὸ διαχωρίζειν αὐτὴν τῆς πόλεως ἵνα ᾖ αὕτη κατὰ μόνας ὅπως μήτε ἀγοράζωσιν μήτε πωλῶσιν

text_en: And they came together to build up the city: for the wall that was upon the brook, towards the east, was broken down, and he repaired that which is called Caphetetha:
text_la: Et convenerunt ut ædificarent civitatem : et cecidit murus qui erat super torrentem ab ortu solis, et reparavit eum, qui vocatur Caphetetha:
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν τοῦ οἰκοδομεῖν τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἔπεσεν τοῦ τείχους τοῦ χειμάρρου τοῦ ἐξ ἀπηλιώτου καὶ ἐπεσκεύασεν τὸ καλούμενον Χαφεναθα

text_en: And Simon built Adiada in Sephela, and fortified it, and set up gates and bars.
text_la: et Simon ædificavit Adiada in Sephela, et munivit eam, et imposuit portas et seras.
text_el: καὶ Σιμων ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Αδιδα ἐν τῇ Σεφηλα καὶ ὠχύρωσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐπέστησεν θύρας καὶ μοχλούς

text_en: Now when Tryphon had conceived a design to make himself king of Asia and to take the crown, and to stretch out his hand against King Antiochus:
text_la: Et cum cogitasset Tryphon regnare Asiæ, et assumere diadema, et extendere manum in Antiochum regem:
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτησεν Τρύφων βασιλεῦσαι τῆς Ἀσίας καὶ περιθέσθαι τὸ διάδημα καὶ ἐκτεῖναι χεῖρα ἐπ' Ἀντίοχον τὸν βασιλέα

text_en: Fearing lest Jonathan would not allow him, but would fight against him: he sought to seize upon him, and to kill him. So he rose up and came to Bethsan .
text_la: timens ne forte non permitteret eum Jonathas, sed pugnaret adversus eum, quærebat comprehendere eum, et occidere. Et exsurgens abiit in Bethsan.
text_el: καὶ εὐλαβήθη μήποτε οὐκ ἐάσῃ αὐτὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ μήποτε πολεμήσῃ πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἐζήτει συλλαβεῖν αὐτὸν τοῦ ἀπολέσαι καὶ ἀπάρας ἦλθεν εἰς Βαιθσαν

text_en: And Jonathan went out to meet him with forty thousand men chosen for battle, and came to Bethsan .
text_la: Et exivit Jonathas obviam illi cum quadraginta millibus virorum electorum in prælium, et venit Bethsan.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιωναθαν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτῷ ἐν τεσσαράκοντα χιλιάσιν ἀνδρῶν ἐπιλελεγμέναις εἰς παράταξιν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Βαιθσαν

text_en: Now when Tryphon saw that Jonathan came with a great army, he dared not stretch forth his hand against him.
text_la: Et vidit Tryphon quia venit Jonathas cum exercitu multo ut extenderet in eum manus : timuit,
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Τρύφων ὅτι ἦλθεν μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς καὶ ἐκτεῖναι χεῖρας ἐπ' αὐτὸν εὐλαβήθη

text_en: But received him with honour, and commended him to all his friends, and gave him presents: and he commanded his troops to obey him, as himself.
text_la: et excepit eum cum honore, et commendavit eum omnibus amicis suis, et dedit ei munera : et præcepit exercitibus suis ut obedirent ei, sicut sibi.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεδέξατο αὐτὸν ἐνδόξως καὶ συνέστησεν αὐτὸν πᾶσιν τοῖς φίλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ δόματα καὶ ἐπέταξεν τοῖς φίλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ταῖς δυνάμεσιν αὐτοῦ ὑπακούειν αὐτοῦ ὡς αὑτοῦ

text_en: And he said to Jonathan : Why have you troubled all the people, whereas we have no war ?
text_la: Et dixit Jonathæ : Ut quid vexasti universum populum, cum bellum nobis non sit?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιωναθαν ἵνα τί ἐκόπωσας πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον πολέμου μὴ ἐνεστηκότος ἡμῖν

text_en: Now, therefore, send them back to their own houses: and choose you a few men that may be with you, and come with me to Ptolemais , and I will deliver it to you, and the rest of the strong holds, and the army, and all that have any charge, and I will return and go away: for this is the cause of my coming.
text_la: et nunc remitte eos in domos suas : elige autem tibi viros paucos, qui tecum sint, et veni mecum Ptolemaidam, et tradam eam tibi, et reliqua præsidia, et exercitum, et universos præpositos negotii : et conversus abibo : propterea enim veni.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀπόστειλον αὐτοὺς εἰς τοὺς οἴκους αὐτῶν ἐπίλεξαι δὲ σεαυτῷ ἄνδρας ὀλίγους οἵτινες ἔσονται μετὰ σοῦ καὶ δεῦρο μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς Πτολεμαίδα καὶ παραδώσω σοι αὐτὴν καὶ τὰ λοιπὰ ὀχυρώματα καὶ τὰς δυνάμεις τὰς λοιπὰς καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἐπὶ τῶν χρειῶν καὶ ἐπιστρέψας ἀπελεύσομαι τούτου γὰρ χάριν πάρειμι

text_en: And Jonathan believed him, and did as he said: and sent away his army, and they departed into the land of Juda :
text_la: Et credidit ei, et fecit sicut dixit : et dimisit exercitum, et abierunt in terram Juda.
text_el: καὶ ἐμπιστεύσας αὐτῷ ἐποίησεν καθὼς εἶπεν καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν τὰς δυνάμεις καὶ ἀπῆλθον εἰς γῆν Ιουδα

text_en: But he kept with him three thousand men : of whom he sent two thousand into Galilee , and one thousand went with him.
text_la: Retinuit autem secum tria millia virorum : ex quibus remisit in Galilæam duo millia : mille autem venerunt cum eo.
text_el: κατέλιπεν δὲ μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ ἄνδρας τρισχιλίους ὧν δισχιλίους ἀφῆκεν ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ χίλιοι δὲ συνῆλθον αὐτῷ

text_en: Now as soon as Jonathan entered into Ptolemais , they of Ptolemais shut the gates of the city, and took him: and all them that came in with him they slew with the sword.
text_la: Ut autem intravit Ptolemaidam Jonathas, clauserunt portas civitatis Ptolemenses, et comprehenderunt eum : et omnes qui cum eo intraverant, gladio interfecerunt.
text_el: ὡς δὲ εἰσῆλθεν Ιωναθαν εἰς Πτολεμαίδα ἀπέκλεισαν οἱ Πτολεμαεῖς τὰς πύλας καὶ συνέλαβον αὐτόν καὶ πάντας τοὺς συνεισελθόντας μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀπέκτειναν ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ

text_en: Then Tryphon sent an army and horsemen into Galilee , and into the great plain, to destroy all Jonathan's company.
text_la: Et misit Tryphon exercitum et equites in Galilæam et in campum magnum, ut perderent omnes socios Jonathæ.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Τρύφων δυνάμεις καὶ ἵππον εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὸ πεδίον τὸ μέγα τοῦ ἀπολέσαι πάντας τοὺς παρὰ Ιωναθου

text_en: But they, when they understood that Jonathan , and all that were with him, were taken and slain, encouraged one another, and went out ready for battle.
text_la: At illi cum cognovissent quia comprehensus est Jonathas, et periit, et omnes qui cum eo erant, hortati sunt semetipsos, et exierunt parati in prælium.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέγνωσαν ὅτι συνελήμφθη καὶ ἀπόλωλεν καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ παρεκάλεσαν ἑαυτοὺς καὶ ἐπορεύοντο συνεστραμμένοι ἕτοιμοι εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: Then they that had come after them, seeing that they stood for their lives, returned back.
text_la: Et videntes hi qui insecuti fuerant, quia pro anima res est illis, reversi sunt:
text_el: καὶ εἶδον οἱ διώκοντες ὅτι περὶ ψυχῆς αὐτοῖς ἐστιν καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν

text_en: Whereupon they all came peaceably into the land of Juda and they bewailed Jonathan , and them that had been with him, exceedingly: and Israel mourned with great lamentation.
text_la: illi autem venerunt omnes cum pace in terram Juda. Et planxerunt Jonathan, et eos qui cum ipso fuerant, valde : et luxit Israël luctu magno.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πάντες μετ' εἰρήνης εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ ἐπένθησαν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν σφόδρα καὶ ἐπένθησεν πᾶς Ισραηλ πένθος μέγα

text_en: Then all the heathens that were round about them, sought to destroy them. For they said:
text_la: Et quæsierunt omnes gentes quæ erant in circuitu eorum conterere eos: dixerunt enim:
text_el: καὶ ἐζήτησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ κύκλῳ αὐτῶν ἐκτρῖψαι αὐτούς εἶπον γάρ

text_en: They have no prince, nor any to help them: now therefore, let us make war upon them, and take away the memory of them from amongst men .
text_la: Non habent principem et adjuvantem : nunc ergo expugnemus illos, et tollamus de hominibus memoriam eorum.
text_el: οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἄρχοντα καὶ βοηθοῦντα νῦν οὖν πολεμήσωμεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐξάρωμεν ἐξ ἀνθρώπων τὸ μνημόσυνον αὐτῶν

text_en: Now Simon heard that Tryphon was gathering together a very great army to invade the land of Juda , and to destroy it.
text_la: Et audivit Simon quod congregavit Tryphon exercitum copiosum ut veniret in terram Juda, et attereret eam.
text_pt: O filho sábio atende à instrução do pai; mas o escarnecedor não ouve a repreensão.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σιμων ὅτι συνήγαγεν Τρύφων δύναμιν πολλὴν τοῦ ἐλθεῖν εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ ἐκτρῖψαι αὐτήν

text_en: And seeing that the people was in dread and in fear, he went up to Jerusalem , and assembled the people,
text_la: Videns quia in tremore populus est, et in timore, ascendit Jerusalem, et congregavit populum:
text_pt: Do fruto da boca cada um comerá o bem, mas a alma dos prevaricadores comerá a violência.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν τὸν λαόν ὅτι ἔντρομός ἐστιν καὶ ἔκφοβος καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἤθροισεν τὸν λαὸν

text_en: and exhorted them, saying: You know what great battles I and my brethren, and the house of my father, have fought for the laws, and the sanctuary, and the distresses that we have seen:
text_la: et adhortans dixit : Vos scitis quanta ego, et fratres mei, et domus patris mei, fecimus pro legibus et pro sanctis, prælia, et angustias quales vidimus:
text_pt: O que guarda a sua boca conserva a sua alma, mas o que abre muito os seus lábios se destrói.
text_el: καὶ παρεκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς αὐτοὶ οἴδατε ὅσα ἐγὼ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ πατρός μου ἐποιήσαμεν περὶ τῶν νόμων καὶ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τοὺς πολέμους καὶ τὰς στενοχωρίας ἃς εἴδομεν

text_en: By reason whereof all my brethren have lost their lives for Israel's sake, and I am left alone.
text_la: horum gratia perierunt fratres mei omnes propter Israël, et relictus sum ego solus.
text_pt: A alma do preguiçoso deseja, e coisa nenhuma alcança, mas a alma dos diligentes se farta.
text_el: τούτου χάριν ἀπώλοντο οἱ ἀδελφοί μου πάντες χάριν τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ κατελείφθην ἐγὼ μόνος

text_en: And now far be it from me to spare my life in any time of trouble: for I am not better than my brethren.
text_la: Et nunc non mihi contingat parcere animæ meæ in omni tempore tribulationis : non enim melior sum fratribus meis.
text_pt: O justo odeia a palavra de mentira, mas o ímpio faz vergonha e se confunde.
text_el: καὶ νῦν μή μοι γένοιτο φείσασθαί μου τῆς ψυχῆς ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ θλίψεως οὐ γάρ εἰμι κρείσσων τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου

text_en: I will avenge then my nation and the sanctuary, and our children, and wives: for all the heathens are gathered together to destroy us out of mere malice.
text_la: Vindicabo itaque gentem meam, et sancta, natos quoque nostros, et uxores : quia congregatæ sunt universæ gentes conterere nos inimicitiæ gratia.
text_pt: A justiça guarda ao que é de caminho certo, mas a impiedade transtornará o pecador.
text_el: πλὴν ἐκδικήσω περὶ τοῦ ἔθνους μου καὶ περὶ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ περὶ τῶν γυναικῶν καὶ τέκνων ὑμῶν ὅτι συνήχθησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη ἐκτρῖψαι ἡμᾶς ἔχθρας χάριν

text_en: And the spirit of the people was enkindled as soon as they heard these words:
text_la: Et accensus est spiritus populi simul ut audivit sermones istos:
text_pt: Há alguns que se fazem de ricos, e não têm coisa nenhuma, e outros que se fazem de pobres e têm muitas riquezas.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεζωπύρησεν τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ λαοῦ ἅμα τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι τῶν λόγων τούτων

text_en: And they answered with a loud voice, saying: You are our leader in the place of Judas , and Jonathan , your brother:
text_la: et responderunt voce magna, dicentes : Tu es dux noster loco Judæ, et Jonathæ fratris tui:
text_pt: O resgate da vida de cada um são as suas riquezas, mas o pobre não ouve ameaças.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες σὺ εἶ ἡμῶν ἡγούμενος ἀντὶ Ιουδου καὶ Ιωναθου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου

text_en: Fight our battles, and we will do whatsoever you shall say to us.
text_la: pugna prælium nostrum : et omnia, quæcumque dixeris nobis, faciemus.
text_pt: A luz dos justos alegra, mas a candeia dos ímpios se apagará.
text_el: πολέμησον τὸν πόλεμον ἡμῶν καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἂν εἴπῃς ἡμῖν ποιήσομεν

text_en: So gathering together all the men of war , he made haste to finish all the walls of Jerusalem , and he fortified it round about.
text_la: Et congregans omnes viros bellatores, acceleravit consummare universos muros Jerusalem, et munivit eam in gyro.
text_pt: Da soberba só provém a contenda, mas com os que se aconselham se acha a sabedoria.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν πάντας τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς πολεμιστὰς καὶ ἐτάχυνεν τοῦ τελέσαι τὰ τείχη Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὠχύρωσεν αὐτὴν κυκλόθεν

text_en: And he sent Jonathan , the son of Absalom , and with him a new army, into Joppe , and he cast out them that were in it, and himself remained there.
text_la: Et misit Jonathan filium Absalomi, et cum eo exercitum novum in Joppen, et ejectis his qui erant in ea, remansit illic ipse.
text_pt: A riqueza de procedência vã diminuirá, mas quem a ajunta com o próprio trabalho a aumentará.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ιωναθαν τὸν τοῦ Αψαλωμου καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ δύναμιν ἱκανὴν εἰς Ιοππην καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τοὺς ὄντας ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And Tryphon removed from Ptolemais with a great army, to invade the land of Juda , and Jonathan was with him in custody.
text_la: Et movit Tryphon a Ptolemaida cum exercitu multo, ut veniret in terram Juda, et Jonathas cum eo in custodia.
text_pt: A esperança adiada desfalece o coração, mas o desejo atendido é árvore de vida.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν Τρύφων ἀπὸ Πτολεμαίδος μετὰ δυνάμεως πολλῆς ἐλθεῖν εἰς γῆν Ιουδα καὶ Ιωναθαν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν φυλακῇ

text_en: But Simon pitched in Addus, over against the plain.
text_la: Simon autem applicuit in Addus contra faciem campi.
text_pt: O que despreza a palavra perecerá, mas o que teme o mandamento será galardoado.
text_el: Σιμων δὲ παρενέβαλεν ἐν Αδιδοις κατὰ πρόσωπον τοῦ πεδίου

text_en: And when Tryphon understood that Simon was risen up in the place of his brother, Jonathan , and that he meant to join battle with him, he sent messengers to him,
text_la: Et ut cognovit Tryphon quia surrexit Simon loco fratris sui Jonathæ, et quia commissurus esset cum eo prælium, misit ad eum legatos,
text_pt: A doutrina do sábio é uma fonte de vida para se desviar dos laços da morte.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέγνω Τρύφων ὅτι ἀνέστη Σιμων ἀντὶ Ιωναθου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅτι συνάπτειν αὐτῷ μέλλει πόλεμον καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν πρέσβεις λέγων

text_en: saying: We have detained your brother, Jonathan , for the money that he owed in the king's account, by reason of the affairs which he had the management of.
text_la: dicens : Pro argento, quod debebat frater tuus Jonathas in ratione regis propter negotia quæ habuit, detinuimus eum.
text_pt: O bom entendimento favorece, mas o caminho dos prevaricadores é áspero.
text_el: περὶ ἀργυρίου οὗ ὤφειλεν Ιωναθαν ὁ ἀδελφός σου εἰς τὸ βασιλικὸν δι' ἃς εἶχεν χρείας συνέχομεν αὐτόν

text_en: But now send a hundred talents of silver, and his two sons for hostages, that when he is set at liberty he may not revolt from us, and we will release him.
text_la: Et nunc mitte argenti talenta centum, et duos filios ejus obsides, ut non dimissus fugiat a nobis, et remittemus eum.
text_pt: Todo prudente procede com conhecimento, mas o insensato espraia a sua loucura.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἀπόστειλον ἀργυρίου τάλαντα ἑκατὸν καὶ δύο τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ὅμηρα ὅπως μὴ ἀφεθεὶς ἀποστατήσῃ ἀφ' ἡμῶν καὶ ἀφήσομεν αὐτόν

text_en: Now Simon knew that he spoke deceitfully to him; nevertheless, he ordered the money and the children to be sent, lest he should bring upon himself a great hatred of the people of Israel , who might have said:
text_la: Et cognovit Simon quia cum dolo loqueretur secum : jussit tamen dari argentum et pueros, ne inimicitiam magnam sumeret ad populum Israël, dicentem:
text_pt: O que prega a maldade cai no mal, mas o embaixador fiel é saúde.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Σιμων ὅτι δόλῳ λαλοῦσιν πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ πέμπει τοῦ λαβεῖν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὰ παιδάρια μήποτε ἔχθραν ἄρῃ μεγάλην πρὸς τὸν λαὸν

text_en: Because he sent not the money and the children therefore is he lost.
text_la: Quia non misit ei argentum, et pueros, propterea periit.
text_pt: Pobreza e afronta virão ao que rejeita a instrução, mas o que guarda a repreensão será honrado.
text_el: λέγοντες ὅτι οὐκ ἀπέστειλα αὐτῷ τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὰ παιδάρια ἀπώλετο

text_en: So he sent the children and the hundred talents and he lied, and did not let Jonathan go.
text_la: Et misit pueros, et centum talenta : et mentitus est, et non dimisit Jonathan.
text_pt: O desejo que se alcança deleita a alma, mas apartar-se do mal é abominável para os insensatos.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὰ παιδάρια καὶ τὰ ἑκατὸν τάλαντα καὶ διεψεύσατο καὶ οὐκ ἀφῆκεν τὸν Ιωναθαν

text_en: And after this, Tryphon entered within the country, to destroy it: and they went about by the way that leads to Ador: and Simon and his army marched to every place wherever they went.
text_la: Et post hæc venit Tryphon intra regionem, ut contereret eam : et gyraverunt per viam quæ ducit Ador : et Simon et castra ejus ambulabant in omnem locum quocumque ibant.
text_pt: O que anda com os sábios ficará sábio, mas o companheiro dos tolos será destruído.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν Τρύφων τοῦ ἐμβατεῦσαι εἰς τὴν χώραν καὶ ἐκτρῖψαι αὐτήν καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν ὁδὸν τὴν εἰς Αδωρα καὶ Σιμων καὶ ἡ παρεμβολὴ αὐτοῦ ἀντιπαρῆγεν αὐτῷ εἰς πάντα τόπον οὗ ἂν ἐπορεύετο

text_en: And they that were in the castle, sent messengers to Tryphon, that he should make haste to come through the desert , and send them victuals.
text_la: Qui autem in arce erant, miserunt ad Tryphonem legatos, ut festinaret venire per desertum, et mitteret illis alimonias.
text_pt: O mal perseguirá os pecadores, mas os justos serão galardoados com o bem.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας ἀπέστελλον πρὸς Τρύφωνα πρεσβευτὰς κατασπεύδοντας αὐτὸν τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς αὐτοὺς διὰ τῆς ἐρήμου καὶ ἀποστεῖλαι αὐτοῖς τροφάς

text_en: And Tryphon made ready all his horsemen to come that night; but there fell a very great snow, and he came not into the country of Galaad.
text_la: Et paravit Tryphon omnem equitatum, ut veniret illa nocte : erat autem nix multa valde, et non venit in Galaaditim.
text_pt: O homem de bem deixa uma herança aos filhos de seus filhos, mas a riqueza do pecador é depositada para o justo.
text_el: καὶ ἡτοίμασεν Τρύφων πᾶσαν τὴν ἵππον αὐτοῦ ἐλθεῖν καὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ ἦν χιὼν πολλὴ σφόδρα καὶ οὐκ ἦλθεν διὰ τὴν χιόνα καὶ ἀπῆρεν καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλααδῖτιν

text_en: And when he approached to Bascama, he slew Jonathan and his sons there.
text_la: Et cum appropinquasset Bascaman, occidit Jonathan et filios ejus illic.
text_pt: O pobre, do sulco da terra, tira mantimento em abundância; mas há os que se consomem por falta de juízo.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤγγισεν τῆς Βασκαμα ἀπέκτεινεν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ ἐτάφη ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Tryphon returned, and went into his own country.
text_la: Et convertit Tryphon, et abiit in terram suam.
text_pt: O que não faz uso da vara odeia seu filho, mas o que o ama, desde cedo o castiga.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν Τρύφων καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Simon sent, and took the bones of Jonathan , his brother, and buried them in Modin, the city of his fathers.
text_la: Et misit Simon, et accepit ossa Jonathæ fratris sui, et sepelivit ea in Modin civitate patrum ejus.
text_pt: O justo come até ficar satisfeito, mas o ventre dos ímpios passará necessidade.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σιμων καὶ ἔλαβεν τὰ ὀστᾶ Ιωναθου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθαψεν αὐτὸν ἐν Μωδεϊν πόλει τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all Israel bewailed him with great lamentation: and they mourned for him many days.
text_la: Et planxerunt eum omnis Israël planctu magno, et luxerunt eum dies multos.
text_el: καὶ ἐκόψαντο αὐτὸν πᾶς Ισραηλ κοπετὸν μέγαν καὶ ἐπένθησαν αὐτὸν ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: And Simon built over the sepulchre of his father and of his brethren, a building lofty to the sight, of polished stone, behind and before:
text_la: Et ædificavit Simon super sepulchrum patris sui et fratrum suorum ædificium altum visu, lapide polito retro et ante.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Σιμων ἐπὶ τὸν τάφον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ὕψωσεν αὐτὸν τῇ ὁράσει λίθῳ ξεστῷ ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν καὶ ἔμπροσθεν

text_en: And he set up seven pyramids, one against another, for his father, and his mother, and his four brethren:
text_la: Et statuit septem pyramidas, unam contra unam, patri et matri, et quatuor fratribus:
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν ἑπτὰ πυραμίδας μίαν κατέναντι τῆς μιᾶς τῷ πατρὶ καὶ τῇ μητρὶ καὶ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἀδελφοῖς

text_en: And round about these he set great pillars; and upon the pillars, arms, for a perpetual memory; and by the arms, ships carved, which might be seen by all that sailed on the sea.
text_la: et his circumposuit columnas magnas : et super columnas arma, ad memoriam æternam : et juxta arma naves sculptas, quæ viderentur ab omnibus navigantibus mare:
text_el: καὶ ταύταις ἐποίησεν μηχανήματα περιθεὶς στύλους μεγάλους καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐπὶ τοῖς στύλοις πανοπλίας εἰς ὄνομα αἰώνιον καὶ παρὰ ταῖς πανοπλίαις πλοῖα ἐγγεγλυμμένα εἰς τὸ θεωρεῖσθαι ὑπὸ πάντων τῶν πλεόντων τὴν θάλασσαν

text_en: This is the sepulchre that he made in Modin, even unto this day.
text_la: hoc est sepulchrum, quod fecit in Modin usque in hunc diem.
text_el: οὗτος ὁ τάφος ὃν ἐποίησεν ἐν Μωδεϊν ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: But Tryphon, when he was upon a journey with the young king, Antiochus, treacherously slew him.
text_la: Tryphon autem cum iter faceret cum Antiocho rege adolescente, dolo occidit eum:
text_el: ὁ δὲ Τρύφων ἐπορεύετο δόλῳ μετὰ Ἀντιόχου τοῦ βασιλέως τοῦ νεωτέρου καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτὸν

text_en: And he reigned in his place, and put on the crown of Asia: and brought great evils upon the land.
text_la: et regnavit loco ejus, et imposuit sibi diadema Asiæ, et fecit plagam magnam in terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ περιέθετο τὸ διάδημα τῆς Ἀσίας καὶ ἐποίησεν πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Simon built up the strong holds of Judea , fortifying them with high towers, and great walls, and gates and bars: and he stored up victuals in the fortresses.
text_la: Et ædificavit Simon præsidia Judææ, muniens ea turribus excelsis, et muris magnis, et portis, et seris : et posuit alimenta in munitionibus.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Σιμων τὰ ὀχυρώματα τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ περιετείχισεν πύργοις ὑψηλοῖς καὶ τείχεσιν μεγάλοις καὶ πύλαις καὶ μοχλοῖς καὶ ἔθετο βρώματα ἐν τοῖς ὀχυρώμασιν

text_en: And Simon chose men , and sent to King Demetrius, to the end that he should grant an immunity to the land; for all that Tryphon did, was to spoil.
text_la: Et elegit Simon viros, et misit ad Demetrium regem ut faceret remissionem regioni : quia actus omnes Tryphonis per direptionem fuerant gesti.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέλεξεν Σιμων ἄνδρας καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς Δημήτριον τὸν βασιλέα τοῦ ποιῆσαι ἄφεσιν τῇ χώρᾳ ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ πράξεις Τρύφωνος ἦσαν ἁρπαγαί

text_en: And King Demetrius, in answer to this request, wrote a letter in this manner:
text_la: Et Demetrius rex ad verba ista respondit ei, et scripsit epistolam talem:
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτῷ Δημήτριος ὁ βασιλεὺς κατὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ καὶ ἔγραψεν αὐτῷ ἐπιστολὴν τοιαύτην

text_en: King Demetrius to Simon, the high priest , and friend of kings, and to the ancients, and to the nation of the Jews , greeting:
text_la: Rex Demetrius Simoni summo sacerdoti et amico regum, et senioribus, et genti Judæorum, salutem.
text_el: βασιλεὺς Δημήτριος Σιμωνι ἀρχιερεῖ καὶ φίλῳ βασιλέων καὶ πρεσβυτέροις καὶ ἔθνει Ιουδαίων χαίρειν

text_en: The golden crown, and the palm, which you sent, we have received: and we are ready to make a firm peace with you, and to write to the king's chief officers to release you the things that we have released.
text_la: Coronam auream, et bahem, quam misistis, suscepimus : et parati sumus facere vobiscum pacem magnam, et scribere præpositis regis remittere vobis quæ indulsimus.
text_el: τὸν στέφανον τὸν χρυσοῦν καὶ τὴν βαΐνην ἣν ἀπεστείλατε κεκομίσμεθα καὶ ἕτοιμοί ἐσμεν τοῦ ποιεῖν ὑμῖν εἰρήνην μεγάλην καὶ γράφειν τοῖς ἐπὶ τῶν χρειῶν τοῦ ἀφιέναι ὑμῖν τὰ ἀφέματα

text_en: For all that we have decreed in your favour shall stand in force. The strong holds that you have built, shall be your own.
text_la: Quæcumque enim constituimus, vobis constant : munitiones, quas ædificastis, vobis sint:
text_el: καὶ ὅσα ἐστήσαμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἕστηκεν καὶ τὰ ὀχυρώματα ἃ ᾠκοδομήσατε ὑπαρχέτω ὑμῖν

text_en: And as for any oversight or fault committed unto this day, we forgive it: and the crown which you owed: and if any other thing were taxed in Jerusalem , now let it not be taxed.
text_la: remittimus quoque ignorantias et peccata usque in hodiernum diem, et coronam quam debebatis : et si quid aliud erat tributarium in Jerusalem, jam non sit tributarium.
text_el: ἀφίεμεν δὲ ἀγνοήματα καὶ τὰ ἁμαρτήματα ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας καὶ τὸν στέφανον ὃν ὠφείλετε καὶ εἴ τι ἄλλο ἐτελωνεῖτο ἐν Ιερουσαλημ μηκέτι τελωνείσθω

text_en: And if any of you be fit to be enrolled among ours, let them be enrolled, and let there be peace between us.
text_la: Et si qui ex vobis apti sunt conscribi inter nostros, conscribantur, et sit inter nos pax.
text_el: καὶ εἴ τινες ἐπιτήδειοι ὑμῶν γραφῆναι εἰς τοὺς περὶ ἡμᾶς ἐγγραφέσθωσαν καὶ γινέσθω ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν εἰρήνη

text_en: In the year one hundred and seventy, the yoke of the Gentiles was taken off from Israel .
text_la: Anno centesimo septuagesimo, ablatum est jugum gentium ab Israël.
text_el: ἔτους ἑβδομηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ ἤρθη ὁ ζυγὸς τῶν ἐθνῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: And the people of Israel began to write in the instruments, and public records, The first year under Simon, the high priest , the great captain , and prince of the Jews .
text_la: Et cœpit populus Israël scribere in tabulis, et gestis publicis, anno primo sub Simone summo sacerdote, magno duce, et principe Judæorum.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξατο ὁ λαὸς γράφειν ἐν ταῖς συγγραφαῖς καὶ συναλλάγμασιν ἔτους πρώτου ἐπὶ Σιμωνος ἀρχιερέως μεγάλου καὶ στρατηγοῦ καὶ ἡγουμένου Ιουδαίων

text_en: In those days Simon besieged Gaza , and camped round about it, and he made engines, and set them to the city, and he struck one tower, and took it.
text_la: In diebus illis applicuit Simon ad Gazam, et circumdedit eam castris, et fecit machinas, et applicuit ad civitatem, et percussit turrem unam, et comprehendit eam.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παρενέβαλεν ἐπὶ Γαζαρα καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν αὐτὴν παρεμβολαῖς καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑλεόπολιν καὶ προσήγαγεν τῇ πόλει καὶ ἐπάταξεν πύργον ἕνα καὶ κατελάβετο

text_en: And they that were within the engine leapt into the city: and there was a great uproar in the city.
text_la: Et eruperant qui erant intra machinam in civitatem, et factus est motus magnus in civitate.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήλλοντο οἱ ἐν τῇ ἑλεοπόλει εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ ἐγένετο κίνημα μέγα ἐν τῇ πόλει

text_en: And they that were in the city went up, with their wives and children, upon the wall, with their garments rent, and they cried with a loud voice, beseeching Simon to grant them peace.
text_la: Et ascenderunt qui erant in civitate cum uxoribus et filiis supra murum, scissis tunicis suis, et clamaverunt voce magna, postulantes a Simone dextras sibi dari,
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν οἱ ἐν τῇ πόλει σὺν γυναιξὶν καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ἐπὶ τὸ τεῖχος διερρηχότες τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβόησαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἀξιοῦντες Σιμωνα δεξιὰς αὐτοῖς δοῦναι

text_en: And they said: Deal not with us according to our evil deeds , but according to your mercy.
text_la: et dixerunt : Non nobis reddas secundum malitias nostras, sed secundum misericordias tuas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν μὴ ἡμῖν χρήσῃ κατὰ τὰς πονηρίας ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ ἔλεός σου

text_en: And Simon being moved, did not destroy them but yet he cast them out of the city, and cleansed the houses wherein there had been idols, and then he entered into it with hymns, blessing the Lord :
text_la: Et flexus Simon, non debellavit eos : ejecit tamen eos de civitate, et mundavit ædes in quibus fuerant simulacra, et tunc intravit in eam cum hymnis benedicens Dominum:
text_el: καὶ συνελύθη αὐτοῖς Σιμων καὶ οὐκ ἐπολέμησεν αὐτούς καὶ ἐξέβαλεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἐκαθάρισεν τὰς οἰκίας ἐν αἷς ἦν τὰ εἴδωλα καὶ οὕτως εἰσῆλθεν εἰς αὐτὴν ὑμνῶν καὶ εὐλογῶν

text_en: And having cast out of it all uncleanness , he placed in it men that should observe the law: and he fortified it, and made it his habitation.
text_la: et ejecta ab ea omni immunditia, collocavit in ea viros qui legem facerent : et munivit eam, et fecit sibi habitationem.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ἐξ αὐτῆς πᾶσαν ἀκαθαρσίαν καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρας οἵτινες τὸν νόμον ποιήσωσιν καὶ προσωχύρωσεν αὐτὴν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἑαυτῷ ἐν αὐτῇ οἴκησιν

text_en: But they that were in the castle of Jerusalem were hindered from going out and coming into the country, and from buying and selling: and they were straitened with hunger, and many of them perished through famine.
text_la: Qui autem erant in arce Jerusalem, prohibebantur egredi et ingredi regionem, et emere ac vendere : et esurierunt valde, et multi ex eis fame perierunt,
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἐκ τῆς ἄκρας ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐκωλύοντο ἐκπορεύεσθαι καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθαι εἰς τὴν χώραν ἀγοράζειν καὶ πωλεῖν καὶ ἐπείνασαν σφόδρα καὶ ἀπώλοντο ἐξ αὐτῶν ἱκανοὶ τῷ λιμῷ

text_en: And they cried to Simon for peace, and he granted it to them: and he cast them out from thence and cleansed the castle from uncleannesses .
text_la: et clamaverunt ad Simonem ut dextras acciperent : et dedit illis : et ejecit eos inde, et mundavit arcem a contaminationibus:
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησαν πρὸς Σιμωνα δεξιὰς λαβεῖν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐξέβαλεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖθεν καὶ ἐκαθάρισεν τὴν ἄκραν ἀπὸ τῶν μιασμάτων

text_en: And they entered into it the three and twentieth day of the second month, in the year one hundred and seventy-one, with thanksgiving, and branches of palm trees, and harps, and cymbals, and psalteries, and hymns, and canticles, because the great enemy was destroyed out of Israel .
text_la: et intraverunt in eam tertia et vigesima die secundi mensis, anno centesimo septuagesimo primo, cum laude, et ramis palmarum, et cinyris, et cymbalis, et nablis, et hymnis, et canticis, quia contritus est inimicus magnus ex Israël.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς αὐτὴν τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ δευτέρου μηνὸς ἔτους πρώτου καὶ ἑβδομηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ μετὰ αἰνέσεως καὶ βαΐων καὶ ἐν κινύραις καὶ ἐν κυμβάλοις καὶ ἐν νάβλαις καὶ ἐν ὕμνοις καὶ ἐν ᾠδαῖς ὅτι συνετρίβη ἐχθρὸς μέγας ἐξ Ισραηλ

text_en: And he ordained that these days should be kept every year with gladness.
text_la: Et constituit ut omnibus annis agerentur dies hi cum lætitia.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν τοῦ ἄγειν τὴν ἡμέραν ταύτην μετὰ εὐφροσύνης

text_en: And he fortified the mountain of the temple that was near the castle, and he dwelt there himself, and they that were with him.
text_la: Et munivit montem templi, qui erat secus arcem, et habitavit ibi ipse, et qui cum eo erant.
text_el: καὶ προσωχύρωσεν τὸ ὄρος τοῦ ἱεροῦ τὸ παρὰ τὴν ἄκραν καὶ ᾤκει ἐκεῖ αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Simon saw that John, his son, was a valiant man for war : and he made him captain of all the forces: and he dwelt in Gazara.
text_la: Et vidit Simon Joannem filium suum, quod fortis prælii vir esset : et posuit eum ducem virtutum universarum : et habitavit in Gazaris.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Σιμων τὸν Ιωαννην υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν καὶ ἔθετο αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον τῶν δυνάμεων πασῶν καὶ ᾤκει ἐν Γαζαροις

text_en: In the year one hundred and seventy-two King Demetrius assembled his army, and went into Media to get him succours to fight against Tryphon.
text_la: Anno centesimo septuagesimo secundo, congregavit rex Demetrius exercitum suum, et abiit in Mediam ad contrahenda sibi auxilia, ut expugnaret Tryphonem.
text_pt: Toda mulher sábia edifica a sua casa; mas a tola a derruba com as próprias mãos.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἔτει δευτέρῳ καὶ ἑβδομηκοστῷ καὶ ἑκατοστῷ συνήγαγεν Δημήτριος ὁ βασιλεὺς τὰς δυνάμεις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Μηδίαν τοῦ ἐπισπάσασθαι βοήθειαν ἑαυτῷ ὅπως πολεμήσῃ τὸν Τρύφωνα

text_en: And Arsaces, the king of Persia and Media , heard that Demetrius was entered within his borders, and he sent one of his princes to take him alive, and bring him to him.
text_la: Et audivit Arsaces rex Persidis et Mediæ, quia intravit Demetrius confines suos : et misit unum de principibus suis ut comprehenderet eum vivum, et adduceret eum ad se.
text_pt: O que anda na retidão teme ao Senhor, mas o que se desvia de seus caminhos o despreza.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ἀρσάκης ὁ βασιλεὺς τῆς Περσίδος καὶ Μηδίας ὅτι εἰσῆλθεν Δημήτριος εἰς τὰ ὅρια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἕνα τῶν ἀρχόντων αὐτοῦ συλλαβεῖν αὐτὸν ζῶντα

text_en: And he went, and defeated the army of Demetrius: and took him, and brought him to Arsaces, and he put him into custody.
text_la: Et abiit, et percussit castra Demetrii : et comprehendit eum, et duxit eum ad Arsacem, et posuit eum in custodiam.
text_pt: Na boca do tolo está a punição da soberba, mas os sábios se conservam pelos próprios lábios.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν παρεμβολὴν Δημητρίου καὶ συνέλαβεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἀρσάκην καὶ ἔθετο αὐτὸν ἐν φυλακῇ

text_en: And all the land of Juda was at rest all the days of Simon, and he sought the good of his nation: and his power, and his glory pleased them well all his days.
text_la: Et siluit omnis terra Juda omnibus diebus Simonis, et quæsivit bona genti suæ : et placuit illis potestas ejus et gloria ejus omnibus diebus.
text_pt: Não havendo bois o estábulo fica limpo, mas pela força do boi há abundância de colheita.
text_el: καὶ ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ Ιουδα πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας Σιμωνος καὶ ἐζήτησεν ἀγαθὰ τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤρεσεν αὐτοῖς ἡ ἐξουσία αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ δόξα αὐτοῦ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: And with all his glory he took Joppe for a haven, and made an entrance to the isles of the sea.
text_la: Et cum omni gloria sua accepit Joppen in portum, et fecit introitum in insulis maris.
text_pt: A verdadeira testemunha não mentirá, mas a testemunha falsa se desboca em mentiras.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ πάσης τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἔλαβεν τὴν Ιοππην εἰς λιμένα καὶ ἐποίησεν εἴσοδον ταῖς νήσοις τῆς θαλάσσης

text_en: And he enlarged the bounds of his nation, and made himself master of the country.
text_la: Et dilatavit fines gentis suæ, et obtinuit regionem.
text_pt: O escarnecedor busca sabedoria e não acha nenhuma, para o prudente, porém, o conhecimento é fácil.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλάτυνεν τὰ ὅρια τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκράτησεν τῆς χώρας

text_en: And he gathered together a great number of captives, and had the dominion of Gazara, and of Bethsura, and of the castle: and took away all uncleanness out of it, and there was none that resisted him.
text_la: Et congregavit captivitatem multam, et dominatus est Gazaræ, et Bethsuræ, et arci : et abstulit immunditias ex ea, et non erat qui resisteret ei.
text_pt: Desvia-te do homem insensato, porque nele não acharás lábios de conhecimento.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν αἰχμαλωσίαν πολλὴν καὶ ἐκυρίευσεν Γαζαρων καὶ Βαιθσουρων καὶ τῆς ἄκρας καὶ ἐξῆρεν τὰς ἀκαθαρσίας ἐξ αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀντικείμενος αὐτῷ

text_en: And every man tilled his land with peace, and the land of Juda yielded her increase, and the trees of the fields their fruit.
text_la: Et unusquisque colebat terram suam cum pace : et terra Juda dabat fructus suos, et ligna camporum fructum suum.
text_pt: A sabedoria do prudente é entender o seu caminho, mas a estultícia dos insensatos é engano.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν γεωργοῦντες τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν μετ' εἰρήνης καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐδίδου τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς καὶ τὰ ξύλα τῶν πεδίων τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: The ancient men sat all in the streets, and treated together of the good things of the land, and the young men put on them glory , and the robes of war .
text_la: Seniores in plateis sedebant omnes, et de bonis terræ tractabant, et juvenes induebant se gloriam, et stolas belli.
text_pt: Os insensatos zombam do pecado, mas entre os retos há benevolência.
text_el: πρεσβύτεροι ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἐκάθηντο πάντες περὶ ἀγαθῶν ἐκοινολογοῦντο καὶ οἱ νεανίσκοι ἐνεδύσαντο δόξας καὶ στολὰς πολέμου

text_en: And he provided victuals for the cities, and he appointed that they should be furnished with ammunition, so that the fame of his glory was renowned even to the end of the earth.
text_la: Et civitatibus tribuebat alimonias, et constituebat eas ut essent vasa munitionis quoadusque nominatum est nomen gloriæ ejus usque ad extremum terræ.
text_pt: O coração conhece a sua própria amargura, e o estranho não participará no íntimo da sua alegria.
text_el: ταῖς πόλεσιν ἐχορήγησεν βρώματα καὶ ἔταξεν αὐτὰς ἐν σκεύεσιν ὀχυρώσεως ἕως ὅτου ὠνομάσθη τὸ ὄνομα τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἕως ἄκρου γῆς

text_en: He made peace in the land, and Israel rejoiced with great joy .
text_la: Fecit pacem super terram, et lætatus est Israël lætitia magna.
text_pt: A casa dos ímpios se desfará, mas a tenda dos retos florescerá.
text_el: ἐποίησεν εἰρήνην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ εὐφράνθη Ισραηλ εὐφροσύνην μεγάλην

text_en: And every man sat under his vine, and under his fig tree: and there was none to make them afraid.
text_la: Et sedit unusquisque sub vite sua, et sub ficulnea sua : et non erat qui eos terreret.
text_pt: Há um caminho que ao homem parece direito, mas o fim dele são os caminhos da morte.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἕκαστος ὑπὸ τὴν ἄμπελον αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν συκῆν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἐκφοβῶν αὐτούς

text_en: There was none left in the land to fight against them: kings were discomfited in those days.
text_la: Defecit impugnans eos super terram : reges contriti sunt in diebus illis.
text_pt: Até no riso o coração sente dor e o fim da alegria é tristeza.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέλιπεν πολεμῶν αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς συνετρίβησαν ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις

text_en: And he strengthened all those of his people that were brought low, and he sought the law, and took away every unjust and wicked man .
text_la: Et confirmavit omnes humiles populi sui, et legem exquisivit, et abstulit omnem iniquum et malum:
text_pt: O que no seu coração comete deslize, se enfada dos seus caminhos, mas o homem bom fica satisfeito com o seu proceder.
text_el: καὶ ἐστήρισεν πάντας τοὺς ταπεινοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτοῦ τὸν νόμον ἐξεζήτησεν καὶ ἐξῆρεν πάντα ἄνομον καὶ πονηρόν

text_en: He glorified the sanctuary, and multiplied the vessels of the holy places.
text_la: sancta glorificavit, et multiplicavit vasa sanctorum.
text_pt: O simples dá crédito a cada palavra, mas o prudente atenta para os seus passos.
text_el: τὰ ἅγια ἐδόξασεν καὶ ἐπλήθυνεν τὰ σκεύη τῶν ἁγίων

text_en: And it was heard at Rome, and as far as Sparta, that Jonathan was dead: and they were very sorry.
text_la: Et auditum est Romæ quia defunctus esset Jonathas, et usque in Spartiatas : et contristati sunt valde.
text_pt: O sábio teme, e desvia-se do mal, mas o tolo se encoleriza, e dá-se por seguro.
text_el: καὶ ἠκούσθη ἐν Ῥώμῃ ὅτι ἀπέθανεν Ιωναθαν καὶ ἕως Σπάρτης καὶ ἐλυπήθησαν σφόδρα

text_en: But when they heard that Simon, his brother, was made high priest in his place, and was possessed of all the country, and the cities therein:
text_la: Ut audierunt autem quod Simon frater ejus factus esset summus sacerdos loco ejus, et ipse obtineret omnem regionem, et civitates in ea,
text_pt: O que se indigna à toa fará doidices, e o homem de maus intentos será odiado.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν ὅτι Σιμων ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ γέγονεν ἀρχιερεὺς ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς ἐπικρατεῖ τῆς χώρας καὶ τῶν πόλεων τῶν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: They wrote to him in tables of brass, to renew the friendship and alliance which they had made with Judas and with Jonathan , his brethren.
text_la: scripserunt ad eum in tabulis æreis, ut renovarent amicitias et societatem quam fecerant cum Juda et cum Jonatha, fratribus ejus.
text_pt: Os simples herdarão a estultícia, mas os prudentes serão coroados de conhecimento.
text_el: ἔγραψαν πρὸς αὐτὸν δέλτοις χαλκαῖς τοῦ ἀνανεώσασθαι πρὸς αὐτὸν φιλίαν καὶ συμμαχίαν ἣν ἔστησαν πρὸς Ιουδαν καὶ Ιωναθαν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they were read before the assembly in Jerusalem . And this is the copy of the letters that the Spartans sent.
text_la: Et lectæ sunt in conspectu ecclesiæ in Jerusalem. Et hoc exemplum epistolarum, quas Spartiatæ miserunt:
text_pt: Os maus inclinam-se diante dos bons, e os ímpios diante das portas dos justos.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεγνώσθησαν ἐνώπιον τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: The princes and the cities of the Spartans, to Simon, the high priest , and to the ancients, and the priests , and the rest of the people of the Jews , their brethren, greeting.
text_la: Spartianorum principes et civitates, Simoni sacerdoti magno, et senioribus, et sacerdotibus, et reliquo populo Judæorum, fratribus, salutem.
text_pt: O pobre é odiado até pelo seu próximo, porém os amigos dos ricos são muitos.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἀντίγραφον τῶν ἐπιστολῶν ὧν ἀπέστειλαν οἱ Σπαρτιᾶται Σπαρτιατῶν ἄρχοντες καὶ ἡ πόλις Σιμωνι ἱερεῖ μεγάλῳ καὶ τοῖς πρεσβυτέροις καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τῷ λοιπῷ δήμῳ τῶν Ιουδαίων ἀδελφοῖς χαίρειν

text_en: The ambassadors that were sent to our people, have told us of your glory , and honour, and joy : and we rejoiced at their coming.
text_la: Legati, qui missi sunt ad populum nostrum, nuntiaverunt nobis de vestra gloria, et honore, ac lætitia : et gavisi sumus in introitu eorum.
text_pt: O que despreza ao seu próximo peca, mas o que se compadece dos humildes é bem-aventurado.
text_el: οἱ πρεσβευταὶ οἱ ἀποσταλέντες πρὸς τὸν δῆμον ἡμῶν ἀπήγγειλαν ἡμῖν περὶ τῆς δόξης ὑμῶν καὶ τιμῆς καὶ ηὐφράνθημεν ἐπὶ τῇ ἐφόδῳ αὐτῶν

text_en: And we registered what was said by them in the councils of the people, in this manner: Numenius, the son of Antiochus, and Antipater, the son of Jason , ambassadors of the Jews , came to us to renew the former friendship with us.
text_la: Et scripsimus quæ ab eis erant dicta in conciliis populi, sic : Numenius Antiochi, et Antipater Jasonis filius, legati Judæorum, venerunt ad nos, renovantes nobiscum amicitiam pristinam.
text_pt: Porventura não erram os que praticam o mal? mas beneficência e fidelidade haverá para os que praticam o bem.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεγράψαμεν τὰ ὑπ' αὐτῶν εἰρημένα ἐν ταῖς βουλαῖς τοῦ δήμου οὕτως Νουμήνιος Ἀντιόχου καὶ Ἀντίπατρος Ἰάσονος πρεσβευταὶ Ιουδαίων ἦλθον πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀνανεούμενοι τὴν πρὸς ἡμᾶς φιλίαν

text_en: And it pleased the people to receive the men honourably, and to put a copy of their words in the public records, to be a memorial to the people of the Spartans. And we have written a copy of them to Simon, the high priest .
text_la: Et placuit populo excipere viros gloriose, et ponere exemplum sermonum eorum in segregatis populi libris, ut sit ad memoriam populo Spartiatarum. Exemplum autem horum scripsimus Simoni magno sacerdoti.
text_pt: Em todo trabalho há proveito, mas ficar só em palavras leva à pobreza.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσεν τῷ δήμῳ ἐπιδέξασθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐνδόξως καὶ τοῦ θέσθαι τὸ ἀντίγραφον τῶν λόγων αὐτῶν ἐν τοῖς ἀποδεδειγμένοις τῷ δήμῳ βιβλίοις τοῦ μνημόσυνον ἔχειν τὸν δῆμον τῶν Σπαρτιατῶν τὸ δὲ ἀντίγραφον τούτων ἔγραψαν Σιμωνι τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ

text_en: And after this Simon sent Numenius to Rome, with a great shield of gold, of the weight of a thousand pounds, to confirm the league with them. And when the people of Rome had heard
text_la: Post hæc autem misit Simon Numenium Romam, habentem clypeum aureum magnum, pondo mnarum mille, ad statuendam cum eis societatem. Cum autem audisset populus Romanus
text_pt: A coroa dos sábios é a sua riqueza, a estultícia dos tolos é só estultícia.
text_el: μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπέστειλεν Σιμων τὸν Νουμήνιον εἰς Ῥώμην ἔχοντα ἀσπίδα χρυσῆν μεγάλην ὁλκὴν μνῶν χιλίων εἰς τὸ στῆσαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὴν συμμαχίαν

text_en: these words, they said: What thanks shall we give to Simon, and his sons:
text_la: sermones istos, dixerunt : Quam gratiarum actionem reddemus Simoni, et filiis ejus?
text_pt: A testemunha verdadeira livra as almas, mas o que se desboca em mentiras é enganador.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν ὁ δῆμος τῶν λόγων τούτων εἶπαν τίνα χάριν ἀποδώσομεν Σιμωνι καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: For he has restored his brethren, and has driven away in fight the enemies of Israel from them: and they decreed him liberty, and registered it in tables of brass, and set it upon pillars in mount Sion.
text_la: restituit enim ipse fratres suos, et expugnavit inimicos Israël ab eis, et statuerunt ei libertatem, et descripserunt in tabulis æreis, et posuerunt in titulis in monte Sion.
text_pt: No temor do Senhor há firme confiança e ele será um refúgio para seus filhos.
text_el: ἐστήρισεν γὰρ αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπολέμησεν τοὺς ἐχθροὺς Ισραηλ ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἔστησαν αὐτῷ ἐλευθερίαν καὶ κατέγραψαν ἐν δέλτοις χαλκαῖς καὶ ἔθεντο ἐν στήλαις ἐν ὄρει Σιων

text_en: And this is a copy of the writing. The eighteenth day of the month Elul, in the year one hundred and seventy-two, being the third year under Simon, the high priest , at Asaramel,
text_la: Et hoc est exemplum scripturæ : Octavadecima die mensis Elul, anno centesimo septuagesimo secundo, anno tertio sub Simone sacerdote magno in Asaramel,
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é fonte de vida, para desviar dos laços da morte.
text_el: καὶ τοῦτο τὸ ἀντίγραφον τῆς γραφῆς ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῃ Ελουλ ἔτους δευτέρου καὶ ἑβδομηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ καὶ τοῦτο τρίτον ἔτος ἐπὶ Σιμωνος ἀρχιερέως μεγάλου ἐν ασαραμελ

text_en: in a great assembly of the priests , and of the people, and the princes of the nation, and the ancients of the country, these things were notified: Forasmuch as there have often been wars in our country,
text_la: in conventu magno sacerdotum, et populi, et principum gentis, et seniorum regionis, nota facta sunt hæc : quoniam frequenter facta sunt prælia in regione nostra,
text_pt: Na multidão do povo está a glória do rei, mas na falta de povo a ruína do príncipe.
text_el: ἐπὶ συναγωγῆς μεγάλης ἱερέων καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἀρχόντων ἔθνους καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων τῆς χώρας ἐγνώρισεν ἡμῖν

text_en: and Simon, the son of Mathathias , of the children of Jarib, and his brethren, have put themselves in danger, and resisted the enemies of their nation, for the maintenance of their holy places, and the law: and have raised their nation to great glory .
text_la: Simon autem Mathathiæ filius, ex filiis Jarib, et fratres ejus, dederunt se periculo, et restiterunt adversariis gentis suæ, ut starent sancta ipsorum, et lex : et gloria magna glorificaverunt gentem suam.
text_pt: O longânimo é grande em entendimento, mas o que é de espírito impaciente mostra a sua loucura.
text_el: ἐπεὶ πολλάκις ἐγενήθησαν πόλεμοι ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ Σιμων δὲ υἱὸς Ματταθιου ἱερεὺς τῶν υἱῶν Ιωαριβ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἔδωκαν αὑτοὺς τῷ κινδύνῳ καὶ ἀντέστησαν τοῖς ὑπεναντίοις τοῦ ἔθνους αὐτῶν ὅπως σταθῇ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νόμος καὶ δόξῃ μεγάλῃ ἐδόξασαν τὸ ἔθνος αὐτῶν

text_en: And Jonathan gathered together his nation, and was made their high priest , and he was laid to his people.
text_la: Et congregavit Jonathas gentem suam, et factus est illis sacerdos magnus, et appositus est ad populum suum.
text_pt: O sentimento sadio é vida para o corpo, mas a inveja é podridão para os ossos.
text_el: καὶ ἤθροισεν Ιωναθαν τὸ ἔθνος αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς ἀρχιερεὺς καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And their enemies desired to tread down and destroy their country, and to stretch forth their hands against their holy places.
text_la: Et voluerunt inimici eorum calcare et atterere regionem ipsorum, et extendere manus in sancta eorum.
text_pt: O que oprime o pobre insulta àquele que o criou, mas o que se compadece do necessitado o honra.
text_el: καὶ ἐβουλήθησαν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῶν ἐμβατεῦσαι εἰς τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκτεῖναι χεῖρας ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν

text_en: Then Simon resisted and fought for his nation, and laid out much of his money, and armed the valiant men of his nation, and gave them wages.
text_la: Tunc restitit Simon, et pugnavit pro gente sua, et erogavit pecunias multas, et armavit viros virtutis gentis suæ, et dedit illis stipendia:
text_pt: Pela sua própria malícia é lançado fora o perverso, mas o justo até na morte se mantém confiante.
text_el: τότε ἀντέστη Σιμων καὶ ἐπολέμησε περὶ τοῦ ἔθνους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐδαπάνησεν χρήματα πολλὰ τῶν ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ὁπλοδότησεν τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ ἔθνους αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὀψώνια

text_en: And he fortified the cities of Judea and Bethsura that lies in the borders of Judea , where the armour of the enemies was before: and he placed there a garrison of Jews .
text_la: et munivit civitates Judææ, et Bethsuram, quæ erat in finibus Judææ, ubi erant arma hostium antea : et posuit illic præsidium viros Judæos.
text_pt: No coração do prudente a sabedoria permanece, mas o que está no interior dos tolos se faz conhecido.
text_el: καὶ ὠχύρωσεν τὰς πόλεις τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ τὴν Βαιθσουραν τὴν ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων τῆς Ιουδαίας οὗ ἦν τὰ ὅπλα τῶν πολεμίων τὸ πρότερον καὶ ἔθετο ἐκεῖ φρουρὰν ἄνδρας Ιουδαίους

text_en: And he fortified Joppe , which lies by the sea: and Gazara, which borders upon Azotus , wherein the enemies dwelt before, and he placed Jews here: and furnished them with all things convenient for their reparation.
text_la: Et Joppen munivit, quæ erat ad mare, et Gazaram, quæ est in finibus Azoti, in qua hostes antea habitabant : et collocavit illic Judæos, et quæcumque apta erant ad correptionem eorum, posuit in eis.
text_pt: A justiça exalta os povos, mas o pecado é a vergonha das nações.
text_el: καὶ Ιοππην ὠχύρωσεν τὴν ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ τὴν Γαζαραν τὴν ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων Ἀζώτου ἐν ᾗ ᾤκουν οἱ πολέμιοι τὸ πρότερον καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐκεῖ Ιουδαίους καὶ ὅσα ἐπιτήδεια ἦν πρὸς τῇ τούτων ἐπανορθώσει ἔθετο ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And the people seeing the acts of Simon, and to what glory he meant to bring his nation, made him their prince and high priest , because he had done all these things, and for the justice and faith which he kept to his nation, and for that he sought by all means to advance his people.
text_la: Et vidit populus actum Simonis, et gloriam quam cogitabat facere genti suæ, et posuerunt eum ducem suum, et principem sacerdotum, eo quod ipse fecerat hæc omnia, et justitiam, et fidem, quam conservavit genti suæ, et exquisivit omni modo exaltare populum suum.
text_pt: O rei se alegra no servo prudente, mas sobre o que o envergonha cairá o seu furor.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ λαὸς τὴν πίστιν τοῦ Σιμωνος καὶ τὴν δόξαν ἣν ἐβουλεύσατο ποιῆσαι τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθεντο αὐτὸν ἡγούμενον αὐτῶν καὶ ἀρχιερέα διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν πεποιηκέναι πάντα ταῦτα καὶ τὴν δικαιοσύνην καὶ τὴν πίστιν ἣν συνετήρησεν τῷ ἔθνει αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξεζήτησεν παντὶ τρόπῳ ὑψῶσαι τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And in his days things prospered in his hands, so that the heathens were taken away out of their country, and they also that were in the city of David, in Jerusalem , in the castle, out of which they issued forth, and profaned all places round about the sanctuary, and did much evil to its purity.
text_la: Et in diebus ejus prosperatum est in manibus ejus, ut tollerentur gentes de regione ipsorum, et qui in civitate David erant, in Jerusalem in arce, de qua procedebant, et contaminabant omnia quæ in circuitu sanctorum sunt, et inferebant plagam magnam castitati:
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ εὐοδώθη ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐξαρθῆναι τὰ ἔθνη ἐκ τῆς χώρας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς ἐν τῇ πόλει Δαυιδ τοὺς ἐν Ιερουσαλημ οἳ ἐποίησαν αὑτοῖς ἄκραν ἐξ ἧς ἐξεπορεύοντο καὶ ἐμίαινον κύκλῳ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐποίουν πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐν τῇ ἁγνείᾳ

text_en: And he placed therein Jews for the defence of the country, and of the city, and he raised up the walls of Jerusalem .
text_la: et collocavit in ea viros Judæos ad tutamentum regionis, et civitatis, et exaltavit muros Jerusalem.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκισεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρας Ιουδαίους καὶ ὠχύρωσεν αὐτὴν πρὸς ἀσφάλειαν τῆς χώρας καὶ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ὕψωσεν τὰ τείχη τῆς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And King Demetrius confirmed him in the high priesthood .
text_la: Et rex Demetrius statuit illi summum sacerdotium.
text_el: καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Δημήτριος ἔστησεν αὐτῷ τὴν ἀρχιερωσύνην κατὰ ταῦτα

text_en: According to these things he made him his friend, and glorified him with great glory .
text_la: Secundum hæc fecit eum amicum suum, et glorificavit eum gloria magna.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτὸν τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐδόξασεν αὐτὸν δόξῃ μεγάλῃ

text_en: For he had heard that the Romans had called the Jews their friends, and confederates, and brethren, and that they had received Simon's ambassadors with honour:
text_la: Audivit enim quod appellati sunt Judæi a Romanis amici, et socii, et fratres, et quia susceperunt legatos Simonis gloriose,
text_el: ἤκουσεν γὰρ ὅτι προσηγόρευνται οἱ Ιουδαῖοι ὑπὸ Ῥωμαίων φίλοι καὶ σύμμαχοι καὶ ἀδελφοί καὶ ὅτι ἀπήντησαν τοῖς πρεσβευταῖς Σιμωνος ἐνδόξως

text_en: And that the Jews , and their priests , had consented that he should be their prince and high priest for ever, till there should arise a faithful prophet :
text_la: et quia Judæi et sacerdotes eorum consenserunt eum esse ducem suum, et summum sacerdotem in æternum, donec surgat propheta fidelis:
text_el: καὶ ὅτι οἱ Ιουδαῖοι καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς εὐδόκησαν τοῦ εἶναι αὐτῶν Σιμωνα ἡγούμενον καὶ ἀρχιερέα εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἕως τοῦ ἀναστῆναι προφήτην πιστὸν

text_en: And that he should be chief over them, and that he should have the charge of the sanctuary, and that he should appoint rulers over their works, and over the country, and over the armour, and over the strong holds;
text_la: et ut sit super eos dux, et ut cura esset illi pro sanctis, et ut constitueret præpositos super opera eorum, et super regionem, et super arma, et super præsidia:
text_el: καὶ τοῦ εἶναι ἐπ' αὐτῶν στρατηγόν καὶ ὅπως μέλῃ αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν ἁγίων καθιστάναι δι' αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς χώρας καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὅπλων καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀχυρωμάτων

text_en: and that he should have care of the holy places; and that he should be obeyed by all, and that all the writings in the country should be made in his name ; and that he should be clothed with purple and gold:
text_la: et cura sit illi de sanctis : et ut audiatur ab omnibus, et scribantur in nomine ejus omnes conscriptiones in regione : et ut operiatur purpura et auro:
text_el: καὶ ὅπως μέλῃ αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ὅπως ἀκούηται ὑπὸ πάντων καὶ ὅπως γράφωνται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ πᾶσαι συγγραφαὶ ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ καὶ ὅπως περιβάλληται πορφύραν καὶ χρυσοφορῇ

text_en: And that it should not be lawful for any of the people, or of the priests , to disannul any of these things, or to gainsay his words, or to call together an assembly in the country without him: or to be clothed with purple, or to wear a buckle of gold.
text_la: et ne liceat ulli ex populo et ex sacerdotibus irritum facere aliquid horum, et contradicere his quæ ab eo dicuntur, aut convocare conventum in regione sine ipso, et vestiri purpura, et uti fibula aurea:
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐξέσται οὐθενὶ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τῶν ἱερέων ἀθετῆσαί τι τούτων καὶ ἀντειπεῖν τοῖς ὑπ' αὐτοῦ ῥηθησομένοις καὶ ἐπισυστρέψαι συστροφὴν ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ ἄνευ αὐτοῦ καὶ περιβάλλεσθαι πορφύραν καὶ ἐμπορποῦσθαι πόρπην χρυσῆν

text_en: And whosoever shall do otherwise, or shall make void any of these things, shall be punished.
text_la: qui autem fecerit extra hæc, aut irritum fecerit aliquid horum, reus erit.
text_el: ὃς δ' ἂν παρὰ ταῦτα ποιήσῃ ἢ ἀθετήσῃ τι τούτων ἔνοχος ἔσται

text_en: And it pleased all the people to establish Simon, and to do according to these words.
text_la: Et complacuit omni populo statuere Simonem, et facere secundum verba ista.
text_el: καὶ εὐδόκησεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς θέσθαι Σιμωνι ποιῆσαι κατὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: And Simon accepted thereof, and was well pleased to execute the office of the high priesthood , and to be captain , and prince of the nation of the Jews , and of the priests , and to be chief over all.
text_la: Et suscepit Simon, et placuit ei ut summo sacerdotio fungeretur, et esset dux et princeps gentis Judæorum, et sacerdotum, et præesset omnibus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεδέξατο Σιμων καὶ εὐδόκησεν ἀρχιερατεύειν καὶ εἶναι στρατηγὸς καὶ ἐθνάρχης τῶν Ιουδαίων καὶ ἱερέων καὶ τοῦ προστατῆσαι πάντων

text_en: And they commanded that this writing should be put in tables of brass, and that they should be set up within the compass of the sanctuary, in a conspicuous place:
text_la: Et scripturam istam dixerunt ponere in tabulis æreis, et ponere eas in peribolo sanctorum, in loco celebri:
text_el: καὶ τὴν γραφὴν ταύτην εἶπον θέσθαι ἐν δέλτοις χαλκαῖς καὶ στῆσαι αὐτὰς ἐν περιβόλῳ τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τόπῳ ἐπισήμῳ

text_en: And that a copy thereof should be put in the treasury, that Simon, and his sons, may have it.
text_la: exemplum autem eorum ponere in ærario, ut habeat Simon, et filii ejus.
text_el: τὰ δὲ ἀντίγραφα αὐτῶν θέσθαι ἐν τῷ γαζοφυλακίῳ ὅπως ἔχῃ Σιμων καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And King Antiochus, the son of Demetrius, sent letters from the isles of the sea to Simon, the priest , and prince of the nation of the Jews , and to all the people:
text_la: Et misit rex Antiochus filius Demetrii epistolas ab insulis maris Simoni sacerdoti, et principi gentis Judæorum, et universæ genti:
text_pt: A resposta branda desvia o furor, mas a palavra dura suscita a ira.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ἀντίοχος υἱὸς Δημητρίου τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπιστολὰς ἀπὸ τῶν νήσων τῆς θαλάσσης Σιμωνι ἱερεῖ καὶ ἐθνάρχῃ τῶν Ιουδαίων καὶ παντὶ τῷ ἔθνει

text_en: And the contents were these: King Antiochus to Simon, the high priest , and to the nation of the Jews , greeting.
text_la: et erant continentes hunc modum : Rex Antiochus Simoni sacerdoti magno, et genti Judæorum salutem.
text_pt: A língua dos sábios adorna a sabedoria, mas a boca dos tolos derrama a estultícia.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν περιέχουσαι τὸν τρόπον τοῦτον βασιλεὺς Ἀντίοχος Σίμωνι ἱερεῖ μεγάλῳ καὶ ἐθνάρχῃ καὶ ἔθνει Ιουδαίων χαίρειν

text_en: Forasmuch as certain pestilent men have usurped the kingdom of our fathers, and my purpose is to challenge the kingdom, and to restore it to its former estate; and I have chosen a great army, and have built ships of war .
text_la: Quoniam quidem pestilentes obtinuerunt regnum patrum nostrorum, volo autem vendicare regnum, et restituere illud sicut erat antea : et electam feci multitudinem exercitus, et feci naves bellicas.
text_pt: Os olhos do Senhor estão em todo lugar, contemplando os maus e os bons.
text_el: ἐπεί τινες λοιμοὶ κατεκράτησαν τῆς βασιλείας τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν βούλομαι δὲ ἀντιποιήσασθαι τῆς βασιλείας ὅπως ἀποκαταστήσω αὐτὴν ὡς ἦν τὸ πρότερον ἐξενολόγησα δὲ πλῆθος δυνάμεων καὶ κατεσκεύασα πλοῖα πολεμικά

text_en: And I design to go through the country, that I may take revenge of them that have destroyed our country, and that have made many cities desolate in my realm.
text_la: Volo autem procedere per regionem ut ulciscar in eos, qui corruperunt regionem nostram, et qui desolaverunt civitates multas in regno meo.
text_pt: A língua benigna é árvore de vida, mas a perversidade nela deprime o espírito.
text_el: βούλομαι δὲ ἐκβῆναι κατὰ τὴν χώραν ὅπως μετέλθω τοὺς κατεφθαρκότας τὴν χώραν ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἠρημωκότας πόλεις πολλὰς ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου

text_en: Now, therefore, I confirm unto you all the oblations which all the kings before me remitted to you, and what other gifts soever they remitted to you:
text_la: Nunc ergo statuo tibi omnes oblationes, quas remiserunt tibi ante me omnes reges, et quæcumque alia dona remiserunt tibi:
text_pt: O tolo despreza a instrução de seu pai, mas o que observa a repreensão se haverá prudentemente.
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἵστημί σοι πάντα τὰ ἀφέματα ἃ ἀφῆκάν σοι οἱ πρὸ ἐμοῦ βασιλεῖς καὶ ὅσα ἄλλα δόματα ἀφῆκάν σοι

text_en: And I give you leave to coin your own money in your country:
text_la: et permitto tibi facere percussuram proprii numismatis in regione tua:
text_pt: Na casa do justo há um grande tesouro, mas nos ganhos do ímpio há perturbação.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέτρεψά σοι ποιῆσαι κόμμα ἴδιον νόμισμα τῇ χώρᾳ σου

text_en: And let Jerusalem be holy and free, and all the armour that has been made, and the fortresses which you have built, and which you keep in your hands, let them remain to you.
text_la: Jerusalem autem sanctam esse, et liberam : et omnia arma, quæ fabricata sunt, et præsidia, quæ construxisti, quæ tenes, maneant tibi.
text_pt: Os lábios dos sábios derramam o conhecimento, mas o coração dos tolos não faz assim.
text_el: Ιερουσαλημ δὲ καὶ τὰ ἅγια εἶναι ἐλεύθερα καὶ πάντα τὰ ὅπλα ὅσα κατεσκεύασας καὶ τὰ ὀχυρώματα ἃ ᾠκοδόμησας ὧν κρατεῖς μενέτω σοι

text_en: And all that is due to the king, and what should be the king's hereafter, from this present and for ever, is forgiven you.
text_la: Et omne debitum regis, et quæ futura sunt regi, ex hoc et in totum tempus remittuntur tibi.
text_pt: O sacrifício dos ímpios é abominável ao Senhor, mas a oração dos retos é o seu contentamento.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ὀφείλημα βασιλικὸν καὶ τὰ ἐσόμενα βασιλικὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν καὶ εἰς τὸν ἅπαντα χρόνον ἀφιέσθω σοι

text_en: And when we shall have recovered our kingdom, we will glorify you, and your nation, and the temple , with great glory , so that your glory shall be made manifest in all the earth.
text_la: Cum autem obtinuerimus regnum nostrum, glorificabimus te, et gentem tuam, et templum, gloria magna, ita ut manifestetur gloria vestra in universa terra.
text_pt: O caminho do ímpio é abominável ao Senhor, mas ao que segue a justiça ele ama.
text_el: ὡς δ' ἂν κρατήσωμεν τῆς βασιλείας ἡμῶν δοξάσομέν σε καὶ τὸ ἔθνος σου καὶ τὸ ἱερὸν δόξῃ μεγάλῃ ὥστε φανερὰν γενέσθαι τὴν δόξαν ὑμῶν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: In the year one hundred and seventy-four, Antiochus entered into the land of his fathers, and all the forces assembled to him, so that few were left with Tryphon.
text_la: Anno centesimo septuagesimo quarto exiit Antiochus in terram patrum suorum, et convenerunt ad eum omnes exercitus, ita ut pauci relicti essent cum Tryphone.
text_pt: Correção severa há para o que deixa a vereda, e o que odeia a repreensão morrerá.
text_el: ἔτους τετάρτου καὶ ἑβδομηκοστοῦ καὶ ἑκατοστοῦ ἐξῆλθεν Ἀντίοχος εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ συνῆλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ δυνάμεις ὥστε ὀλίγους εἶναι σὺν Τρύφωνι

text_en: And King Antiochus pursued after him, and he fled along by the sea coast and came to Dora .
text_la: Et insecutus est eum Antiochus rex, et venit Doram fugiens per maritimam:
text_pt: O inferno e a perdição estão perante o Senhor; quanto mais os corações dos filhos dos homens?
text_el: καὶ ἐδίωξεν αὐτὸν Ἀντίοχος καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Δωρα φεύγων τὴν ἐπὶ θαλάσσης

text_en: For he perceived that evils were gathered together upon him, and his troops had forsaken him.
text_la: sciebat enim quod congregata sunt mala in eum, et reliquit eum exercitus:
text_pt: O escarnecedor não ama aquele que o repreende, nem se chegará aos sábios.
text_el: ᾔδει γὰρ ὅτι ἐπισυνῆκται ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὰ κακά καὶ ἀφῆκαν αὐτὸν αἱ δυνάμεις

text_en: And Antiochus camped above Dora with a hundred and twenty thousand men of war , and eight thousand horsemen:
text_la: et applicuit Antiochus super Doram cum centum viginti millibus virorum belligeratorum, et octo millibus equitum:
text_pt: O coração alegre aformoseia o rosto, mas pela dor do coração o espírito se abate.
text_el: καὶ παρενέβαλεν Ἀντίοχος ἐπὶ Δωρα καὶ σὺν αὐτῷ δώδεκα μυριάδες ἀνδρῶν πολεμιστῶν καὶ ὀκτακισχιλία ἵππος

text_en: And he invested the city, and the ships drew near by sea: and they annoyed the city by land, and by sea, and suffered none to come in, or to go out.
text_la: et circuivit civitatem, et naves a mari accesserunt : et vexabant civitatem a terra et mari, et neminem sinebant ingredi vel egredi.
text_pt: O coração entendido buscará o conhecimento, mas a boca dos tolos se apascentará de estultícia.
text_el: καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν τὴν πόλιν καὶ τὰ πλοῖα ἀπὸ θαλάσσης συνῆψαν καὶ ἔθλιβε τὴν πόλιν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ οὐκ εἴασεν οὐδένα ἐκπορεύεσθαι οὐδὲ εἰσπορεύεσθαι

text_en: And Numenius, and they that had been with him, came from the city of Rome, having letters written to the kings, and countries, the contents whereof were these:
text_la: Venit autem Numenius, et qui cum eo fuerant, ab urbe Roma, habentes epistolas regibus et regionibus scriptas, in quibus continebantur hæc:
text_pt: Todos os dias do oprimido são maus, mas o coração alegre é um banquete contínuo.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Νουμήνιος καὶ οἱ παρ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ Ῥώμης ἔχοντες ἐπιστολὰς τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν καὶ ταῖς χώραις ἐν αἷς ἐγέγραπτο τάδε

text_en: Lucius, the consul of the Romans, to King Ptolemee, greeting.
text_la: Lucius consul Romanorum, Ptolemæo regi salutem.
text_pt: Melhor é o pouco com o temor do Senhor, do que um grande tesouro onde há inquietação.
text_el: Λεύκιος ὕπατος Ῥωμαίων Πτολεμαίῳ βασιλεῖ χαίρειν

text_en: The ambassadors of the Jews , our friends, came to us, to renew the former friendship and alliance, being sent from Simon, the high priest , and the people of the Jews .
text_la: Legati Judæorum venerunt ad nos amici nostri, renovantes pristinam amicitiam et societatem, missi a Simone principe sacerdotum et populo Judæorum.
text_pt: Melhor é a comida de hortaliça, onde há amor, do que o boi cevado, e com ele o ódio.
text_el: οἱ πρεσβευταὶ τῶν Ιουδαίων ἦλθον πρὸς ἡμᾶς φίλοι ἡμῶν καὶ σύμμαχοι ἀνανεούμενοι τὴν ἐξ ἀρχῆς φιλίαν καὶ συμμαχίαν ἀπεσταλμένοι ἀπὸ Σιμωνος τοῦ ἀρχιερέως καὶ τοῦ δήμου τῶν Ιουδαίων

text_en: And they brought also a shield of gold of a thousand pounds.
text_la: Attulerunt autem et clypeum aureum mnarum mille.
text_pt: O homem iracundo suscita contendas, mas o longânimo apaziguará a luta.
text_el: ἤνεγκαν δὲ ἀσπίδα χρυσῆν ἀπὸ μνῶν χιλίων

text_en: It has seemed good therefore to us, to write to the kings and countries, that they should do them no harm, nor fight against them, their cities, or countries: and that they should give no aid to them that fight against them.
text_la: Placuit itaque nobis scribere regibus et regionibus, ut non inferant illis mala, neque impugnent eos, et civitates eorum, et regiones eorum : et ut non ferant auxilium pugnantibus adversus eos.
text_pt: O caminho do preguiçoso é cercado de espinhos, mas a vereda dos retos é bem aplanada.
text_el: ἤρεσεν οὖν ἡμῖν γράψαι τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν καὶ ταῖς χώραις ὅπως μὴ ἐκζητήσωσιν αὐτοῖς κακὰ καὶ μὴ πολεμήσωσιν αὐτοὺς καὶ τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν χώραν αὐτῶν καὶ ἵνα μὴ συμμαχῶσιν τοῖς πολεμοῦσιν πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: And it has seemed good to us to receive the shield of them.
text_la: Visum autem est nobis accipere ab eis clypeum.
text_pt: O filho sábio alegra seu pai, mas o homem insensato despreza a sua mãe.
text_el: ἔδοξεν δὲ ἡμῖν δέξασθαι τὴν ἀσπίδα παρ' αὐτῶν

text_en: If, therefore, any pestilent men are fled out of their country to you, deliver them to Simon, the high priest , that he may punish them according to their law.
text_la: Si qui ergo pestilentes refugerunt de regione ipsorum ad vos, tradite eos Simoni principi sacerdotum, ut vindicet in eos secundum legem suam.
text_pt: A estultícia é alegria para o que carece de entendimento, mas o homem entendido anda retamente.
text_el: εἴ τινες οὖν λοιμοὶ διαπεφεύγασιν ἐκ τῆς χώρας αὐτῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς παράδοτε αὐτοὺς Σιμωνι τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ ὅπως ἐκδικήσῃ αὐτοὺς κατὰ τὸν νόμον αὐτῶν

text_en: These same things were written to King Demetrius, and to Attalus, and to Ariarathes, and to Arsaces,
text_la: Hæc eadem scripta sunt Demetrio regi, et Attalo, et Ariarathi, et Arsaci,
text_pt: Quando não há conselhos os planos se dispersam, mas havendo muitos conselheiros eles se firmam.
text_el: καὶ ταὐτὰ ἔγραψεν Δημητρίῳ τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ Ἀττάλῳ καὶ Ἀριαράθῃ καὶ Ἀρσάκῃ

text_en: and to all the countries: and to Lampsacus and to the Spartans, and to Delus, and Myndus, and Sicyon, and Caria, and Samus, and Pamphylia, and Lycia, and Alicarnassus, and Cos, and Side, and Aradus, and Rhodes , and Phaselis, and Gortyna, and Gnidus, and Cyprus , and Cyrene.
text_la: et in omnes regiones : et Lampsaco, et Spartiatis, et in Delum, et in Myndum, et in Sicyonem, et in Cariam, et in Samum, et in Pamphyliam, et in Lyciam, et in Alicarnassum, et in Coo, et in Siden, et in Aradon, et in Rhodum, et in Phaselidem, et in Gortynam, et Gnidum, et Cyprum, et Cyrenen.
text_pt: O homem se alegra em responder bem, e quão boa é a palavra dita a seu tempo!
text_el: καὶ εἰς πάσας τὰς χώρας καὶ Σαμψάμῃ καὶ Σπαρτιάταις καὶ εἰς Δῆλον καὶ εἰς Μύνδον καὶ εἰς Σικυῶνα καὶ εἰς τὴν Καρίαν καὶ εἰς Σάμον καὶ εἰς τὴν Παμφυλίαν καὶ εἰς Λυκίαν καὶ εἰς Ἁλικαρνασσὸν καὶ εἰς Ῥόδον καὶ εἰς Φασηλίδα καὶ εἰς Κῶ καὶ εἰς Σίδην καὶ εἰς Ἄραδον καὶ Γόρτυναν καὶ Κνίδον καὶ Κύπρον καὶ Κυρήνην

text_en: And they wrote a copy thereof to Simon, the high priest , and to the people of the Jews .
text_la: Exemplum autem eorum scripserunt Simoni principi sacerdotum, et populo Judæorum.
text_pt: Para o entendido, o caminho da vida leva para cima, para que se desvie do inferno em baixo.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἀντίγραφον τούτων ἔγραψαν Σιμωνι τῷ ἀρχιερεῖ

text_en: But King Antiochus moved his camp to Dora the second time, assaulting it continually, and making engines: and he shut up Tryphon, that he could not go out.
text_la: Antiochus autem rex applicuit castra in Doram secundo, admovens ei semper manus, et machinas faciens : et conclusit Tryphonem, ne procederet:
text_pt: O Senhor desarraiga a casa dos soberbos, mas estabelece o termo da viúva.
text_el: ἀντίοχος δὲ ὁ βασιλεὺς παρενέβαλεν ἐπὶ Δωρα ἐν τῇ δευτέρᾳ προσάγων διὰ παντὸς αὐτῇ τὰς χεῖρας καὶ μηχανὰς ποιούμενος καὶ συνέκλεισεν τὸν Τρύφωνα τοῦ ἐκπορεύεσθαι καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθαι

text_en: And Simon sent to him two thousand chosen men to aid him, silver also, and gold, and abundance of furniture.
text_la: et misit ad eum Simon duo millia virorum electorum in auxilium, et argentum, et aurum, et vasa copiosa:
text_pt: Abomináveis são para o Senhor os pensamentos do mau, mas as palavras dos puros são aprazíveis.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτῷ Σιμων δισχιλίους ἄνδρας ἐκλεκτοὺς συμμαχῆσαι αὐτῷ καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ σκεύη ἱκανά

text_en: And he would not receive them, but broke all the covenant that he had made with him before, and alienated himself from him.
text_la: et noluit ea accipere, sed rupit omnia, quæ pactus est cum eo antea, et alienavit se ab eo.
text_pt: O que agir com avareza perturba a sua casa, mas o que odeia presentes viverá.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠβούλετο αὐτὰ δέξασθαι ἀλλὰ ἠθέτησεν πάντα ὅσα συνέθετο αὐτῷ τὸ πρότερον καὶ ἠλλοτριοῦτο αὐτῷ

text_en: And he sent to him Athenobius, one of his friends, to treat with him, saying: You hold Joppe and Gazara, and the castle that is in Jerusalem , which are cities of my kingdom:
text_la: Et misit ad eum Athenobium unum de amicis suis, ut tractaret cum ipso, dicens : Vos tenetis Joppen, et Gazaram, et arcem, quæ est in Jerusalem, civitates regni mei:
text_pt: O coração do justo medita no que há de responder, mas a boca dos ímpios jorra coisas más.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἀθηνόβιον ἕνα τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ κοινολογησόμενον αὐτῷ λέγων ὑμεῖς κατακρατεῖτε τῆς Ιοππης καὶ Γαζαρων καὶ τῆς ἄκρας τῆς ἐν Ιερουσαλημ πόλεις τῆς βασιλείας μου

text_en: Their borders you have wasted, and you have made great havoc in the land, and have got the dominion of many places in my kingdom.
text_la: fines earum desolastis, et fecistis plagam magnam in terra, et dominati estis per loca multa in regno meo.
text_pt: O Senhor está longe dos ímpios, mas a oração dos justos escutará.
text_el: τὰ ὅρια αὐτῶν ἠρημώσατε καὶ ἐποιήσατε πληγὴν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκυριεύσατε τόπων πολλῶν ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου

text_en: Now, therefore, deliver up the cities that you have taken, and the tributes of the places whereof you have gotten the dominion without the borders of Judea .
text_la: Nunc ergo tradite civitates quas occupastis, et tributa locorum in quibus dominati estis extra fines Judææ:
text_pt: A luz dos olhos alegra o coração, a boa notícia fortalece os ossos.
text_el: νῦν οὖν παράδοτε τὰς πόλεις ἃς κατελάβεσθε καὶ τοὺς φόρους τῶν τόπων ὧν κατεκυριεύσατε ἐκτὸς τῶν ὁρίων τῆς Ιουδαίας

text_en: But if not, give me for them five hundred talents of silver, and for the havoc that you have made, and the tributes of the cities, other five hundred talents: or else we will come and fight against you.
text_la: sin autem, date pro illis quingenta talenta argenti, et exterminii, quod exterminastis, et tributorum civitatum alia talenta quingenta : sin autem, veniemus, et expugnabimus vos.
text_pt: Os ouvidos que atendem à repreensão da vida farão a sua morada no meio dos sábios.
text_el: εἰ δὲ μή δότε ἀντ' αὐτῶν πεντακόσια τάλαντα ἀργυρίου καὶ τῆς καταφθορᾶς ἧς κατεφθάρκατε καὶ τῶν φόρων τῶν πόλεων ἄλλα τάλαντα πεντακόσια εἰ δὲ μή παραγενόμενοι ἐκπολεμήσομεν ὑμᾶς

text_en: So Athenobius, the king's friend came to Jerusalem , and saw the glory of Simon and his magnificence in gold, and silver, and his great equipage, and he was astonished, and told him the king's words.
text_la: Et venit Athenobius amicus regis in Jerusalem, et vidit gloriam Simonis, et claritatem in auro, et argento, et apparatum copiosum : et obstupuit, et retulit ei verba regis.
text_pt: O que rejeita a instrução menospreza a própria alma, mas o que escuta a repreensão adquire entendimento.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ἀθηνόβιος ὁ φίλος τοῦ βασιλέως εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ εἶδεν τὴν δόξαν Σιμωνος καὶ κυλικεῖον μετὰ χρυσωμάτων καὶ ἀργυρωμάτων καὶ παράστασιν ἱκανὴν καὶ ἐξίστατο καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Simon answered him, and said to him: We have neither taken other men's land, neither do we hold that which is other men's , but the inheritance of our fathers, which was for some time unjustly possessed by our enemies.
text_la: Et respondit ei Simon, et dixit ei : Neque alienam terram sumpsimus, neque aliena detinemus : sed hæreditatem patrum nostrorum, quæ injuste ab inimicis nostris aliquo tempore possessa est.
text_pt: O temor do Senhor é a instrução da sabedoria, e precedendo a honra vai a humildade.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Σιμων εἶπεν αὐτῷ οὔτε γῆν ἀλλοτρίαν εἰλήφαμεν οὔτε ἀλλοτρίων κεκρατήκαμεν ἀλλὰ τῆς κληρονομίας τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ὑπὸ δὲ ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν ἀκρίτως ἔν τινι καιρῷ κατεκρατήθη

text_en: But we having opportunity, claim the inheritance of our fathers.
text_la: Nos vero tempus habentes, vindicamus hæreditatem patrum nostrorum.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ καιρὸν ἔχοντες ἀντεχόμεθα τῆς κληρονομίας τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν

text_en: And as to your complaints concerning Joppe and Gazara, they did great harm to the people, and to our country: yet for these we will give a hundred talents. And Athenobius answered him not a word.
text_la: Nam de Joppe et Gazara quæ expostulas, ipsi faciebant in populo plagam magnam, et in regione nostra : horum damus talenta centum. Et non respondit ei Athenobius verbum.
text_el: περὶ δὲ Ιοππης καὶ Γαζαρων ὧν αἰτεῖς αὗται ἐποίουν ἐν τῷ λαῷ πληγὴν μεγάλην καὶ τὴν χώραν ἡμῶν τούτων δώσομεν τάλαντα ἑκατόν

text_en: But returning in a rage to the king, made report to him of these words, and of the glory of Simon, and of all that he had seen, and the king was exceeding angry .
text_la: Reversus autem cum ira ad regem, renuntiavit ei verba ista, et gloriam Simonis, et universa quæ vidit, et iratus est rex ira magna.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη αὐτῷ λόγον ἀπέστρεψεν δὲ μετὰ θυμοῦ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῷ τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ τὴν δόξαν Σιμωνος καὶ πάντα ὅσα εἶδεν καὶ ὠργίσθη ὁ βασιλεὺς ὀργὴν μεγάλην

text_en: And Tryphon fled away by ship to Orthosias.
text_la: Tryphon autem fugit navi in Orthosiada.
text_el: τρύφων δὲ ἐμβὰς εἰς πλοῖον ἔφυγεν εἰς Ὀρθωσίαν

text_en: And the king appointed Cendebeus captain of the sea coast, and gave him an army of footmen and horsemen.
text_la: Et constituit rex Cendebæum ducem maritimum, et exercitum peditum et equitum dedit illi.
text_el: καὶ κατέστησεν ὁ βασιλεὺς τὸν Κενδεβαῖον ἐπιστράτηγον τῆς παραλίας καὶ δυνάμεις πεζικὰς καὶ ἱππικὰς ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ

text_en: And he commanded him to march with his army towards Judea : and he commanded him to build up Gedor , and to fortify the gates of the city, and to war against the people. But the king himself pursued after Tryphon.
text_la: Et mandavit illi movere castra contra faciem Judææ : et mandavit ei ædificare Gedorem, et obstruere portas civitatis, et debellare populum. Rex autem persequebatur Typhonem.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ παρεμβάλλειν κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς Ιουδαίας καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὴν Κεδρων καὶ ὀχυρῶσαι τὰς πύλας καὶ ὅπως πολεμῇ τὸν λαόν ὁ δὲ βασιλεὺς ἐδίωκε τὸν Τρύφωνα
